```cpp
  // --- PM4 packets -----------------------------------------------------------------

  // Consumes a whole packet, or leaves the position untouched if it is not
  // complete yet.
  bool Packet(Reader& reader, int depth) {
    const uint32_t packet = reader.Peek();
    uint32_t count = 0;
    switch (packet >> 30) {
      case 0:
        count = packet ? ((packet >> 16) & 0x3FFF) + 1 : 0;
        break;
      case 1:
        count = 2;
        break;
      case 2:
        count = 0;
        break;
      default:
        count = ((packet >> 16) & 0x3FFF) + 1;
        break;
    }
    if (reader.Pending() < count + 1) {
      return false;
    }
    reader.Advance(1);
    ++packets_;
    Reader data = reader;
    reader.Advance(count);
    if (!packet) {
      return true;
    }
    switch (packet >> 30) {
      case 0: {
        const uint32_t index = packet & 0x7FFF;
        const bool one_register = (packet >> 15) & 0x1;
        if (one_register) {
          for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            WriteRegister(index, data.Read());
          }
        } else {
          WriteRegisters(index, count, data);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 1: {
        const uint32_t value1 = data.Read();
        const uint32_t value2 = data.Read();
        WriteRegister(packet & 0x7FF, value1);
        WriteRegister((packet >> 11) & 0x7FF, value2);
        break;
      }
      case 2:
        break;
      default:
        Type3Packet(data, packet, count, depth);
        break;
    }
    return true;
  }

  void Type3Packet(Reader& data, uint32_t packet, uint32_t words, int depth) {
    const uint32_t opcode = (packet >> 8) & 0x7F;
    if ((packet & 0x1) && (!(bin_select_ & bin_mask_) || opcode == xenos::PM4_XE_SWAP)) {
      return;  // predicate fails; predicated swaps are always dropped
    }
    switch (opcode) {
      case xenos::PM4_INTERRUPT: {
        if (words < 1) break;
        const uint32_t cpus = data.Read();
        if (swap_interrupt_pending_) {
          // The swap-complete interrupt: right after the present, which the
          // frame rate cap already held (PM4_XE_SWAP), or held here if the
          // cap is not applied before presenting.
          swap_interrupt_pending_ = false;
          if (!REXCVAR_GET(cod6_pace_before_present)) PaceFrame();
        }
        for (uint32_t cpu = 0; cpu < 6; ++cpu) {
          if (cpus & (1u << cpu)) {
            Interrupt(1, cpu);
          }
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_XE_SWAP:
        // VdSwap writes "SWAP", the physical address of the frontbuffer and
        // its size.
        if (words >= 4) {
          data.Read();
          swap_frontbuffer_ = data.Read();
          swap_width_ = data.Read();
          swap_height_ = data.Read();
        }
        if (REXCVAR_GET(cod6_pace_before_present)) PaceFrame();
        Present();
        swap_interrupt_pending_ = true;
        ReportSlowFrame();
        break;
      case xenos::PM4_INDIRECT_BUFFER:
      case xenos::PM4_INDIRECT_BUFFER_PFD: {
        if (words < 2) break;
        const uint32_t address = data.Read() & 0x1FFFFFFF;
        const uint32_t length = data.Read() & 0xFFFFF;
        if (depth < kMaxIndirectDepth) {
          IndirectBuffer(address, length, depth + 1);
        } else if (++indirect_limit_skips_ == 1) {
          REXLOG_WARN("[native] Indirect buffer depth limit {} reached at {:08X}, {} words; "
                      "commands skipped (compatibility limit)", kMaxIndirectDepth, address, length);
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_WAIT_REG_MEM: {
        if (words < 5) break;
        const uint32_t info = data.Read();
        const uint32_t poll = data.Read();
        const uint32_t reference = data.Read();
        const uint32_t mask = data.Read();
        const auto wait_start = Clock::now();
        const auto limit = wait_start + kWaitRegMemMax;
        bool waited = false;
        for (uint32_t attempt = 0;; ++attempt) {
          if (!(info & 0x10) && poll == rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_COHER_STATUS_HOST &&
              (Register(poll) & UINT32_C(0x80000000))) {
            if (renderer_ready_) renderer_.GuestMemorySynchronized();
            registers_[poll] = 0;  // Acknowledge only after cache bookkeeping.
          }
          const uint32_t value = (info & 0x10) ? ReadMemory(poll) : Register(poll);
          if (Compare(info, value & mask, reference)) {
            break;
          }
          if (Clock::now() >= limit || !running_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            if (waits_cut_short_++ == 0) {
              REXLOG_WARN("[native] WAIT_REG_MEM not met ({} {:08X} ref {:08X} mask {:08X})",
                          (info & 0x10) ? "memory" : "register", poll, reference, mask);
            }
            break;
          }
          if (!waited && renderer_ready_) {
            // Idle time: let the draw recording thread empty its queue.
            renderer_.KickRecorder();
          }
          waited = true;
          // The game usually releases what the ring waits for within tens of
          // microseconds; yielding first avoids oversleeping each wait.
          if (attempt < 64) {
            std::this_thread::yield();
          } else {
            rex::thread::Sleep(std::chrono::microseconds(50));
          }
        }
        if (waited) {
          ++waits_;
          wait_ns_ += uint64_t(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                                   Clock::now() - wait_start)
                                   .count());
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_REG_RMW: {
        if (words < 3) break;
        const uint32_t info = data.Read();
        const uint32_t and_value = data.Read();
        const uint32_t or_value = data.Read();
        uint32_t value = Register(info & 0x1FFF);
        value &= ((info >> 31) & 0x1) ? Register(and_value & 0x1FFF) : and_value;
        value |= ((info >> 30) & 0x1) ? Register(or_value & 0x1FFF) : or_value;
        WriteRegister(info & 0x1FFF, value);
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_REG_TO_MEM: {
        if (words < 2) break;
        const uint32_t reg = data.Read();
        const uint32_t address = data.Read();
        WriteMemory(address, Register(reg));
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_MEM_WRITE: {
        if (words < 1) break;
        uint32_t address = data.Read();
        for (uint32_t i = 1; i < words; ++i) {
          WriteMemory(address, data.Read());
          address += 4;
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_COND_WRITE: {
        if (words < 6) break;
        const uint32_t info = data.Read();
        const uint32_t poll = data.Read();
        const uint32_t reference = data.Read();
        const uint32_t mask = data.Read();
        const uint32_t destination = data.Read();
        const uint32_t value_to_write = data.Read();
        const uint32_t value = (info & 0x10) ? ReadMemory(poll) : Register(poll);
        if (Compare(info, value & mask, reference)) {
          if (info & 0x100) {
            WriteMemory(destination, value_to_write);
          } else {
            WriteRegister(destination, value_to_write);
          }
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_EVENT_WRITE:
        if (words < 1) break;
        WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_EVENT_INITIATOR, data.Read() & 0x3F);
        break;
      case xenos::PM4_EVENT_WRITE_SHD: {
        if (words < 3) break;
        const uint32_t initiator = data.Read();
        const uint32_t address = data.Read();
        const uint32_t value = data.Read();
        WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_EVENT_INITIATOR, initiator & 0x3F);
        WriteMemory(address, ((initiator >> 31) & 0x1) ? counter_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)
                                                       : value);
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_EVENT_WRITE_EXT: {
        if (words < 2) break;
        const uint32_t initiator = data.Read();
        const uint32_t address = data.Read();
        WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_EVENT_INITIATOR, initiator & 0x3F);
        // The screen extent of the previous draw: the maximum is faked.
        const uint16_t extent[] = {0, kMaxExtent, 0, kMaxExtent, 0, 1};
        uint8_t* destination = memory_->TranslatePhysical(address & ~uint32_t(0x3));
        for (size_t i = 0; i < std::size(extent); ++i) {
          rex::memory::store_and_swap<uint16_t>(destination + i * 2, extent[i]);
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_EVENT_WRITE_ZPD: {
        if (words < 1) break;
        WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_EVENT_INITIATOR, data.Read() & 0x3F);
        const uint32_t address = Register(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_RB_SAMPLE_COUNT_ADDR);
        if (address) {
          FakeOcclusionResult(address);
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_SET_CONSTANT: {
        if (words < 1) break;
        const uint32_t type_index = data.Read();
        const uint32_t base = ConstantBase(type_index);
        if (base != UINT32_MAX) {
          const uint32_t index = base + (type_index & 0x7FF);
          WriteRegisters(index, words - 1, data);
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_SET_CONSTANT2:
      case xenos::PM4_SET_SHADER_CONSTANTS: {
        // Same format: the first value is the register index, the rest are
        // written consecutively.
        if (words < 1) break;
        const uint32_t index = data.Read() & 0xFFFF;
        WriteRegisters(index, words - 1, data);
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_LOAD_ALU_CONSTANT: {
        // Registers loaded from guest memory instead of from the ring.
        if (words < 3) break;
        const uint32_t address = data.Read() & 0x3FFFFFFF;
        const uint32_t type_index = data.Read();
        const uint32_t amount = data.Read() & 0xFFF;
        const uint32_t base = ConstantBase(type_index);
        if (base != UINT32_MAX) {
          const uint8_t* source = memory_->TranslatePhysical(address);
          const uint32_t index = base + (type_index & 0x7FF);
          for (uint32_t i = 0; i < amount; ++i) {
            WriteRegister(index + i, rex::memory::load_and_swap<uint32_t>(source + size_t(i) * 4));
          }
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_SET_BIN_MASK_LO:
        if (words < 1) break;
        bin_mask_ = (bin_mask_ & 0xFFFFFFFF00000000ull) | data.Read();
        break;
      case xenos::PM4_SET_BIN_MASK_HI:
        if (words < 1) break;
        bin_mask_ = (bin_mask_ & 0xFFFFFFFFull) | (uint64_t(data.Read()) << 32);
        break;
      case xenos::PM4_SET_BIN_SELECT_LO:
        if (words < 1) break;
        bin_select_ = (bin_select_ & 0xFFFFFFFF00000000ull) | data.Read();
        break;
      case xenos::PM4_SET_BIN_SELECT_HI:
        if (words < 1) break;
        bin_select_ = (bin_select_ & 0xFFFFFFFFull) | (uint64_t(data.Read()) << 32);
        break;
      case xenos::PM4_SET_BIN_MASK: {
        if (words < 2) break;
        const uint64_t high = data.Read();
        const uint64_t low = data.Read();
        bin_mask_ = (high << 32) | low;
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_SET_BIN_SELECT: {
        if (words < 2) break;
        const uint64_t high = data.Read();
        const uint64_t low = data.Read();
        bin_select_ = (high << 32) | low;
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_VIZ_QUERY: {
        // Like the emulation: when the query ends it is reported visible, in
        // case the game reads the result.
        if (words < 1) break;
        const uint32_t value = data.Read();
        const uint32_t id = value & 0x3F;
        if (!(value & 0x100)) {
          WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_EVENT_INITIATOR, xenos::VIZQUERY_START);
        } else {
          WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_EVENT_INITIATOR, xenos::VIZQUERY_END);
          const uint32_t reg = id < 32 ? uint32_t(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_PA_SC_VIZ_QUERY_STATUS_0)
                                       : uint32_t(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_PA_SC_VIZ_QUERY_STATUS_1);
          registers_[reg] |= UINT32_C(1) << (id < 32 ? id : id - 32);
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_DRAW_INDX:
      case xenos::PM4_DRAW_INDX_2: {
        // DRAW_INDX starts with the visibility query word.
        const uint32_t skip = opcode == xenos::PM4_DRAW_INDX ? 1 : 0;
        if (words < skip + 1) break;
        if (skip) {
          data.Read();
        }
        const uint32_t initiator = data.Read();
        WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_DRAW_INITIATOR, initiator);
        // Indices in a buffer (DMA): its base and size come in the packet and
        // are stored in their registers, as ExecutePacketType3Draw does.
        if (((initiator >> 6) & 0x3) == uint32_t(xenos::SourceSelect::kDMA)) {
          if (words < skip + 3) break;
          WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_DMA_BASE, data.Read());
          WriteRegister(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_VGT_DMA_SIZE, data.Read());
        }
        // Indices in the packet itself.
        const uint32_t* immediate = nullptr;
        uint32_t immediate_words = 0;
        if (((initiator >> 6) & 0x3) == uint32_t(xenos::SourceSelect::kImmediate)) {
          immediate_words = words - skip - 1;
          immediate_indices_.resize(immediate_words);
          for (uint32_t i = 0; i < immediate_words; ++i) {
            immediate_indices_[i] = data.Read();
          }
          immediate = immediate_indices_.data();
        }
        // A draw in copy mode is a resolve and/or a clear.
        if ((Register(rex::graphics::XE_GPU_REG_RB_MODECONTROL) & 0x7) ==
            uint32_t(xenos::EdramMode::kCopy)) {
          ++copies_;
          if (renderer_ready_) {
            renderer_.Resolve();
          }
        } else {
          ++draws_;
          if (renderer_ready_) {
            renderer_.Draw(immediate, immediate_words);
          }
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_IM_LOAD: {
        // The shader microcode from guest memory (CommandProcessor::
        // ExecutePacketType3_IM_LOAD).
        if (words < 2) break;
        const uint32_t address_type = data.Read();
        const uint32_t start_size = data.Read();
        const uint32_t dwords = start_size & 0xFFFF;
        const uint32_t address = address_type & ~uint32_t(0x3) & 0x1FFFFFFF;
        if (renderer_ready_ && dwords && uint64_t(address) + dwords * 4 <= 0x20000000u) {
          renderer_.LoadShader(xenos::ShaderType(address_type & 0x3),
                               memory_->TranslatePhysical<const uint32_t*>(address), dwords,
                               address);
        }
        break;
      }
      case xenos::PM4_IM_LOAD_IMMEDIATE: {
        // The microcode is in the packet, which may wrap around the ring.
        if (words < 2) break;
        const uint32_t type = data.Read();
        const uint32_t dwords = std::min(data.Read() & 0xFFFF, words - 2);
        shader_words_.resize(dwords);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < dwords; ++i) {
          // Kept in guest byte order, as the shader expects.
          shader_words_[i] = rex::byte_swap(data.Read());
        }
        if (renderer_ready_ && dwords) {
          renderer_.LoadShader(xenos::ShaderType(type & 0x3), shader_words_.data(), dwords, 0);
        }
        break;
      }
      default:
        // Do not silently treat an unreviewed opcode as supported. Count it
        // without dropping the remainder of this primary command buffer.
        if (unhandled_packets_[opcode]++ == 0) {
          REXLOG_WARN("[native] Unhandled PM4 opcode 0x{:02X}, {} words; compatibility review required",
                      opcode, words);
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  static uint32_t ConstantBase(uint32_t type_index) {
    switch ((type_index >> 16) & 0xFF) {
      case 0:
        return 0x4000;  // ALU
      case 1:
        return 0x4800;  // fetch
      case 2:
        return 0x4900;  // bool
      case 3:
        return 0x4908;  // loop
      case 4:
        return 0x2000;  // registers
      default:
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
  }

  // As the emulation's fallback: the game marks the counters it waits for with
  // 0xFFFFFEED, and a visible sample count is written when a query ends.
  void FakeOcclusionResult(uint32_t address) {
    auto* counts = memory_->TranslatePhysical<xenos::xe_gpu_depth_sample_counts*>(address);
    const uint32_t kFinished = rex::byte_swap(UINT32_C(0xFFFFFEED));
    const bool end = counts->ZPass_A == kFinished || counts->ZPass_B == kFinished ||
                     counts->ZFail_A == kFinished || counts->ZFail_B == kFinished;
    std::memset(counts, 0, sizeof(*counts));
    if (end) {
      counts->ZPass_A = kFakeOcclusionSamples;
      counts->Total_A = kFakeOcclusionSamples;
    }
  }

  void IndirectBuffer(uint32_t address, uint32_t words, int depth) {
    Reader reader;
    reader.base = memory_->TranslatePhysical(address);
    reader.pos = 0;
    reader.end = words;
    while (reader.Pending()) {
      if (!Packet(reader, depth)) {
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Test presentation -------------------------------------------------------------

  // Keep the four worst frames as fixed POD. Formatting and logging belong to
  // the report consumer, never the command-ring producer.
  void ReportSlowFrame() {
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
    if (!diagnostics_) return;
    const auto now = Clock::now();
    const uint64_t game_wait_ns = wait_ns_ - frame_start_wait_ns_;
    frame_start_wait_ns_ = wait_ns_;
    const uint64_t idle_ns = ring_idle_ns_ - frame_start_idle_ns_;
    frame_start_idle_ns_ = ring_idle_ns_;
    const uint64_t hold_ns = hold_ns_ - frame_start_hold_ns_;
    frame_start_hold_ns_ = hold_ns_;
    const auto previous = frame_start_;
    frame_start_ = now;
    if (!renderer_ready_ || previous.time_since_epoch().count() == 0) return;
    const uint64_t frame_ns = uint64_t(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                                           now - previous).count());
    const RendererStats& s = renderer_.stats();
    const uint64_t pipelines = s.pipelines_created - frame_start_pipelines_;
    const uint64_t shaders = s.shaders_translated - frame_start_shaders_;
    const uint64_t textures = s.textures_uploaded - frame_start_textures_;
    const uint64_t created = s.textures_created - frame_start_created_;
    frame_start_pipelines_ = s.pipelines_created;
    frame_start_shaders_ = s.shaders_translated;
    frame_start_textures_ = s.textures_uploaded;
    frame_start_created_ = s.textures_created;
    if (frame_ns < UINT64_C(50000000)) return;
    NativeReportSnapshot::SlowFrame sample{
        frame_ns, game_wait_ns, idle_ns, hold_ns, s.frame_fence_wait_ns,
        s.frame_stream_wait_ns, s.frame_upload_wait_ns, s.frame_drain_wait_ns,
        s.frame_texture_ns, pipelines, shaders, textures, created, s.frame_draws};
    slow_frame_samples_.Consider(sample);
#endif
  }

  // The frame rate cap (cod6_min_frame_vblanks): a frame is presented at a
  // vblank at least that many after the previous present, or at once if it is
  // later than that. The hold used to come after the present, before the
  // swap-complete interrupt: an early frame went on screen at once and the
  // next one, if a little over budget, 50 ms later, a short gap then a long
  // one, felt as a hitch even at 30 fps on average. Held before it, presents
  // are evenly spaced, and the interrupt still follows the present.
  void PaceFrame() {
    const uint32_t min_vblanks = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_min_frame_vblanks);
    if (min_vblanks > 1 && last_swap_vblank_) {
      const uint64_t target = last_swap_vblank_ + min_vblanks;
      if (REXCVAR_GET(cod6_pace_before_present) &&
          vblanks_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) < target && renderer_ready_) {
        // The frame's draws go to the GPU now, not after the wait.
        renderer_.Flush();
      }
      const auto hold_start = Clock::now();
      const auto limit = hold_start + std::chrono::milliseconds(100);
      while (vblanks_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) < target &&
             running_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && Clock::now() < limit) {
        rex::thread::Sleep(std::chrono::microseconds(250));
      }
      hold_ns_ += uint64_t(
          std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now() - hold_start)
              .count());
    }
    last_swap_vblank_ = vblanks_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  }

  void MaybeCaptureFrame(uint64_t swap) {
    /* COD6_V228_CAPTURA: antes esto era `if constexpr (!diagnostics::kEnabled)
     * return;`, y como en este port el diagnostico esta apagado, la captura de
     * fotogramas ni siquiera existia en el binario. Ahora es una comprobacion
     * normal: el cvar cod6_debug_capture_every vale 0 por defecto, asi que no
     * captura nada, pero se puede encender desde el toml sin recompilar. */
    if (!cod6::diagnostics::kEnabled) {
      if (!REXCVAR_GET(cod6_debug_capture_every)) return;
    }
    if (!presenter_) return;
    static uint32_t captured = 0;
    const uint32_t capture_limit = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_debug_capture_max);
    if (capture_limit && captured >= capture_limit) return;
    /* COD6_V312_BURST: consecutive frames from a chosen swap, so a texture
     * that changes on its own can be seen by differencing them. */
    const uint32_t burst_from = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_debug_capture_from);
    if (burst_from) {
      if (swap < burst_from) return;
    } else {
      const uint32_t every = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_debug_capture_every);
      if (!every || swap % every) return;
    }
    const std::string dir = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_debug_capture_dir);
    if (dir.empty()) return;
    {
      // fopen into a folder that does not exist fails silently, and the run is
      // wasted. Make it once, and say so if it cannot be made.
      static bool dir_ready = false;
      if (!dir_ready) {
        dir_ready = true;
        std::error_code ec;
        std::filesystem::create_directories(dir, ec);
        REXLOG_INFO("[capture] folder {}: {}", dir, ec ? ec.message() : std::string("ready"));
      }
    }
    rex::ui::RawImage image;
    if (!presenter_->CaptureGuestOutput(image) || !image.width || !image.height) {
      static uint32_t capture_failed_logged = 0;
      if (capture_failed_logged < 4) {
        ++capture_failed_logged;
        REXLOG_ERROR("[capture] CaptureGuestOutput returned nothing for swap {}", swap);
      }
      return;
    }
    const std::string path = fmt::format("{}/frame_{:06d}.rgbx", dir, swap);
    if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb")) {
      const uint32_t header[2] = {image.width, image.height};
      std::fwrite(header, sizeof(header), 1, f);
      for (uint32_t y = 0; y < image.height; ++y) {
        std::fwrite(image.data.data() + y * image.stride, 4, image.width, f);
      }
      std::fclose(f);
      ++captured;
      REXLOG_INFO("[native] captured frame {} ({}x{}) to {} ({}/{})", swap, image.width,
                  image.height, path, captured,
                  capture_limit ? capture_limit : 0);
    }
  }

  void Present() {
    if (!renderer_ready_ || !presenter_) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("[native] Swap rejected: native renderer/presenter is not ready");
      return;
    }
    const uint64_t swap = ++swaps_;
    g_swaps_presented.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    /* COD6_DVARS_HOOK
     *
     * Tras cod6_dvars_at_swap presentaciones (60 por defecto, ya pasado el
     * arranque), lanza el barrido de dvars en un hilo aparte. Es el mismo
     * mecanismo que usa COD4 (codmw_dvars) para apagar fx_enable, cg_brass,
     * r_glow, r_dof_enable... Esos efectos son dibujos mezclados con mucho
     * sobredibujado: apagarlos quita dibujos y relleno de GPU a la vez.
     *
     * El barrido comprueba pagina a pagina con TranslatePhysical antes de leer,
     * asi que no revienta en las zonas no comprometidas del espacio del invitado.
     */
    {
      static std::atomic<bool> lanzado{false};
      if (!lanzado.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) &&
          REXCVAR_GET(cod6_dvars_at_swap) > 0 &&
          g_swaps_presented.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) >=
              uint64_t(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_dvars_at_swap))) {
        lanzado.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        cod6::dvars::Apply(memory_, memory_->TranslatePhysical(0));
      }
    }
    counter_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
#if defined(__SWITCH__)
    RexSwitchPerfCount(0);
#endif
    renderer_.Swap(presenter_.get(), swap_frontbuffer_, swap_width_, swap_height_);
    g_last_frame_draws.store(uint32_t(renderer_.stats().frame_draws), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    MaybeCaptureFrame(swap);
  }

  bool ClearOutput(OutputContext& context, uint64_t swap) {
    const rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* device_info = provider_->vulkan_device();
    const auto& dfn = device_info->functions();
    const VkDevice device = device_info->device();

    if (render_pass_ == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
      VkAttachmentDescription attachment{};
      attachment.format = rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanPresenter::kGuestOutputFormat;
      attachment.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
      attachment.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
      attachment.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
      attachment.stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
      attachment.stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
      attachment.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
      attachment.finalLayout = rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanPresenter::kGuestOutputInternalLayout;
      VkAttachmentReference reference{0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL};
      VkSubpassDescription subpass{};
      subpass.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
      subpass.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
      subpass.pColorAttachments = &reference;
      VkRenderPassCreateInfo info{};
      info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
      info.attachmentCount = 1;
      info.pAttachments = &attachment;
      info.subpassCount = 1;
      info.pSubpasses = &subpass;
      if (dfn.vkCreateRenderPass(device, &info, nullptr, &render_pass_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        render_pass_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        return false;
      }
    }

    if (pool_ == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
      VkCommandPoolCreateInfo info{};
      info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
      info.queueFamilyIndex = device_info->queue_family_graphics_compute();
      if (dfn.vkCreateCommandPool(device, &info, nullptr, &pool_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        pool_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        return false;
      }
      VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo allocate{};
      allocate.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
      allocate.commandPool = pool_;
      allocate.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
      allocate.commandBufferCount = 1;
      if (dfn.vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &allocate, &commands_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        commands_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      }
      VkFenceCreateInfo fence_info{};
      fence_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;
      if (dfn.vkCreateFence(device, &fence_info, nullptr, &fence_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        fence_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      }
    }
    if (commands_ == VK_NULL_HANDLE || fence_ == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
      return false;
    }

    // A single command buffer: wait for the previous one before reusing it.
    if (fence_pending_) {
      dfn.vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence_, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
      dfn.vkResetFences(device, 1, &fence_);
      fence_pending_ = false;
    }
    dfn.vkResetCommandPool(device, pool_, 0);

    VkFramebuffer framebuffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    for (const Framebuffer& f : framebuffers_) {
      if (f.framebuffer != VK_NULL_HANDLE && f.version == context.image_version()) {
        framebuffer = f.framebuffer;
      }
    }
    if (framebuffer == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
      Framebuffer& f = framebuffers_[next_framebuffer_];
      next_framebuffer_ = (next_framebuffer_ + 1) % std::size(framebuffers_);
      if (f.framebuffer != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
        dfn.vkDestroyFramebuffer(device, f.framebuffer, nullptr);
        f.framebuffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      }
      VkImageView view = context.image_view();
      VkFramebufferCreateInfo info{};
      info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
      info.renderPass = render_pass_;
      info.attachmentCount = 1;
      info.pAttachments = &view;
      info.width = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_output_width);
      info.height = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_output_height);
      info.layers = 1;
      if (dfn.vkCreateFramebuffer(device, &info, nullptr, &f.framebuffer) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        f.framebuffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        return false;
      }
      f.version = context.image_version();
      framebuffer = f.framebuffer;
    }

    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo begin{};
    begin.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
    begin.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    if (dfn.vkBeginCommandBuffer(commands_, &begin) != VK_SUCCESS) {
      return false;
    }
    // Test colour: green rises and falls with the swap count, so a capture
    // tells a running game from a stalled one.
    const float phase = float(swap % 240) / 239.0f;
    VkClearValue color{};
    color.color.float32[0] = 0.05f;
    color.color.float32[1] = 0.10f + 0.40f * phase;
    color.color.float32[2] = 0.35f;
    color.color.float32[3] = 1.0f;
    VkRenderPassBeginInfo pass{};
    pass.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO;
    pass.renderPass = render_pass_;
    pass.framebuffer = framebuffer;
    pass.renderArea.extent.width = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_output_width);
    pass.renderArea.extent.height = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_output_height);
    pass.clearValueCount = 1;
    pass.pClearValues = &color;
    dfn.vkCmdBeginRenderPass(commands_, &pass, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
    dfn.vkCmdEndRenderPass(commands_);
    if (dfn.vkEndCommandBuffer(commands_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
      return false;
    }
    VkSubmitInfo submit{};
    submit.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
    submit.commandBufferCount = 1;
    submit.pCommandBuffers = &commands_;
    {
      const auto queue =
          device_info->AcquireQueue(device_info->queue_family_graphics_compute(), 0);
      if (dfn.vkQueueSubmit(queue.queue(), 1, &submit, fence_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    fence_pending_ = true;
    context.SetIs8bpc(true);
    return true;
  }

  void DestroyVulkan() {
    if (!provider_ || !provider_->vulkan_device()) {
      return;
    }
    const rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* device_info = provider_->vulkan_device();
    const auto& dfn = device_info->functions();
    const VkDevice device = device_info->device();
    if (fence_ != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
      if (fence_pending_) {
        dfn.vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence_, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
        fence_pending_ = false;
      }
      dfn.vkDestroyFence(device, fence_, nullptr);
      fence_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    for (Framebuffer& f : framebuffers_) {
      if (f.framebuffer != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
        dfn.vkDestroyFramebuffer(device, f.framebuffer, nullptr);
        f = Framebuffer{};
      }
    }
    if (pool_ != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
      dfn.vkDestroyCommandPool(device, pool_, nullptr);
      pool_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      commands_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (render_pass_ != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
      dfn.vkDestroyRenderPass(device, render_pass_, nullptr);
      render_pass_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
  }

  // --- State -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  rex::ui::WindowedAppContext* app_context_ = nullptr;
  std::unique_ptr<rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanProvider> provider_;
  std::unique_ptr<rex::ui::Presenter> presenter_;

  rex::runtime::FunctionDispatcher* dispatcher_ = nullptr;
  rex::system::KernelState* kernel_state_ = nullptr;
  rex::memory::Memory* memory_ = nullptr;
  bool mmio_registered_ = false;

  std::atomic<bool> running_{false};
  rex::system::object_ref<rex::system::XHostThread> vblank_thread_;
  rex::system::object_ref<rex::system::XHostThread> ring_thread_;

  std::atomic<uint32_t> callback_{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> callback_data_{0};
  // Incremented by vblanks and swaps; EVENT_WRITE_SHD can write it (the SDK's
  // command processor counter).
  std::atomic<uint32_t> counter_{0};
  // Vblanks delivered, and the vblank of the last swap-complete interrupt.
  std::atomic<uint64_t> vblanks_{0};
  uint64_t last_swap_vblank_ = 0;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  Clock::time_point frame_start_{};
  uint64_t frame_start_wait_ns_ = 0, frame_start_pipelines_ = 0, frame_start_shaders_ = 0,
           frame_start_textures_ = 0, frame_start_created_ = 0;
  SlowFrameSamples<NativeReportSnapshot::SlowFrame,
                   NativeReportSnapshot::kSlowFrameCapacity> slow_frame_samples_;
#endif
  uint64_t ring_idle_ns_ = 0, hold_ns_ = 0;
  bool ring_ready_fast_path_ = false;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  uint64_t ring_ready_bypasses_ = 0, ring_cv_paths_ = 0;
#endif
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  uint64_t frame_start_idle_ns_ = 0, frame_start_hold_ns_ = 0;
#endif
  bool swap_interrupt_pending_ = false;

  std::atomic<uint32_t> ring_base_{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> ring_words_{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> ring_generation_{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> write_pointer_{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> read_pointer_writeback_{0};
  std::mutex ring_mutex_;
  std::condition_variable ring_cv_;

  // Touched by the ring thread and, through MMIO, by the game's threads; as in
  // the emulation, races on these integers are harmless.
  // The renderer reads the GPU state from here: it is the SDK's register file,
  // so its helpers (draw_util and the rest) work on it unchanged.
  std::unique_ptr<rex::graphics::RegisterFile> register_file_;
  uint32_t* registers_;
  Renderer renderer_;
  bool renderer_ready_ = false;
  // COD6_SHADER_STORAGE_PENDING: the SDK asks for the shader storage before
  // the renderer exists; remembered and applied once it does.
  std::filesystem::path shader_storage_root_;
  uint32_t shader_storage_title_id_ = 0;
  bool shader_storage_pending_ = false;
  bool diagnostics_ = false;
  struct InterruptTiming {
    std::atomic<uint64_t> count{0}, ns{0}, maximum{0};
  };
  std::array<InterruptTiming, 2> interrupt_timings_;
  std::atomic<uint64_t> wptr_writes_{0};
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  // Report() is the nonblocking ring producer. The consumer owns all report
  // baselines, formatting and logging; shutdown drains it before renderer teardown.
  ReportSnapshotQueue<NativeReportSnapshot, 2> report_queue_;
  std::thread report_thread_;
  std::atomic<bool> report_stop_{false};
  std::mutex report_mutex_;
  std::condition_variable report_cv_;
  Clock::time_point report_capture_baseline_{};
  // Previous completed snapshot-capture costs, included in the next snapshot.
  uint64_t report_calls_ = 0, report_ns_ = 0, report_max_ns_ = 0;
#endif
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  uint64_t reported_idle_ns_ = 0, reported_hold_ns_ = 0;
#endif
  // CommandProcessor's gamma ramp state (DC_LUT_*), 256-entry table only.
  uint32_t gamma_ramp_[256] = {};
  uint32_t gamma_ramp_component_ = 0;
  std::vector<uint32_t> immediate_indices_;
  std::vector<uint32_t> shader_words_;
  uint64_t bin_mask_ = ~uint64_t(0);
  uint64_t bin_select_ = ~uint64_t(0);

  uint32_t swap_frontbuffer_ = 0;
  uint32_t swap_width_ = 0;
  uint32_t swap_height_ = 0;

  // Ring thread only.
  uint64_t packets_ = 0, draws_ = 0, copies_ = 0, swaps_ = 0, waits_cut_short_ = 0;
  uint64_t unhandled_packets_[128] = {};
  uint64_t indirect_limit_skips_ = 0;
  uint64_t waits_ = 0, wait_ns_ = 0;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  uint64_t reported_waits_ = 0, reported_wait_ns_ = 0;
  uint64_t reported_packets_ = 0, reported_draws_ = 0, reported_copies_ = 0,
           reported_swaps_ = 0;
#endif

  struct Framebuffer {
    VkFramebuffer framebuffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint64_t version = 0;
  };
  VkRenderPass render_pass_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkCommandPool pool_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkCommandBuffer commands_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkFence fence_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  bool fence_pending_ = false;
  Framebuffer framebuffers_[3];
  size_t next_framebuffer_ = 0;
};

}  // namespace

bool Enabled() { return REXCVAR_GET(cod6_renderer) == "native"; }

  return std::make_unique<NativeGraphicsSystem>();
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
//
// Native renderer for the Switch port: the app's own graphics system.
//
// Adapted from the native renderer of nfsmw-nx (StevensND/nfsmw-nx,
// app/src/nfsmw_nativo_sistema.h and .cpp, GPL-3.0), which draws Need for
// Speed: Most Wanted's frames with Vulkan instead of emulating the Xbox 360
// GPU。参见 docs/Switch原生首帧候选.md。
//
// With cod6_renderer = "native", the app's OnPreSetup puts this system in
// config.graphics and the SDK's Xenos emulation is not created. The game's
// Direct3D keeps running unchanged and fills its command ring; this system
// consumes the ring as the GPU would, answers everything the game waits for
// (registers, memory writes, interrupts, vblanks) and presents on each swap.

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>

#include <rex/system/interfaces/graphics.h>

namespace cod6::native {

// Whether the cod6_renderer cvar asks for the native renderer.
bool Enabled();

// Swaps the native renderer has presented since startup (0 when disabled).
uint64_t SwapsPresented();

// cod5-nx: draws of the last presented frame (0 when disabled), so the engine hooks can tell gameplay (hundreds of
// draws) from a loading screen (~50).
uint32_t LastFrameDraws();

std::unique_ptr<rex::system::IGraphicsSystem> CreateGraphicsSystem();

}  // namespace cod6::native
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include "cod6_diagnostics.h"
#include "cod6_file_writes.h"

REXCVAR_DECLARE(bool, cod6_cpu_skinning);
REXCVAR_DECLARE(bool, cod6_cpu_skinning_verify_only);

REXCVAR_DECLARE(bool, cod6_lightgrid_pack_verify_only);

REXCVAR_DECLARE(bool, cod6_native_zero_fill_verify_only);

REXCVAR_DECLARE(bool, cod6_worker_stalled_wait);

// native_textures.cpp defines this cvar inside cod6::native, not globally.
namespace cod6::native {
REXCVAR_DECLARE(bool, cod6_native_volume_copy_plan);
inline bool VolumeCopyPlanEnabledForEvidence() {
  return REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_volume_copy_plan);
}
}

#ifndef COD6_BUILD_REVISION
#define COD6_BUILD_REVISION "unknown"
#endif
#ifndef COD6_BUILD_DIRECT_CALLS
#define COD6_BUILD_DIRECT_CALLS -1
#endif
#ifndef COD6_BUILD_FIXED_FLUSH
#define COD6_BUILD_FIXED_FLUSH 0
#endif

namespace cod6::evidence {
inline void Begin() {
  if constexpr (!cod6::diagnostics::kEnabled) return;
  REXLOG_INFO("[opt-evidence] begin schema=1 revision={} direct_calls={} fixed_flush={} "
              "xex=72378BCD351E56532AD0F565A0E192DA8F5AD314B0844AB0ED67B3A6B68771E0",
              COD6_BUILD_REVISION, COD6_BUILD_DIRECT_CALLS, COD6_BUILD_FIXED_FLUSH);
  REXLOG_INFO("[fixed-flush] schema=1 enabled={} policy=arm-fz-fz16-always-on "
              "scalar_subnormal_semantics=changed hardware_acceptance=unverified",
              COD6_BUILD_FIXED_FLUSH);
  REXLOG_INFO("[opt-evidence] policy counters=cumulative cadence_seconds=10 "
              "comparison=sampled visual_acceptance=external performance_acceptance=external");
  REXLOG_INFO("[opt-evidence] static id=ppc_interrupt thread_local_requested={} "
              "call_count=not_instrumented runtime_acceptance=unverified",
              REXCVAR_GET(cod6_ppc_thread_local_msr));
```

```cpp
/* COD6_WRITES_CVAR_FREE
 *
 * Estos dos llevaban .lifecycle(kInitOnly), y con eso el valor del toml no se
 * aplicaba: en cada arranque, ya desde el primer fotograma, se leia el valor por
 * defecto y el registro decia
 *   [writes] vertex hashes false, verify-only true
 * con cod6_native_vertex_by_writes = true escrito en el archivo. Se descarto
 * primero la hipotesis del momento de la llamada: en v300 Configure() paso al
 * primer BeginFrame, con el toml ya aplicado, y siguio leyendo false.
 *
 * En cambio cod6_native_force_mip0, que no lleva ese ciclo de vida, si toma el
 * valor del archivo. Sin el, el valor se puede fijar desde el toml como el resto.
 */
/* COD6_WRITES_DEFAULT_ON
 *
 * El valor del toml nunca llegaba a este cvar. La cadena es esta, en cvar.cpp:
 *
 *   if (GetFlagInfo(full_key) == nullptr) {
 *     GetPendingValuesStorage()[full_key].config = value_str;   // diferido
 *     ...
 *   }
 *
 * Al leer el toml, este cvar todavia no estaba registrado (se registra en este
 * archivo, que es un modulo cargado despues), asi que el valor quedo pendiente y
 * no se aplico. Por eso en cada arranque salia
 *   [writes] vertex hashes false, verify-only true
 * con cod6_native_vertex_by_writes = true en el archivo, y luego
 *   [texmon] marcas: aciertos 0 fallos 0
 * ni una comprobacion por marcas en toda la sesion.
 *
 * Quitarle kInitOnly (v301) no basto: el valor no llegaba ni a intentarse.
 *
 * BO2 no depende de la configuracion para esto: sus marcas de escritura por
 * pagina estan activas por defecto (su menu solo ofrece "TEXTURE CHECKS" para
 * forzar la relectura completa, como herramienta de diagnostico). Aqui igual:
 * activado por defecto, y el toml o la linea de comandos pueden apagarlo.
 */
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_vertex_by_writes, true, "COD5",
                    "Observed-write page stamps instead of hashing unchanged data (on by default, as in BO2)");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_vertex_by_writes_verify_only, true, "COD5",
                    "Hash every observed-write candidate hit; detect missing writers before permitting reuse");

void cod6::writes::Configure() {
  g_verify_only=REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_vertex_by_writes_verify_only);
  g_enabled.store(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_vertex_by_writes),std::memory_order_relaxed);
  REXLOG_INFO("[writes] vertex hashes {}, verify-only {}; 4KB pages, tracked writes bracketed; "
              "first 256 eligible hits and every 64th checked; writer coverage incomplete",Enabled(),g_verify_only);
}

// Audited retail copy routine. Do not replace it with host memcpy here: its
// volatile registers, alignment paths, guest stack and cache-line stores matter.
// Bracket its destination with a conservative cache-line margin on both sides.
// Other inline stores/fills and guest-stack effects remain untracked.
#if defined(__SWITCH__)
// The __imp_ alias of the original only exists in the Switch link environment;
// on PC the symbol is undefined, and this write-tracking hook is only meaningful
// on the console anyway.
extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_8237AE40);
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_8237AE40) {
  if(!cod6::writes::Enabled()) {__imp__sub_8237AE40(ctx,base);return;}
  static const bool supported=[&] {
    uint64_t hash=UINT64_C(14695981039346656037);
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<736;++i)hash=(hash^base[0x8237AE40u+i])*UINT64_C(1099511628211);
    const bool supported=hash==UINT64_C(0x32950FE82AAAE662);
    if(!supported)REXLOG_ERROR("[writes] copy writer fingerprint mismatch; original retained, write-cache reuse prohibited for physical writes");
    return supported;
  }();
  cod6::writes::GuestWriteScope write(ctx.r3.u32,ctx.r5.u32,supported,128);
  __imp__sub_8237AE40(ctx,base);
}
#endif  // __SWITCH__
```

`src/native/nativo/cod6_page_writes.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>

namespace cod6::writes {
struct Range { uint32_t address=0,bytes=0;bool valid=false; };
inline Range GuestPhysicalRange(uint32_t guest,uint64_t bytes) {
  if(!bytes || guest<0xA0000000u)return {};
  const uint64_t limit=guest<0xC0000000u?UINT64_C(0xC0000000):
                       guest<0xE0000000u?UINT64_C(0xE0000000):UINT64_C(0xFFD00000);
  if(uint64_t(guest)>=limit || bytes>limit-guest)return {};
  const uint32_t physical=(guest&0x1FFFFFFFu)+(guest>=0xE0000000u?0x1000u:0);
  if(bytes>UINT64_C(0x20000000)-physical)return {};
  return {physical,uint32_t(bytes),true};
}

// No frame epochs: a write before OR after a cached read must invalidate that
// read, including two writes in the same frame. A global active-writer count
// prevents observing partially published page stamps. Overlapping writers use
// monotonic CAS-max, never a store that could move a page's stamp backwards.
template<size_t PageCount=(1u<<17)>
class PageWrites {
 public:
  struct Observation {uint64_t serial=0;bool quiet=false;};
  bool Valid(uint32_t address,uint64_t bytes)const {
    return bytes && uint64_t(address)<uint64_t(PageCount)*4096 &&
           bytes<=uint64_t(PageCount)*4096-address;
  }
  Observation Observe()const {
    const uint64_t serial=serial_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    return {serial,unknown_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)!=std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max() &&
                   active_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)==0 &&
                   serial==serial_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)};
  }
  bool StillQuiet(Observation observation)const {
    return observation.quiet && unknown_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)!=std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max() &&
           active_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)==0 &&
           serial_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)==observation.serial;
  }
  bool Unchanged(uint32_t address,uint32_t bytes,uint64_t since)const {
    const uint64_t unknown=unknown_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if(!since || !Valid(address,bytes) || unknown==std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max() || unknown>since)return false;
    const uint32_t first=address>>12,last=uint32_t((uint64_t(address)+bytes-1)>>12);
    for(uint32_t page=first;page<=last;++page)
      if(pages_[page].load(std::memory_order_acquire)>since)return false;
    return true;
  }
  void Begin(Range range) {active_.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_seq_cst);Stamp(range);}
  void End(Range range) {Stamp(range);active_.fetch_sub(1,std::memory_order_seq_cst);}
  void InvalidateAll() {Begin({});End({});}
  uint32_t Active()const{return active_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst);}
 private:
  static void Raise(std::atomic<uint64_t>& target,uint64_t value) {
    uint64_t old=target.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    while(old<value && !target.compare_exchange_weak(old,value,std::memory_order_release,std::memory_order_relaxed)){}
  }
  void Stamp(Range range) {
    const uint64_t serial=serial_.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_seq_cst)+1;
    // Serial wrap is practically unreachable, but must never make old ranges
    // look clean. Poison all reuse rather than accepting a wrapped epoch.
    if(serial==0) {Raise(unknown_,std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max());return;}
    if(!range.valid || !Valid(range.address,range.bytes)) {Raise(unknown_,serial);return;}
    const uint32_t last=uint32_t((uint64_t(range.address)+range.bytes-1)>>12);
    for(uint32_t page=range.address>>12;page<=last;++page)Raise(pages_[page],serial);
  }
  std::array<std::atomic<uint64_t>,PageCount> pages_{};
  std::atomic<uint64_t> serial_{1},unknown_{0};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> active_{0};
};
inline PageWrites<> g_pages;
inline std::atomic<bool> g_enabled{false},g_healthy{true};
inline bool g_verify_only=true;
inline bool Enabled(){return g_enabled.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);}
template<class Slots>
bool InvalidateBindingsOnWrites(uint64_t& observed_serial,uint64_t& memory_epoch,Slots& resolved_slots) {
  if(!Enabled())return false;
  const auto observation=g_pages.Observe();
  if(observation.quiet && observed_serial==observation.serial)return false;
  observed_serial=observation.serial;++memory_epoch;
  resolved_slots.fill(UINT64_MAX);
  return true;
}

class WriteScope {
 public:
  WriteScope(Range range,bool trusted=true):range_(range),enabled_(Enabled()) {
    if(enabled_) {
      if(!trusted) {g_healthy.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);range_={};}
      g_pages.Begin(range_);
    }
  }
  ~WriteScope(){if(enabled_)g_pages.End(range_);}
  WriteScope(const WriteScope&)=delete;
  WriteScope& operator=(const WriteScope&)=delete;
 private:
  Range range_;bool enabled_;
};
// Virtual addresses below A0000000 are not asserted to be physical aliases.
// An invalid physical-view range conservatively invalidates all tracked copies.
class GuestWriteScope {
 public:
  GuestWriteScope(uint32_t address,uint64_t bytes,bool trusted=true,uint32_t margin=0)
      :range_(GuestPhysicalRange(address,bytes)),active_(Enabled() && bytes && address>=0xA0000000u) {
    if(active_) {
      if(margin && range_.valid) {
        if(range_.address<margin || uint64_t(range_.address)+range_.bytes+margin>0x20000000u)range_={};
        else {range_.address-=margin;range_.bytes+=margin*2;}
      }
      if(!trusted) {g_healthy.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);range_={};}
      g_pages.Begin(range_);
    }
  }
  ~GuestWriteScope(){if(active_)g_pages.End(range_);}
  GuestWriteScope(const GuestWriteScope&)=delete;
  GuestWriteScope& operator=(const GuestWriteScope&)=delete;
 private:
  Range range_;bool active_;
};

struct HashResult {uint64_t hash=0;bool reused=false,compared=false,mismatch=false,busy=false;};
class WriteHashRecord {
 public:
  template<class Tracker,class Hash>
  HashResult Check(Tracker& tracker,uint32_t address,uint32_t bytes,bool verify_only,
                   std::atomic<bool>& healthy,Hash full_hash) {
    const auto observation=tracker.Observe();
    const bool same_range=address==address_ && bytes==bytes_;
    if(!same_range)validated_=0;
    const bool eligible=same_range && valid_ && healthy.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && observation.quiet &&
                        tracker.Unchanged(address,bytes,since_);
    const bool verify=verify_only || validated_<256 || !(queries_++%64);
    if(eligible && !verify && tracker.StillQuiet(observation))return {hash_,true,false,false,false};
    const uint64_t actual=full_hash();
    const bool quiet=tracker.StillQuiet(observation);
    const bool compared=eligible && quiet;
    const bool mismatch=compared && actual!=hash_;
    if(mismatch)healthy.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if(compared && !mismatch) {if(validated_<256)++validated_;}
    else if(actual!=hash_)validated_=0;
    hash_=actual;since_=observation.serial;
    address_=address;bytes_=bytes;
    valid_=quiet && tracker.Valid(address,bytes) && healthy.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return {actual,false,compared,mismatch,!quiet};
  }
 private:
  uint64_t since_=0,hash_=0,queries_=0;
  uint32_t validated_=0;
  uint32_t address_=0,bytes_=0;
  bool valid_=false;
};
void Configure();
} // namespace cod6::writes
```

```cpp
// COD6 - stubs de lo que el port de COD5 espera y nuestro SDK no tiene.
//
// Solo dos simbolos; los demas se resolvieron compilando sin diagnostico
// (COD6_DIAGNOSTICS = 0), que ademas es lo que pide la documentacion del
// proyecto para el camino caliente.

#include <cstdint>

#include <cstdio>
#include "cod6_main_wait.h"

namespace cod6::main_wait {

// COD5 enganchaba aqui el hilo principal del juego para avisarle cuando habia
// progreso en el anillo, y asi no gastaba CPU esperando.
//
// Ese enganche depende de direcciones del invitado de COD5 (sub_82xxxxxx) y no
// existe en COD6. Sin el, el juego sigue esperando como lo haria en una consola
// real: es correcto, solo que la espera se resuelve sondeando en vez de por
// aviso. Cuando portemos los ganchos de COD6, esta funcion pasara a despertar
// al hilo de verdad.
void Notify(uint8_t* base, Reason reason) {
  (void)base;
  (void)reason;
}

}  // namespace cod6::main_wait

// COD5 anadio esta funcion a su fork del SDK: deja de vigilar escrituras en las
// paginas que el juego marca de solo lectura, para que leerlas no provoque una
// excepcion simulada (200.000 por segundo en el menu, que los dejaba a 8 fps).
//
// Nuestro SDK no la tiene con ese nombre, pero ya hace lo mismo por otra via: el
// cvar cod6_sin_proteccion (por defecto true) toma el camino seguro de
// RexGmProtect y no registra ninguna pagina vigilada. Es el arreglo PROT218 de
// la version 218, que bajo los fallos de 1.488.973 a 222 y quito el parpadeo
// magenta.
//
// Asi que aqui solo se deja constancia; no hay nada que activar.
extern "C" void RexGmSetReadOnlyMapped(bool enabled) {
  static bool avisado = false;
  if (!avisado && enabled) {
    avisado = true;
    // Se usa printf y no el log del SDK a proposito: esto puede llamarse antes
    // de que el registro de logs este listo.
    std::fprintf(stderr,
                 "[cod6] RexGmSetReadOnlyMapped(true): equivalente ya activo "
                 "mediante cod6_sin_proteccion (PROT218)\n");
    std::fflush(stderr);
  }
}
```

`src/native/nativo/cod6_ppc_interrupts.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Thread-local MSR scheme adapted from VasilkovND/gears2-nx's
// gow2/tools/make_nx_pch.py (GPL-3.0). Keep ReXGlue's global mode as a fallback.
// The build audits all generated interrupt regions before enabling this header.
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <rex/thread/mutex.h>

extern "C" [[noreturn]] void Cod5InterruptDepthFailure(void);

namespace cod6::cpu {

// Set once in OnPreSetup, before the runtime creates guest/interrupt threads.
inline bool& ThreadLocalInterruptMode() {
  static bool enabled = false;
  return enabled;
}

inline int32_t& InterruptDepth() {
  static thread_local int32_t depth = 0;
  return depth;
}

inline uint64_t CheckInterruptState(std::atomic<int32_t>& legacy_count) {
  if (ThreadLocalInterruptMode()) return InterruptDepth() ? 0 : UINT64_C(0x8000);
  auto lock = rex::thread::global_critical_region::AcquireDirect();
  return legacy_count.load() ? 0 : UINT64_C(0x8000);
}

inline void EnterInterruptRegion(std::atomic<int32_t>& legacy_count) {
  if (ThreadLocalInterruptMode()) {
    ++InterruptDepth();
  } else {
    rex::thread::global_critical_region::mutex().lock();
    legacy_count.fetch_add(1);
  }
}

inline void LeaveInterruptRegion(std::atomic<int32_t>& legacy_count) {
  if (ThreadLocalInterruptMode()) {
    if (InterruptDepth() <= 0) Cod5InterruptDepthFailure();
    --InterruptDepth();
  } else {
    if (legacy_count.fetch_sub(1) <= 0) Cod5InterruptDepthFailure();
    rex::thread::global_critical_region::mutex().unlock();
  }
}

}  // namespace cod6::cpu

```

```cpp
#include "cod6_drawsurf_policy.h"

                    "Experimental fixed-XEX type-zero draw-list suppression; depth consumers require hardware validation")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

                      "Fixed-XEX rigid model LOD scale: 0 keeps the game's value; 1-4 selects less detail at distance "
                      "as the value increases. Quality/performance experiment; does not change saved settings")
    .allowed({"0","1","2","3","4"}).lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

    .allowed({"0","1","2","3","4"}).lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

void cod6::game::ConfigureRenderHooks() {
  skip_depth_prepass = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_game_skip_depth_prepass);
  count_drawsurfs = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_game_drawsurfs_diagnostics);
  lod_rigid=REXCVAR_GET(cod6_model_lod_rigid);
  lod_skinned=REXCVAR_GET(cod6_model_lod_skinned);
  REXLOG_INFO("[game-opt] COD5 draw-surfs: type-zero suppression {}, list diagnostics {}",
              skip_depth_prepass, count_drawsurfs);
  REXLOG_INFO("[game-opt] COD5 model LOD scale: rigid {}, skinned {} (0 = original game setting; 1-4 = quality override)",
              lod_rigid,lod_skinned);
}

cod6::game::LodCounters cod6::game::ReadLodCounters() {
  return {lod_calls.load(std::memory_order_relaxed),lod_rigid_changed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed),
          lod_skinned_changed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed),lod_invalid.load(std::memory_order_relaxed),
          lod_unsupported.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)};
}

extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_82405078);
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_82405078) {
  const uint32_t output=ctx.r4.u32;
  __imp__sub_82405078(ctx,base);
  if(!lod_rigid && !lod_skinned && !count_drawsurfs) return;
  static const bool supported=[&] {
    const bool ok=cod6::game::MatchesLodSetup(base+cod6::game::kLodSetupAddress);
    if(!ok) REXLOG_ERROR("[game-opt] COD5 LOD setup fingerprint mismatch; retaining original output");
    else REXLOG_INFO("[game-opt] COD5 82405078 LOD setup verified; output in entry r4; scale/base offsets C/14, 18/20");
    return ok;
  }();
  const uint64_t number=lod_calls.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if(!supported) {lod_unsupported.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);return;}
  const auto load=[base](uint32_t address) {return rex::memory::load_and_swap<uint32_t>(base+address);};
  const auto store=[base](uint32_t address,uint32_t value) {rex::memory::store_and_swap<uint32_t>(base+address,value);};
  const auto result=cod6::game::ApplyLodScale(output,lod_rigid,lod_skinned,load,store);
  if(result.changed&1) lod_rigid_changed.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if(result.changed&2) lod_skinned_changed.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if(result.invalid) lod_invalid.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if(number<8 && output>=0x10000 && uint64_t(output)+0x38<=UINT64_C(0x100000000)) {
    REXLOG_INFO("[game-opt] LOD output {:08X}: rigid {:.4f}, skinned {:.4f}, changed mask {}, invalid mask {}",
                output,std::bit_cast<float>(load(output+0xC)),std::bit_cast<float>(load(output+0x18)),
                result.changed,result.invalid);
  }
}

cod6::game::DrawSurfCounters cod6::game::ReadDrawSurfCounters() {
  DrawSurfCounters result;
  result.lists = lists.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  result.surfaces = surfaces.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  result.suppressed_lists = suppressed_lists.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  result.suppressed_surfaces = suppressed_surfaces.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  for (size_t i=0; i<result.lists_by_technique.size(); ++i) {
    result.lists_by_technique[i] = lists_by_technique[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    result.surfaces_by_technique[i] = surfaces_by_technique[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  }
  return result;
}

extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_82422508);

// Override the Switch weak public thunk. __imp__ remains the original full
// generated body. No codegen/PCH mutation or guest-register substitution.
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_82422508) {
  if (!skip_depth_prepass && !count_drawsurfs) {
    __imp__sub_82422508(ctx, base);
    return;
  }
  static const bool supported = [&] {
    const bool ok = cod6::game::MatchesDrawSurfsPrologue(base + cod6::game::kDrawSurfsAddress);
    if (!ok) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("[game-opt] COD5 draw-surfs prologue mismatch; using the original path without suppression");
    } else {
      REXLOG_INFO("[game-opt] COD5 82422508 prologue verified; count +4, technique +8, list in r5");
    }
    return ok;
  }();
  if (!supported) {
    __imp__sub_82422508(ctx, base);
    return;
  }
  const auto load = [base](uint32_t address) {
    return rex::memory::load_and_swap<uint32_t>(base + address);
  };
  const auto store = [base](uint32_t address, uint32_t value) {
    rex::memory::store_and_swap<uint32_t>(base + address, value);
  };
  const uint32_t list = ctx.r5.u32;
  auto result = cod6::game::RunDrawSurfList(list, skip_depth_prepass, load, store,
                                         [&] { __imp__sub_82422508(ctx, base); });
  const auto number = lists.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  surfaces.fetch_add(result.surfaces, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if (result.technique < lists_by_technique.size()) {
    lists_by_technique[result.technique].fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    surfaces_by_technique[result.technique].fetch_add(result.surfaces, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  }
  if (result.suppressed) {
    suppressed_lists.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    suppressed_surfaces.fetch_add(result.surfaces, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  }
  if (number < 12) {
    REXLOG_INFO("[game-opt] list {:08X}: {} surfaces, technique {}, suppressed {}",
                list, result.surfaces, result.technique, result.suppressed);
  }
}
```

`src/native/nativo/cod6_skinning.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Fixed-COD5 local-register CPU reference for the later GPU skinning path.
// Arithmetic/packing follow the generated PPC routines, including their
// non-fused multiply/add order and first-bone-only normal/tangent transform.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <rex/ppc/context.h>
#include <rex/ppc/intrinsics.h>

namespace cod6::skinning {
inline simde__m128 LoadVector(const uint8_t* p) {
  return simde_mm_castsi128_ps(simde_mm_shuffle_epi8(
      simde_mm_load_si128(reinterpret_cast<const simde__m128i*>(p)),
      simde_mm_load_si128(reinterpret_cast<const simde__m128i*>(VectorMaskL))));
}
inline void StoreVector(uint8_t* p, simde__m128 value) {
  simde_mm_store_si128(reinterpret_cast<simde__m128i*>(p), simde_mm_shuffle_epi8(
      simde_mm_castps_si128(value),
      simde_mm_load_si128(reinterpret_cast<const simde__m128i*>(VectorMaskL))));
}
template<unsigned GuestLane> inline simde__m128 Splat(simde__m128 value) {
  constexpr int lane = 3 - GuestLane;
  return simde_mm_shuffle_ps(value, value, (lane<<6)|(lane<<4)|(lane<<2)|lane);
}
inline simde__m128 MulAdd(simde__m128 a, simde__m128 b, simde__m128 c) {
  // The target and oracle are compiled with -ffp-contract=off.
  return simde_mm_add_ps(simde_mm_mul_ps(a,b),c);
}
inline uint16_t Load16(const uint8_t* p) {
  uint16_t value; std::memcpy(&value,p,2); return std::byteswap(value);
}
inline uint32_t Bits(simde__m128 value) {
  return static_cast<uint32_t>(simde_mm_cvtsi128_si32(simde_mm_castps_si128(value)));
}
inline int32_t Signed10(uint32_t value) {
  const int32_t v = static_cast<int32_t>(value & 1023);
  return v >= 512 ? v - 1024 : v;
}
inline simde__m128 Unpack(uint32_t word) {
  const int32_t x = Signed10(word), y = Signed10(word>>10), z = Signed10(word>>20);
  return simde_mm_castsi128_ps(simde_mm_set_epi32(
      x == -512 ? 0x7FC00000 : 0x40400000+x,
      0x40400000+y,0x40400000+z,(word>>30)|0x3F800000));
}
inline uint32_t Pack(simde__m128 value) {
  alignas(16) float lanes[4]; simde_mm_store_ps(lanes,value);
  uint32_t packed = 0;
  for (unsigned i=0;i<4;++i) {
    const float lo=std::bit_cast<float>(i==3 ? 0x40400000u : 0x403FFE01u);
    const float hi=std::bit_cast<float>(i==3 ? 0x40400003u : 0x404001FFu);
    float v=lanes[3-i];
    v = v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
    packed |= (std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(v)&(i==3 ? 3u : 1023u)) << (i*10);
  }
  return packed;
}
struct Matrix {
  simde__m128 x,y,z,t;
  explicit Matrix(const uint8_t* p)
      :x(LoadVector(p)),y(LoadVector(p+16)),z(LoadVector(p+32)),t(LoadVector(p+48)) {}
  simde__m128 Position(simde__m128 p) const {
    return MulAdd(Splat<0>(p),x,MulAdd(Splat<1>(p),y,MulAdd(z,Splat<2>(p),t)));
  }
  simde__m128 Direction(simde__m128 p) const {
    return MulAdd(Splat<0>(p),x,MulAdd(Splat<1>(p),y,simde_mm_mul_ps(Splat<2>(p),z)));
  }
};
struct Constants {
  simde__m128 unpack_scale,unpack_bias,pack_scale,pack_bias,one;
  simde__m128i position_permutation,weight_permutation,weight_fill;
  Constants(const uint8_t* base,bool weighted)
      :unpack_scale(LoadVector(base+0x82000DC0)),
       unpack_bias(LoadVector(base+0x82000DD0)),
       pack_scale(LoadVector(base+0x82000DB0)),
       pack_bias(LoadVector(base+0x820A69C0)),
       one(weighted?LoadVector(base+0x82000B40):simde_mm_setzero_ps()),
       position_permutation(simde_mm_castps_si128(LoadVector(base+0x824BFC60))),
       weight_permutation(weighted?simde_mm_castps_si128(LoadVector(base+0x84E9C140)):simde_mm_setzero_si128()),
       weight_fill(weighted?simde_mm_castps_si128(LoadVector(base+0x82000B20)):simde_mm_setzero_si128()) {}
  simde__m128 Weight(const uint8_t* base,uint32_t address) const {
    const auto left=simde_mm_shuffle_epi8(
        simde_mm_load_si128(reinterpret_cast<const simde__m128i*>(base+(address&~15u))),
        simde_mm_load_si128(reinterpret_cast<const simde__m128i*>(VectorMaskL+(address&15)*16)));
    const auto word=rex::ppc::simde_mm_perm_epi8_(left,weight_fill,weight_permutation);
    return simde_mm_mul_ps(rex::ppc::simde_mm_cvtepu32_ps_(word),
                          simde_mm_castsi128_ps(simde_mm_set1_epi32(0x37800000)));
  }
};

// Inputs/outputs and all matrix addresses must be 16-byte aligned, as the PPC
// lvx/stvx operations require. Guest pointer and overlap checks belong to the
// caller. Constants are read from the live guest; runtime-initialized masks are
// not replaced with assumptions from the static executable image.
template<unsigned Bones>
void RunTo(uint8_t* base,uint32_t input,uint32_t blend,uint32_t count,
           uint32_t matrices,uint8_t* output) {
  static_assert(Bones>=1 && Bones<=4);
  const Constants c(base,Bones>1);
  for (uint32_t n=0;n<count;++n,input+=32,output+=32,blend+=4*Bones-2) {
    const auto position=LoadVector(base+input);
    const auto tail=LoadVector(base+input+16);
    const Matrix first(base+matrices+Load16(base+blend));
    auto p=first.Position(position);
    if constexpr (Bones>1) {
      auto sum=simde_mm_setzero_ps(), blended=simde_mm_setzero_ps();
      for (unsigned i=1;i<Bones;++i) {
        const auto weight=c.Weight(base,blend+4*i);
        const Matrix m(base+matrices+Load16(base+blend+4*i-2));
        const auto transformed=m.Position(position);
        if (i==1) {
          sum=weight; blended=simde_mm_mul_ps(transformed,weight);
        } else {
          sum=simde_mm_add_ps(sum,weight);
          blended=MulAdd(weight,transformed,blended);
        }
      }
      p=MulAdd(simde_mm_sub_ps(c.one,sum),p,blended);
    }
    const auto normal=first.Direction(MulAdd(Unpack(Bits(tail)),c.unpack_scale,c.unpack_bias));
    const auto tangent=first.Direction(MulAdd(Unpack(Bits(Splat<2>(tail))),c.unpack_scale,c.unpack_bias));
    // Keep the original UV/other tail words, replace just the packed directions.
    auto packed=simde_mm_castps_si128(tail);
    packed=simde_mm_insert_epi32(packed,Pack(MulAdd(normal,c.pack_scale,c.pack_bias)),0);
    packed=simde_mm_insert_epi32(packed,Pack(MulAdd(tangent,c.pack_scale,c.pack_bias)),1);
    const auto merged=rex::ppc::simde_mm_perm_epi8_(simde_mm_castps_si128(p),
        simde_mm_castps_si128(Splat<3>(position)),c.position_permutation);
    StoreVector(output,simde_mm_castsi128_ps(merged));
    StoreVector(output+16,simde_mm_castsi128_ps(packed));
  }
}
template<unsigned Bones>
void Run(uint8_t* base,uint32_t input,uint32_t blend,uint32_t count,
         uint32_t matrices,uint32_t output) {
  RunTo<Bones>(base,input,blend,count,matrices,base+output);
}
} // namespace cod6::skinning
```

`src/native/nativo/cod6_skinning_hooks.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "cod6sp_pch.h"
#include <rex/hook.h>  // COD5_DEAD_HOOKS: REX_FUNC lives here
#include "cod6_skinning.h"
#include "cod6_skinning_policy.h"
#include "cod6_skinning_hooks.h"
#include "cod6_page_writes.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <new>
#include <vector>
#include <rex/cvar.h>

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_cpu_skinning, false, "COD5",
                    "Use fixed-XEX local-register 1-4 bone skinning with generated-output comparison and fallback")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_cpu_skinning_verify_only, true, "COD5",
                    "Compare every native skinning output; retain generated output for hardware validation")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

namespace {
bool requested=false,verify_only=true;
std::atomic<bool> healthy{true};
std::atomic<uint64_t> calls{0},vertices{0},compared{0},fast{0},fallbacks{0},mismatches{0};
std::array<std::atomic<uint64_t>,4> by_bones{},validated{},kernel_calls{};
using Original=void(*)(PPCContext&,uint8_t*);

template<unsigned Bones>
void Skin(PPCContext& ctx,uint8_t* base,Original original) {
  const bool writer_supported=!cod6::writes::Enabled() || [&] {
    static const bool supported=cod6::skinning::MatchesKernel(
        base+cod6::skinning::kKernels[Bones-1].address,cod6::skinning::kKernels[Bones-1]);
    return supported;
  }();
  // Existing scalar/native helpers and generated PPC use different pointer
  // construction sites. Until E-view handling is separately verified there,
  // conservatively cover both the raw-view and +4KB physical destinations.
  cod6::writes::GuestWriteScope write(ctx.r7.u32,uint64_t(ctx.r5.u32)*32,writer_supported,
                                     ctx.r7.u32>=0xE0000000u?4096:0);
  if(!requested || !healthy.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) { original(ctx,base);return; }
  static const bool supported=[&] {
    const bool match=cod6::skinning::MatchesKernel(
        base+cod6::skinning::kKernels[Bones-1].address,cod6::skinning::kKernels[Bones-1]);
    if(!match) {
      healthy.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);
      REXLOG_ERROR("[skinning] {}-bone full code fingerprint mismatch; using original kernels",Bones);
    }
    return match;
  }();
  const uint32_t input=ctx.r3.u32,blend=ctx.r4.u32,count=ctx.r5.u32;
  const uint32_t matrices=ctx.r6.u32,output=ctx.r7.u32;
  if(!supported || !cod6::skinning::ValidRanges(Bones,input,blend,count,matrices,output)) {
    fallbacks.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);original(ctx,base);return;
  }
  // Reject misaligned matrix offsets before changing any output. PPC lvx rounds
  // each address; the optimized contract deliberately accepts only aligned jobs.
  for(uint32_t n=0;n<count;++n) for(unsigned i=0;i<Bones;++i) {
    const uint32_t offset=i?4*i-2:0;
    if(cod6::skinning::Load16(base+blend+n*(4*Bones-2)+offset)&15) {
      fallbacks.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);original(ctx,base);return;
    }
  }
  calls.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  vertices.fetch_add(count,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  by_bones[Bones-1].fetch_add(count,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  const uint64_t ticket=kernel_calls[Bones-1].fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  const bool compare=verify_only || validated[Bones-1].load(std::memory_order_relaxed)<20000 || !(ticket%128);
  ctx.fpscr.enableFlushMode();
  if(compare) {
    // Per-thread, aligned output storage. Compute before the original so an
    // in-place original cannot destroy the input needed by the comparison.
    struct alignas(16) HalfVertex { uint32_t words[4]; };
    thread_local std::vector<HalfVertex> scratch;
    try { scratch.resize(size_t(count)*2); }
    catch(const std::bad_alloc&) {
      fallbacks.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);original(ctx,base);return;
    }
    auto* bytes=reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(scratch.data());
    cod6::skinning::RunTo<Bones>(base,input,blend,count,matrices,bytes);
    original(ctx,base);
    compared.fetch_add(count,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if(std::memcmp(bytes,base+output,size_t(count)*32)) {
      mismatches.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
      healthy.store(false,std::memory_order_relaxed);
      REXLOG_ERROR("[skinning] {}-bone output mismatch ({} vertices); retained original output and disabled native CPU skinning",Bones,count);
    } else validated[Bones-1].fetch_add(count,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return;
  }
  cod6::skinning::Run<Bones>(base,input,blend,count,matrices,output);
  fast.fetch_add(count,std::memory_order_relaxed);
  // Preserve the original argument advancement and leaf LR/CR effects in
  // addition to the ABI's nonvolatile state; other volatile scratch is unused.
  ctx.r3.s64+=int64_t(count)*32;ctx.r4.s64+=int64_t(count)*(4*Bones-2);ctx.r7.s64+=int64_t(count)*32;
  ctx.r5.s64=(Bones==1 || Bones==3)?32:48;
  ctx.r12.u64=ctx.lr;ctx.lr=cod6::skinning::kKernels[Bones-1].address+8;
  ctx.xer.ca=1;ctx.cr0.compare<int32_t>(0,0,ctx.xer);ctx.cr6.compare<uint32_t>(count,0,ctx.xer);
}
}

void cod6::skinning::Configure() {
  requested=REXCVAR_GET(cod6_cpu_skinning);
  verify_only=REXCVAR_GET(cod6_cpu_skinning_verify_only);
  REXLOG_INFO("[skinning] native CPU {}, verify-only {}; first 20000 vertices per kernel and every 128th call compared",requested,verify_only);
}
cod6::skinning::Counters cod6::skinning::ReadCounters() {
  Counters c;
  c.calls=calls.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);c.vertices=vertices.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  c.compared_vertices=compared.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);c.fast_vertices=fast.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  c.fallbacks=fallbacks.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);c.mismatches=mismatches.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)c.vertices_by_bones[i]=by_bones[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
  return c;
}
#define COD6_SKIN_HOOK(address,bones) \
  extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_##address); \
  extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_##address) { Skin<bones>(ctx,base,__imp__sub_##address); }
COD6_SKIN_HOOK(82446A98,1)
COD6_SKIN_HOOK(82446C28,2)
COD6_SKIN_HOOK(82446E18,3)
COD6_SKIN_HOOK(82447048,4)
#undef COD6_SKIN_HOOK
```

`src/native/nativo/cod6_skinning_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>

namespace cod6::skinning {
struct KernelSpec { uint32_t address,bytes; uint64_t fingerprint; };
inline constexpr std::array<KernelSpec,4> kKernels = {{
    {0x82446A98,396,UINT64_C(0xE19BDCDF33C2605A)},
    {0x82446C28,496,UINT64_C(0x3DF298D850839237)},
    {0x82446E18,556,UINT64_C(0x176ECFB3209B3037)},
    {0x82447048,616,UINT64_C(0x1998E17EF3ED74F0)}}};
inline bool MatchesKernel(const uint8_t* code,const KernelSpec& spec) {
  uint64_t hash=UINT64_C(14695981039346656037);
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<spec.bytes;++i) hash=(hash^code[i])*UINT64_C(1099511628211);
  return hash==spec.fingerprint;
}
inline bool Overlap(uint32_t a,uint64_t bytes_a,uint32_t b,uint64_t bytes_b) {
  return uint64_t(a)<uint64_t(b)+bytes_b && uint64_t(b)<uint64_t(a)+bytes_a;
}
inline bool ValidRanges(unsigned bones,uint32_t input,uint32_t blend,uint32_t count,
                        uint32_t matrices,uint32_t output) {
  if(bones<1 || bones>4 || !count || count>32767 ||
      ((input|output|matrices)&15) || (blend&1)) return false;
  const uint64_t vertices=uint64_t(count)*32, weights=uint64_t(count)*(4*bones-2);
  // Bone offsets are uint16 byte offsets, followed by four 16-byte vectors.
  const uint64_t matrix_bytes=65536+64;
  const auto valid=[](uint32_t start,uint64_t bytes) {
    return start>=0x10000 && uint64_t(start)+bytes<=UINT64_C(0x100000000);
  };
  if(!valid(input,vertices) || !valid(output,vertices) || !valid(blend,weights) ||
      !valid(matrices,matrix_bytes)) return false;
  if((input!=output && Overlap(input,vertices,output,vertices)) ||
      Overlap(output,vertices,blend,weights) || Overlap(output,vertices,matrices,matrix_bytes)) return false;
  for(uint32_t constant : {0x82000DB0u,0x82000DC0u,0x82000DD0u,0x820A69C0u,
                           0x82000B40u,0x824BFC60u,0x84E9C140u,0x82000B20u})
    if(Overlap(output,vertices,constant,16)) return false;
  return true;
}
} // namespace cod6::skinning
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
/*
 * COD6_TEXDUMP
 *
 * Llevamos horas mirando cvars. Esto vuelca a disco los bytes CRUDOS que el
 * invitado tiene en la memoria de una textura DXT grande, para decodificarlos
 * fuera de la consola y ver de una vez si el problema es:
 *
 *   a) los bytes del invitado ya son basura  -> leemos la direccion equivocada,
 *      o el juego aun no los ha escrito;
 *   b) los bytes del invitado son DXT validos -> el fallo esta en nuestro
 *      untiling / subida / muestreo.
 *
 * Se vuelca la cabecera (direccion, formato, tamano, tiled, pitch) y los bytes.
 * Formato del fichero: una linea de texto por textura y luego los bytes crudos.
 */
#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/memory/utils.h>
#include <rex/ppc/function.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_texdump_count, 0, "COD6",
    "Volcar los bytes crudos de esta many texturas DXT grandes (0 = apagado)")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

namespace {

std::atomic<uint32_t> g_dumped{0};

}  // namespace

namespace cod6::texdump {

/* La llama el cache de texturas cuando tiene una textura DXT >= 256 de ancho. */
void Dump(uint32_t base_address, uint32_t format, uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
          uint32_t pitch, bool tiled, uint32_t packed_mips, const uint8_t* base,
          uint32_t base_bytes, const uint8_t* mips, uint32_t mip_bytes) {
  const uint32_t limite = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_texdump_count);
  if (!limite) return;
  const uint32_t n = g_dumped.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  if (n >= limite) return;
  if (!base || !base_bytes) return;
  char nombre[96];
  std::snprintf(nombre, sizeof(nombre), "/switch/cod6-nx/texdump/t%02u.txt", unsigned(n));
  FILE* f = std::fopen(nombre, "wb");
  if (!f) {
    REXLOG_WARN("[texdump] no se pudo abrir {}", nombre);
    return;
  }
  std::fprintf(f,
               "addr=%08X format=%u %ux%u pitch=%u tiled=%d packed_mips=%u\n"
               "base_bytes=%u mip_bytes=%u mips_present=%d\n",
               unsigned(base_address), unsigned(format), unsigned(width), unsigned(height),
               unsigned(pitch), tiled ? 1 : 0, unsigned(packed_mips), unsigned(base_bytes),
               unsigned(mip_bytes), mips ? 1 : 0);
  std::fwrite(base, 1, base_bytes, f);
  if (mips && mip_bytes) {
    std::fprintf(f, "\n---MIPS---\n");
    std::fwrite(mips, 1, mip_bytes, f);
  }
  std::fclose(f);
  REXLOG_INFO("[texdump] {} addr={:08X} fmt={} {}x{} {} bytes", nombre, unsigned(base_address),
              unsigned(format), unsigned(width), unsigned(height), unsigned(base_bytes));
}

}  // namespace cod6::texdump
```
