```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "cod6sp_pch.h"
#include <rex/hook.h>  // COD5_DEAD_HOOKS: REX_FUNC lives here
// COD5-specific idle-worker gate; no guest event/queue state is replaced.
#include "cod6_worker_hooks.h"
#include "cod6_worker_policy.h"
#include "cod6_main_wait.h"
#include "cod6_ppc_interrupts.h"
#include "cod6_diagnostics.h"
#include <rex/cvar.h>
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
#include <chrono>
#define COD6_WORKER_NOTE(...) do { __VA_ARGS__; } while (0)
#else
#define COD6_WORKER_NOTE(...) do {} while (0)
#endif

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_worker_idle_wait, true, "COD5",
                    "Experimental bounded notification waits only for the two verified idle workers; "
                    "false retains the original worker loop")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_worker_idle_wait_us, 100, "COD5",
                      "Maximum idle-worker address-arbiter wait before the original scan runs again")
    .allowed({"50","100","200"}).lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_worker_stalled_wait, true, "COD5",
                    "With idle waits enabled, bound retries after four stable original worker scans with no consumption; "
                    "dependency changes without a notification are rechecked after the finite timeout")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

extern "C" uint32_t svcWaitForAddress(void*,uint32_t,int64_t,int64_t);
extern "C" uint32_t svcSignalToAddress(void*,uint32_t,int32_t,int32_t);

namespace {
using namespace cod6::workers;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
using Clock=std::chrono::steady_clock;
#endif
bool enabled=false;
bool stalled_enabled=false;
uint32_t bound_us=100;
std::atomic<bool> failed{false};
WakeGate gate;
thread_local int worker_slot=-1;
thread_local bool scanning=false;
thread_local uint64_t consumed_jobs=0;
thread_local StalledScans stalled_scans;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
std::atomic<uint64_t> scans{0},parks{0},changed{0},quiet_returns{0},queued{0},unsafe{0},unsupported{0};
std::atomic<uint64_t> notifications{0},wakes{0},sleep_ns{0},errors{0},late{0};
std::atomic<uint32_t> last_error{0};
std::atomic<uint64_t> inflight_scans{0},available_scans{0},negative_scans{0},stalled_parks{0};
#endif
bool Supported(uint8_t* base) {
  static const bool supported=[&] {
    const bool ok=MatchesWorkerCode(base);
    if(ok)REXLOG_INFO("[workers] fixed-XEX worker, queue publication and completion code verified");
    else {
      COD6_WORKER_NOTE(unsupported.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));
      REXLOG_ERROR("[workers] code fingerprint mismatch; retaining original worker loop");
    }
    return ok;
  }();
  return supported;
}
bool Active(uint8_t* base) {return enabled && !failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && Supported(base);}
void Notify() {
  COD6_WORKER_NOTE(notifications.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));
  [[maybe_unused]] const uint32_t count=gate.Notify([](std::atomic<uint32_t>& word) {
    const uint32_t result=svcSignalToAddress(&word,0,0,1);
    if(result) {
      COD6_WORKER_NOTE(errors.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);last_error.store(result,std::memory_order_relaxed));
      failed.store(true,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
  });
  COD6_WORKER_NOTE(wakes.fetch_add(count,std::memory_order_relaxed));
}
uint32_t LoadQueue(const uint8_t* base,uint32_t address) {
  return __builtin_bswap32(__atomic_load_n(reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(base+address),__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE));
}
struct WorkerScope {
  int previous=worker_slot;uint32_t slot;
  StalledScans previous_stalls=stalled_scans;
  explicit WorkerScope(uint32_t value):slot(value){worker_slot=int(slot);stalled_scans.Reset();}
  ~WorkerScope(){worker_slot=previous;stalled_scans=previous_stalls;gate.Release(slot);}
};
} // namespace

void cod6::workers::Configure() {
  const bool wait_requested=REXCVAR_GET(cod6_worker_idle_wait);
  enabled=wait_requested && cod6::cpu::ThreadLocalInterruptMode();
  stalled_enabled=enabled && REXCVAR_GET(cod6_worker_stalled_wait);
  const uint32_t requested_us=REXCVAR_GET(cod6_worker_idle_wait_us);
  bound_us=(requested_us==50 || requested_us==100 || requested_us==200)?requested_us:100;
  if(wait_requested && !enabled) {
    REXLOG_INFO("[workers] idle wait request disabled: audited thread-local interrupt mode is inactive");
  }
  REXLOG_INFO("[workers] idle wait {}, bound {} us; original scans and nonempty queues preserved",enabled,bound_us);
  REXLOG_INFO("[workers] stalled retries {}; four stable scans, no successful consumption, negative claims excluded; finite recheck",
              enabled && stalled_enabled);
}
cod6::workers::Counters cod6::workers::ReadCounters() {
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  return {enabled,scans.load(),parks.load(),changed.load(),quiet_returns.load(),queued.load(),unsafe.load(),unsupported.load(),
          notifications.load(),wakes.load(),sleep_ns.load(),errors.load(),late.load(),last_error.load(),
          inflight_scans.load(),available_scans.load(),negative_scans.load(),stalled_parks.load()};
#else
  return {};
#endif
}

extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_8242CEA0);
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_8242CEA0) {
  const uint32_t entry_slot=ctx.r3.u32;
  if(!Active(base) || entry_slot<2 || entry_slot>3 || !gate.Claim(entry_slot-2)) {
    __imp__sub_8242CEA0(ctx,base);return;
  }
  WorkerScope scope(entry_slot-2);
  __imp__sub_8242CEA0(ctx,base);
}

extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_8242CBD8);
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_8242CBD8) {
  const bool candidate=enabled && worker_slot>=0 && ctx.lr==kWorkerReturn && !scanning;
  if(!candidate || !Active(base)) {__imp__sub_8242CBD8(ctx,base);return;}
  // Sample BEFORE the original scan; a publication/completion during it must
  // prevent parking even if another consumer has already emptied that queue.
  const uint64_t seen=gate.Snapshot();
  const uint64_t consumed_before=consumed_jobs;
  struct ScanScope {ScanScope(){scanning=true;}~ScanScope(){scanning=false;}} scope;
  __imp__sub_8242CBD8(ctx,base);
  COD6_WORKER_NOTE(scans.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));
  if(failed.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) || !cod6::cpu::ThreadLocalInterruptMode() ||
      cod6::cpu::InterruptDepth()!=0 || !(ctx.msr&0x8000)) {
    stalled_scans.Reset();COD6_WORKER_NOTE(unsafe.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));return;
  }
  bool stalled=false;
  auto load=[&](uint32_t address){return LoadQueue(base,address);};
  if(stalled_enabled) {
    const auto queues=ObserveQueues(load);
    COD6_WORKER_NOTE(if(queues.negative)negative_scans.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    else if(queues.available)available_scans.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    else if(queues.outstanding)inflight_scans.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));
    stalled=stalled_scans.ShouldPark(queues,seen,gate.Snapshot(),consumed_before!=consumed_jobs);
    if(!queues.Idle() && !stalled) {COD6_WORKER_NOTE(queued.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));return;}
  } else if(!QueuesIdle(load)) {
    COD6_WORKER_NOTE(queued.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));return;
  }
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  const auto begin=Clock::now();
#endif
  const auto result=gate.Park(uint32_t(worker_slot),seen,int64_t(bound_us)*1000,
    [](std::atomic<uint32_t>& word,uint32_t expected,int64_t ns) {
      return svcWaitForAddress(&word,2,int64_t(expected),ns);
    });
  COD6_WORKER_NOTE(if(result.changed)changed.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed));
  if(result.waited) {
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
    if(stalled)stalled_parks.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    parks.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const auto elapsed=uint64_t(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now()-begin).count());
    sleep_ns.fetch_add(elapsed,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if(elapsed>uint64_t(bound_us)*1000+1000000)late.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if(!result.changed)quiet_returns.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
#endif
    // libnx result.h: kernel module 1, descriptions 117 (timeout), 125
    // (the word changed before registration). Other errors disable parking.
    if(result.platform_result && result.platform_result!=0xEA01 && result.platform_result!=0xFA01) {
      COD6_WORKER_NOTE(errors.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);last_error.store(result.platform_result,std::memory_order_relaxed));
      failed.store(true,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
  }
}

extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_8242CF40);
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_8242CF40) {
  __imp__sub_8242CF40(ctx,base);
  cod6::main_wait::Notify(base,cod6::main_wait::Reason::Publication);
  if(Active(base))Notify(); // Publication is complete, including synchronous fallback.
}
extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_8242C870);
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_8242C870) {
  __imp__sub_8242C870(ctx,base);
  if(ctx.r3.u32==1)cod6::main_wait::Notify(base,cod6::main_wait::Reason::Consumption);
  if(stalled_enabled && worker_slot>=0 && scanning && ctx.r3.u32==1)++consumed_jobs;
  if(enabled && ctx.r3.u32==1 && Active(base))Notify(); // Actual successful consumption/completion only.
}
extern "C" REX_FUNC(__imp__sub_8242C610);
extern "C" REX_FUNC(sub_8242C610) {
  __imp__sub_8242C610(ctx,base);
  cod6::main_wait::Notify(base,cod6::main_wait::Reason::Dispatch);
  if(Active(base))Notify(); // Includes the queue-full direct-dispatch path.
}

  __imp__sub_82241098(ctx,base);
```

`src/native/nativo/cod6_worker_policy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>

namespace cod6::workers {
inline constexpr uint32_t kWorkerReturn=0x8242CEC8;
inline constexpr uint32_t kQueueBase=0x84E72880,kQueueStride=128,kQueueCount=27;
struct CodeCheck { uint32_t address,bytes;uint64_t fingerprint; };
// Explicit fingerprint windows, not a claim about recovered function sizes.
inline constexpr CodeCheck kCodeChecks[]={
  {0x8242CEA0,44,UINT64_C(0xB2FA31D052CBB457)},
  {0x8242CBD8,208,UINT64_C(0xE408F761ECB5C5D2)},
  {0x8242C870,776,UINT64_C(0xF109E1178CD2A645)},
  {0x8242CF40,500,UINT64_C(0x2FE8AAC28A5D42AB)},
  {0x8242C610,608,UINT64_C(0xF8D9222AFCD8997A)},
  {0x82241098,12,UINT64_C(0x5BABB7E826DD3497)},
  {0x8242CED0,140,UINT64_C(0xD5EE10FF802883A4)},
  {0x82240AD8,112,UINT64_C(0x0D4CD250FB2005BE)},
  {0x82240920,112,UINT64_C(0xE29329AD2B2E606B)},
  {0x82240990,144,UINT64_C(0x446A06E8714C7BA6)},
};
inline bool MatchesWorkerCode(const uint8_t* base) {
  for(const auto& check:kCodeChecks) {
    uint64_t hash=UINT64_C(14695981039346656037);
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<check.bytes;++i) hash=(hash^base[check.address+i])*UINT64_C(1099511628211);
    if(hash!=check.fingerprint)return false;
  }
  return true;
}
template<class Load> bool QueuesIdle(Load load) {
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<kQueueCount;++i) {
    const uint32_t queue=kQueueBase+i*kQueueStride;
    // In-flight jobs and temporary negative claims also forbid parking.
    if(load(queue+12)!=0 || load(queue+16)!=0)return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// Observations only: +12 counts outstanding work (publication/execution), +16
// is atomically claimed by consumers and can be transiently negative. Positive
// +16 does not prove that a dependency callback will allow a job to run.
struct QueueObservation {
  bool outstanding=false,available=false,negative=false;
  uint64_t fingerprint=UINT64_C(14695981039346656037);
  bool Idle()const{return !outstanding && !available && !negative;}
};
template<class Load> QueueObservation ObserveQueues(Load load) {
  QueueObservation result;
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<kQueueCount;++i) {
    const uint32_t queue=kQueueBase+i*kQueueStride;
    const uint32_t outstanding=load(queue+12),available=load(queue+16);
    result.negative|=(outstanding&0x80000000u) || (available&0x80000000u);
    result.outstanding|=outstanding!=0;result.available|=available!=0;
    result.fingerprint=(result.fingerprint^outstanding)*UINT64_C(1099511628211);
    result.fingerprint=(result.fingerprint^available)*UINT64_C(1099511628211);
  }
  return result;
}

// A bounded retry policy, not a proof that all dependencies are blocked. The
// complete original scan always runs first; no callback or queued job is skipped.
class StalledScans {
 public:
  void Reset(){streak_=0;}
  bool ShouldPark(const QueueObservation& queues,uint64_t before,uint64_t after,bool consumed) {
    if(queues.negative || queues.Idle() || consumed || before!=after) {Reset();return false;}
    if(streak_ && generation_==after && fingerprint_==queues.fingerprint) {
      if(streak_<4)++streak_;
    } else streak_=1;
    generation_=after;fingerprint_=queues.fingerprint;
    return streak_>=4;
  }
 private:
  unsigned streak_=0;
  uint64_t generation_=0,fingerprint_=0;
};

// Two workers, one independently arbitrated word each. Every notification
// changes the generation BEFORE inspecting sleeping words. A waiter arms its
// word BEFORE rechecking the generation. The kernel must atomically check the
// word while registering its wait (svcWaitForAddress on Horizon).
class WakeGate {
 public:
  static constexpr uint32_t kIdle=0,kSleeping=1,kNotified=2;
  struct Result { bool waited=false,changed=false,busy=false;uint32_t platform_result=0; };
  bool Claim(uint32_t slot) {
    if(slot>=slots_.size())return false;
    bool expected=false;
    return slots_[slot].claimed.compare_exchange_strong(expected,true,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
  }
  void Release(uint32_t slot) {
    slots_[slot].word.store(kIdle,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    slots_[slot].claimed.store(false,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
  }
  uint64_t Snapshot()const{return generation_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst);}
  template<class Wake> uint32_t Notify(Wake wake) {
    generation_.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    uint32_t count=0;
    for(auto& slot:slots_) {
      uint32_t expected=kSleeping;
      if(slot.word.compare_exchange_strong(expected,kNotified,std::memory_order_seq_cst)) {
        wake(slot.word);++count;
      }
    }
    return count;
  }
  template<class Wait> Result Park(uint32_t slot,uint64_t seen,int64_t bound_ns,Wait wait) {
    if(slot>=slots_.size() || bound_ns<=0 || !slots_[slot].claimed.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst))
      return {.busy=true};
    auto& word=slots_[slot].word;
    uint32_t expected=kIdle;
    if(!word.compare_exchange_strong(expected,kSleeping,std::memory_order_seq_cst))return {.busy=true};
    struct Disarm {std::atomic<uint32_t>& word;~Disarm(){word.store(kIdle,std::memory_order_seq_cst);}} disarm{word};
    if(Snapshot()!=seen)return {.changed=true};
    const uint32_t result=wait(word,kSleeping,bound_ns);
    return {.waited=true,.changed=Snapshot()!=seen || word.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)==kNotified,
            .platform_result=result};
  }
 private:
  struct alignas(64) Slot { std::atomic<uint32_t> word{kIdle};std::atomic<bool> claimed{false}; };
  std::array<Slot,2> slots_{};
  std::atomic<uint64_t> generation_{0};
};
static_assert(std::atomic<uint32_t>::is_always_lock_free && sizeof(std::atomic<uint32_t>)==4);
} // namespace cod6::workers
```

`src/native/nativo/native_batch_recorder.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <type_traits>

namespace cod6::native {
// One producer owns Enqueue/Publish/Drain/Stop. The consumer only executes
// copied commands. Resources referenced by a command remain the renderer's
// responsibility: drain before recording immediate commands or retiring them.
/*
 * COD6_BATCH256
 *
 * El lote de publicacion era 64. Con ~5.800 dibujos por fotograma eso son unas 90
 * publicaciones por fotograma, y cada una es un store atomico mas un possible
 * notify. La tanda 254 medía capacity_waits=0, asi que el productor nunca se
 * quedaba sin sitio: subir el lote solo quita publicaciones, no anade espera.
 *
 * Las dos cotas son potencias de dos y Capacity >= Batch, que es lo que exige el
 * static_assert de abajo.
 */
template<class Command,uint32_t Capacity=4096,uint32_t Batch=256>
class BatchRecorder {
 public:
  static_assert(Capacity>=Batch && Batch>0 && (Capacity&(Capacity-1))==0);
  static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Command>);
  static constexpr uint32_t kBatchSize=Batch;
  struct Stats {
    uint64_t queued=0,publications=0,wakes=0,capacity_waits=0,drains=0;
    uint64_t capacity_wait_ns=0,drain_wait_ns=0,executed=0,executed_batches=0,execute_ns=0;
  };
  ~BatchRecorder(){Stop();}
  // Lifecycle handoff only: the old producer must have stopped, and its
  // writes must be externally synchronized (thread start/join in the host).
  void AdoptProducer(){owner_=std::this_thread::get_id();}
  void Start(std::function<void(const Command&)> execute,std::function<void()> startup={}) {
    assert(!active_ && !worker_.joinable());
    commands_=std::make_unique<Command[]>(Capacity);
    execute_=std::move(execute);startup_=std::move(startup);
    AdoptProducer();
    written_=published_seen_=done_seen_=0;
    stats_={};published_.store(0);done_.store(0);stop_.store(false);
    consumer_sleeping_.store(false);producer_waiting_.store(false);
    executed_batches_.store(0);execute_ns_.store(0);
    worker_=std::thread([this]{Run();});
    active_=true;
  }
  void Enqueue(const Command& command) {
    AssertOwner();assert(active_);
    if(written_+1-done_seen_>Capacity) {
      done_seen_=done_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
      if(written_+1-done_seen_>Capacity) {
        ++stats_.capacity_waits;const auto begin=Now();
        Publish();WaitDone(written_+1-Capacity);
        stats_.capacity_wait_ns+=Now()-begin;
        done_seen_=done_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
      }
    }
    commands_[written_%Capacity]=command;
    ++written_;++stats_.queued;
    if(written_-published_seen_>=Batch)Publish();
  }
  void Publish() {
    AssertOwner();
    if(!active_ || written_==published_seen_)return;
    // The consumer announces sleep before rechecking this cursor. SC orders
    // the cursor store before our sleeping load, so one side sees the other.
    published_.store(written_,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    published_seen_=written_;++stats_.publications;
    if(consumer_sleeping_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)) {
      ++stats_.wakes;std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);work_.notify_one();
    }
  }
  void Drain() {
    AssertOwner();
    if(!active_ || done_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)==written_)return;
    ++stats_.drains;const auto begin=Now();
    Publish();WaitDone(written_);
    stats_.drain_wait_ns+=Now()-begin;
    done_seen_=done_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  }
  void Stop() {
    if(!active_)return;
    AssertOwner();Drain();stop_.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    {std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);work_.notify_one();}
    worker_.join();active_=false;commands_.reset();
  }
  Stats ReadStats()const {
    AssertOwner();Stats result=stats_;
    result.executed=done_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    result.executed_batches=executed_batches_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    result.execute_ns=execute_ns_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return result;
  }
 private:
  static uint64_t Now() {
    return uint64_t(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
      std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
  }
  void AssertOwner()const {assert(!active_ || owner_==std::this_thread::get_id());}
  void WaitDone(uint64_t target) {
    if(done_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)>=target)return;
    std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
    producer_waiting_.store(true,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    progress_.wait(lock,[&]{return done_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)>=target;});
    producer_waiting_.store(false,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
  }
  void Run() {
    if(startup_)startup_();
    uint64_t tail=0;
    for(;;) {
      const uint64_t head=published_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
      if(tail<head) {
        const uint64_t end=std::min(head,tail+Batch);const auto begin=Now();
        for(;tail<end;++tail)execute_(commands_[tail%Capacity]);
        execute_ns_.fetch_add(Now()-begin,std::memory_order_relaxed);
        executed_batches_.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
        done_.store(tail,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
        if(producer_waiting_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)) {
          std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);progress_.notify_one();
        }
        continue;
      }
      std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
      consumer_sleeping_.store(true,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
      work_.wait(lock,[&]{return stop_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
                               published_.load(std::memory_order_seq_cst)>tail;});
      consumer_sleeping_.store(false,std::memory_order_seq_cst);
      if(stop_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && published_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)==tail)return;
    }
  }
  std::unique_ptr<Command[]> commands_;
  std::function<void(const Command&)> execute_;
  std::function<void()> startup_;
  std::thread worker_;
  std::thread::id owner_;
  bool active_=false;
  alignas(64) uint64_t written_=0,published_seen_=0,done_seen_=0;
  Stats stats_;
  alignas(64) std::atomic<uint64_t> published_{0};
  alignas(64) std::atomic<uint64_t> done_{0};
  alignas(64) std::atomic<uint64_t> executed_batches_{0},execute_ns_{0};
  std::atomic<bool> stop_{false},consumer_sleeping_{false},producer_waiting_{false};
  std::mutex mutex_;
  std::condition_variable work_,progress_;
};
} // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_binding_key_memo.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace cod6::native {

// The texture-binding hash is derived from up to 32 six-word fetch slots.  A
// dependency identity that has not changed produces exactly the same hash, so
// keep the already-computed value in a bounded direct-map table.  Hashing only
// chooses a slot: every field is compared before an answer is returned.
struct BindingKeyIdentity {
  uint64_t vs = 0;
  uint64_t ps = 0;
  uint64_t layout = 0;
  uint64_t used_fetch_generation = 0;
  uint32_t slot_mask = 0;

  bool operator==(const BindingKeyIdentity&) const = default;
};

template <size_t Capacity = 256>
class BindingKeyMemo {
 public:
  static_assert(Capacity && !(Capacity & (Capacity - 1)), "capacity must be a power of two");
  static constexpr size_t kCapacity = Capacity;

  // The object keeps a fixed maximum allocation so same-NRO A/B tests change
  // only the lookup mask, not allocator behavior or object lifetime. Invalid
  // runtime values fail closed to the original 256-slot table (or Capacity for
  // deliberately smaller host fixtures).
  explicit BindingKeyMemo(size_t active_capacity = Capacity)
      : active_capacity_(ValidCapacity(active_capacity) ? active_capacity
                                                        : FallbackCapacity()) {}

  bool Lookup(const BindingKeyIdentity& key, uint64_t& value) const {
    const Entry& entry = entries_[Slot(key)];
    if (!entry.valid || !(entry.key == key)) return false;
    value = entry.value;
    return true;
  }

  // Returns true when another valid identity occupied the selected slot.
  bool Store(const BindingKeyIdentity& key, uint64_t value) {
    Entry& entry = entries_[Slot(key)];
    const bool collision = entry.valid && !(entry.key == key);
    entry.key = key;
    entry.value = value;
    entry.valid = true;
    return collision;
  }

  size_t capacity() const { return active_capacity_; }
  static constexpr size_t Bytes() { return sizeof(BindingKeyMemo); }

 private:
  struct Entry {
    BindingKeyIdentity key;
    uint64_t value = 0;
    bool valid = false;
  };

  static uint64_t Mix(uint64_t value) {
    value += UINT64_C(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15);
    value = (value ^ (value >> 30)) * UINT64_C(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9);
    value = (value ^ (value >> 27)) * UINT64_C(0x94D049BB133111EB);
    return value ^ (value >> 31);
  }

  static constexpr size_t FallbackCapacity() {
    return Capacity >= 256 ? 256 : Capacity;
  }

  static constexpr bool ValidCapacity(size_t value) {
    return value && value <= Capacity && !(value & (value - 1));
  }

  size_t Slot(const BindingKeyIdentity& key) const {
    uint64_t hash = key.vs;
    const auto combine = [&hash](uint64_t value) {
      hash ^= value + UINT64_C(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) + (hash << 6) + (hash >> 2);
    };
    combine(key.ps);
    combine(key.layout);
    combine(key.used_fetch_generation);
    combine(key.slot_mask);
    return size_t(Mix(hash)) & (active_capacity_ - 1);
  }

  size_t active_capacity_ = FallbackCapacity();
  std::array<Entry, Capacity> entries_{};
};

}  // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_descriptor_writes.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#ifndef VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#endif
// Match rex/ui/vulkan/api.h even when this helper is included first. Defining
// beta extensions after vulkan_core.h was already parsed leaves Vulkan-Hpp
// referring to extension constants that were not declared by the C headers.
#ifndef VK_ENABLE_BETA_EXTENSIONS
#define VK_ENABLE_BETA_EXTENSIONS
#endif
// Only include core types here. The SDK API wrapper defines the platform
// surface macros before including vulkan.h; consuming that umbrella header
// here would prevent its later VI_NN declarations from being loaded.
#include <vulkan/vulkan_core.h>

namespace cod6::native {

// Consecutive-binding writes require identical stageFlags. The system, vertex,
// pixel, loop and fetch constant bindings do not all have the same visibility,
// so describe each binding separately (VUID-VkWriteDescriptorSet-descriptorCount-00317).
inline void MakeConstantDescriptorWrites(VkDescriptorSet set,
                                         const VkDescriptorBufferInfo* infos,
                                         uint32_t count, VkWriteDescriptorSet* writes) {
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
    writes[i] = {};
    writes[i].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
    writes[i].dstSet = set;
    writes[i].dstBinding = i;
    writes[i].descriptorCount = 1;
    writes[i].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC;
    writes[i].pBufferInfo = &infos[i];
  }
}

}  // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_diagnostic_buckets.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace cod6::native {

// Ring-thread only. Fixed storage keeps diagnostic logging out of draw calls.
template <size_t Capacity, size_t Words = 10>
class DiagnosticBuckets {
 public:
  static_assert(Capacity > 0);
  using Key = std::array<uint64_t, Words>;
  struct Entry { Key key{}; uint64_t count = 0; };

  void Record(const Key& key) {
    ++total_;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size_; ++i) {
      if (entries_[i].key == key) { ++entries_[i].count; return; }
    }
    if (size_ == Capacity) { ++omitted_; return; }
    entries_[size_++] = {key, 1};
  }
  const auto& entries() const { return entries_; }
  size_t size() const { return size_; }
  uint64_t total() const { return total_; }
  uint64_t omitted() const { return omitted_; }
  void Reset() { size_ = 0; total_ = omitted_ = 0; }

 private:
  std::array<Entry, Capacity> entries_{};
  size_t size_ = 0;
  uint64_t total_ = 0, omitted_ = 0;
};

}  // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_fetch_generations.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cstdint>

namespace cod6::native {

// Fetch constants are grouped in 32 six-word slots. A monotonically newer
// sequence is assigned to every written slot. The maximum sequence of the
// slots a shader uses changes if and only if one of those slots was written;
// writes to unrelated slots therefore do not invalidate texture-binding work.
class FetchGenerations {
 public:
  void Written(uint32_t mask) {
    if (!mask) return;
    const uint64_t generation = ++all_;
    while (mask) {
      const uint32_t slot = uint32_t(std::countr_zero(mask));
      mask &= mask - 1;
      slots_[slot] = generation;
    }
  }

  uint64_t all() const { return all_; }

  uint64_t ForMask(uint32_t mask) const {
    uint64_t generation = 1;
    while (mask) {
      const uint32_t slot = uint32_t(std::countr_zero(mask));
      mask &= mask - 1;
      if (slots_[slot] > generation) generation = slots_[slot];
    }
    return generation;
  }

 private:
  uint64_t all_ = 1;
  std::array<uint64_t, 32> slots_ = [] {
    std::array<uint64_t, 32> values{};
    values.fill(1);
    return values;
  }();
};

}  // namespace cod6::native
```
