      return 2;
    default:
      return 0;
  }
}

void ConvertBlock(Conversion conversion, xenos::Endian endian, uint8_t* out, const uint8_t* in,
                  uint32_t guest_bytes, uint32_t out_row_pitch) {
  switch (conversion) {
    case Conversion::kCopy:
      if (guest_bytes < 4 && endian != xenos::Endian::kNone) {
        // Smaller than the swap unit: CopySwapBlock swaps whole units and
        // copied nothing, leaving these texels as whatever the staging
        // memory held. Gather each byte from where the swap puts it; `in`
        // is at a guest_bytes-aligned offset from the 4 KB-aligned base.
        const uintptr_t x = SwapXor(endian);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < guest_bytes; ++i) {
          out[i] = *reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>((reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(in) + i) ^ x);
        }
      } else {
        texture_conversion::CopySwapBlock(endian, out, in, guest_bytes);
      }
      break;
    case Conversion::kSwapRB565: {
      uint16_t v;
      texture_conversion::CopySwapBlock(endian, &v, in, 2);
      v = uint16_t(((v & 0x1F) << 11) | (v & 0x7E0) | (v >> 11));
      std::memcpy(out, &v, 2);
    } break;
    case Conversion::kSwapRB1555: {
      uint16_t v;
      texture_conversion::CopySwapBlock(endian, &v, in, 2);
      v = uint16_t((v & 0x83E0) | ((v & 0x1F) << 10) | ((v >> 10) & 0x1F));
      std::memcpy(out, &v, 2);
    } break;
    case Conversion::kRGBA4ToBGRA4: {
      uint16_t v;
      texture_conversion::CopySwapBlock(endian, &v, in, 2);
      uint32_t r = v & 0xF, g = (v >> 4) & 0xF, b = (v >> 8) & 0xF, a = v >> 12;
      v = uint16_t((b << 12) | (g << 8) | (r << 4) | a);
      std::memcpy(out, &v, 2);
    } break;
    case Conversion::kR10G11B11ToRGBA16:
    case Conversion::kR11G11B10ToRGBA16: {
      uint32_t v;
      texture_conversion::CopySwapBlock(endian, &v, in, 4);
      uint32_t r, g, b;
      uint16_t o[4];
      if (conversion == Conversion::kR10G11B11ToRGBA16) {
        r = v & 0x3FF;
        g = (v >> 10) & 0x7FF;
        b = v >> 21;
        o[0] = uint16_t(r * 65535 / 0x3FF);
        o[1] = uint16_t(g * 65535 / 0x7FF);
        o[2] = uint16_t(b * 65535 / 0x7FF);
      } else {
        r = v & 0x7FF;
        g = (v >> 11) & 0x7FF;
        b = v >> 22;
        o[0] = uint16_t(r * 65535 / 0x7FF);
        o[1] = uint16_t(g * 65535 / 0x7FF);
        o[2] = uint16_t(b * 65535 / 0x3FF);
      }
      o[3] = 0xFFFF;
      std::memcpy(out, o, 8);
    } break;
    case Conversion::kCTX1:
      texture_conversion::ConvertTexelCTX1ToR8G8(endian, out, in, out_row_pitch);
      break;
    case Conversion::kDXT3A:
      texture_conversion::ConvertTexelDXT3AToDXT3(endian, out, in, 16);
      break;
    default:
      break;
  }
}

}  // namespace

// Host layout of one level: every layer tightly packed, rows in whole blocks.
struct LevelLayout {
  uint32_t width, height;       // texels
  uint32_t blocks_x, blocks_y;  // guest blocks
  uint32_t host_row_bytes;      // one row of host blocks or texels
  uint32_t host_rows;           // rows of host blocks or texels
  VkDeviceSize offset;          // of layer 0
  VkDeviceSize layer_bytes;
};

// Everything the untiling of one texture needs, so it can run on a worker.
struct UntileJob {
  LevelLayout levels[xenos::kTextureMaxMips];
  uint32_t level_count, layers, width, height;
  texture_util::TextureGuestLayout layout;
  TextureUploadSource source;
  uint8_t* staging;
  bool tiled, host_blocks;
  xenos::Endian endianness;
  xenos::TextureFormat format;
  Conversion conversion;
  uint32_t block_width, block_height, guest_bytes_per_block, bpb_log2, host_texel_bytes;
};

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_texture_same_frame, false, "COD6",
                    "Hipotesis sin confirmar (2026-11-03): reutilizar la respuesta de una "
                    "textura solo dentro del fotograma. Apagado por defecto hasta tener datos "
                    "del [dtab]: todavia no esta localizado el origen de las texturas que "
                    "cambian (UI, municion, armas, personajes).");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_generated_mips, false, "COD6",
    "Reconstruir la cadena de mip desde el nivel 0 cuando el invitado la dejo a cero (sus "
    "capas las escribe una copia por memexport que saltamos). Sin esto solo existe el nivel "
    "0 y las superficies muy reducidas hacen aliasing: las rejillas y el ruido de color que "
    "salen en las capturas de hardware de v303")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

/* COD6_V305_GENMIPS
 *
 * The game fills every mip level above 0 with a copy done by a memexport vertex
 * shader, and those draws are skipped (handover chapter 9.2), so the guest keeps
 * the chain allocated and full of zeros. That was papered over with
 * cod6_native_force_mip0 - every sample clamped to level 0 - and the hardware
 * captures of v303 show what that costs: the fine grid over the walls and the
 * coloured speckle on the floor are that aliasing, not a wrong texture.
 *
 * Here the chain is rebuilt from level 0: a 2x2 box average, re-compressed in
 * the same block format. Not bit for bit what the game would have written, but a
 * mipmap IS a 2x2 average. Only our own staging buffer is written, never guest
 * memory, and only when the guest left the levels empty.
 */
namespace {

inline void Unpack565(uint16_t c, uint8_t out[3]) {
  const uint32_t r = (c >> 11) & 0x1F, g = (c >> 5) & 0x3F, b = c & 0x1F;
  out[0] = uint8_t((r << 3) | (r >> 2));
  out[1] = uint8_t((g << 2) | (g >> 4));
  out[2] = uint8_t((b << 3) | (b >> 2));
}

inline uint16_t Pack565(const uint8_t c[3]) {
  return uint16_t(((c[0] >> 3) << 11) | ((c[1] >> 2) << 5) | (c[2] >> 3));
}

// One BC1 colour block to 16 RGBA texels; force_four is what DXT5's colour half
// always uses.
inline void DecodeBc1Colour(const uint8_t* block, bool force_four, uint8_t out[16][4]) {
  const uint16_t c0 = uint16_t(block[0] | (block[1] << 8));
  const uint16_t c1 = uint16_t(block[2] | (block[3] << 8));
  uint8_t pal[4][3];
  Unpack565(c0, pal[0]);
  Unpack565(c1, pal[1]);
  const bool four = force_four || c0 > c1;
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
    if (four) {
      pal[2][i] = uint8_t((2 * pal[0][i] + pal[1][i]) / 3);
      pal[3][i] = uint8_t((pal[0][i] + 2 * pal[1][i]) / 3);
    } else {
      pal[2][i] = uint8_t((pal[0][i] + pal[1][i]) / 2);
      pal[3][i] = 0;
    }
  }
  const uint32_t bits = uint32_t(block[4]) | (uint32_t(block[5]) << 8) |
                        (uint32_t(block[6]) << 16) | (uint32_t(block[7]) << 24);
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    const uint32_t idx = (bits >> (2 * i)) & 3;
    out[i][0] = pal[idx][0];
    out[i][1] = pal[idx][1];
    out[i][2] = pal[idx][2];
    out[i][3] = (!four && idx == 3) ? 0 : 255;
  }
}

inline void DecodeBc4Alpha(const uint8_t* block, uint8_t out[16]) {
  const uint8_t a0 = block[0], a1 = block[1];
  uint8_t pal[8];
  pal[0] = a0;
  pal[1] = a1;
  if (a0 > a1) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) pal[2 + i] = uint8_t(((6 - i) * a0 + (1 + i) * a1) / 7);
  } else {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) pal[2 + i] = uint8_t(((4 - i) * a0 + (1 + i) * a1) / 5);
    pal[6] = 0;
    pal[7] = 255;
  }
  uint64_t bits = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) bits |= uint64_t(block[2 + i]) << (8 * i);
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) out[i] = pal[(bits >> (3 * i)) & 7];
}

inline void EncodeBc1Colour(const uint8_t in[16][4], uint8_t* block) {
  // DXT1 carries one bit of alpha through the third entry being transparent,
  // which needs the three-colour mode (c0 <= c1). Encoded always in four-colour
  // mode, every leaf and every fence link becomes a solid rectangle, so the mode
  // follows the texels.
  bool punched = false;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) punched |= in[i][3] < 128;
  uint8_t lo[3] = {255, 255, 255}, hi[3] = {0, 0, 0};
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    if (punched && in[i][3] < 128) continue;  // the hole does not set the range
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
      lo[c] = std::min(lo[c], in[i][c]);
      hi[c] = std::max(hi[c], in[i][c]);
    }
  }
  uint16_t c0 = Pack565(hi), c1 = Pack565(lo);
  if (punched) {
    if (c0 > c1) std::swap(c0, c1);  // three-colour mode needs c0 <= c1
  } else if (c0 < c1) {
    std::swap(c0, c1);               // four-colour mode needs c0 > c1
  }
  uint8_t pal[4][3];
  Unpack565(c0, pal[0]);
  Unpack565(c1, pal[1]);
  if (punched) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) pal[2][i] = uint8_t((pal[0][i] + pal[1][i]) / 2);
    pal[3][0] = pal[3][1] = pal[3][2] = 0;
  } else {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
      pal[2][i] = uint8_t((2 * pal[0][i] + pal[1][i]) / 3);
      pal[3][i] = uint8_t((pal[0][i] + 2 * pal[1][i]) / 3);
    }
  }
  uint32_t bits = 0;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    if (punched && in[i][3] < 128) {
      bits |= uint32_t(3) << (2 * i);
      continue;
    }
    int best = 0;
    long best_distance = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < (punched ? 3 : 4); ++k) {
      long d = 0;
      for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
        const long e = long(in[i][c]) - long(pal[k][c]);
        d += e * e;
      }
      if (best_distance < 0 || d < best_distance) {
        best_distance = d;
        best = k;
      }
    }
    bits |= uint32_t(best) << (2 * i);
  }
  block[0] = uint8_t(c0 & 0xFF);
  block[1] = uint8_t(c0 >> 8);
  block[2] = uint8_t(c1 & 0xFF);
  block[3] = uint8_t(c1 >> 8);
  block[4] = uint8_t(bits & 0xFF);
  block[5] = uint8_t((bits >> 8) & 0xFF);
  block[6] = uint8_t((bits >> 16) & 0xFF);
  block[7] = uint8_t((bits >> 24) & 0xFF);
}

inline void EncodeBc4Alpha(const uint8_t in[16], uint8_t* block) {
  uint8_t lo = 255, hi = 0;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    lo = std::min(lo, in[i]);
    hi = std::max(hi, in[i]);
  }
  uint8_t pal[8];
  pal[0] = hi;
  pal[1] = (hi == lo) ? uint8_t(hi > 0 ? hi - 1 : 1) : lo;
  for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) pal[2 + i] = uint8_t(((6 - i) * pal[0] + (1 + i) * pal[1]) / 7);
  uint64_t bits = 0;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    int best = 0;
    int best_distance = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k) {
      const int v = int(in[i]), p = int(pal[k]);
      const int d = v > p ? v - p : p - v;
      if (best_distance < 0 || d < best_distance) {
        best_distance = d;
        best = k;
      }
    }
    bits |= uint64_t(best) << (3 * i);
  }
  block[0] = pal[0];
  block[1] = pal[1];
  for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) block[2 + i] = uint8_t((bits >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF);
}

enum class MipKind { kBc1, kBc3, kBc5, kRgba8 };

inline bool MipKindOf(xenos::TextureFormat format, bool host_blocks, uint32_t host_texel_bytes,
                      MipKind& kind) {
  if (host_blocks) {
    if (format == xenos::TextureFormat::k_DXT1) {
      kind = MipKind::kBc1;
      return true;
    }
    if (format == xenos::TextureFormat::k_DXT2_3 || format == xenos::TextureFormat::k_DXT4_5) {
      kind = MipKind::kBc3;
      return true;
    }
    if (format == xenos::TextureFormat::k_DXN) {
      kind = MipKind::kBc5;  // two channels, two BC4 blocks - the normal maps
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  if (host_texel_bytes != 4) return false;
  kind = MipKind::kRgba8;
  return true;
}

inline void DecodeMipLevel(const uint8_t* level, const LevelLayout& l, MipKind kind,
                           uint8_t* rgba) {
  if (kind == MipKind::kRgba8) {
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < l.height; ++y) {
      std::memcpy(rgba + size_t(y) * l.width * 4, level + size_t(y) * l.host_row_bytes,
                  size_t(l.width) * 4);
    }
    return;
  }
  const uint32_t block_bytes = kind == MipKind::kBc1 ? 8u : 16u;
  uint8_t texels[16][4];
  for (uint32_t by = 0; by < l.blocks_y; ++by) {
    for (uint32_t bx = 0; bx < l.blocks_x; ++bx) {
      const uint8_t* block = level + (size_t(by) * l.blocks_x + bx) * block_bytes;
      if (kind == MipKind::kBc1) {
        DecodeBc1Colour(block, false, texels);
      } else if (kind == MipKind::kBc5) {
        uint8_t x[16], y[16];
        DecodeBc4Alpha(block, x);
        DecodeBc4Alpha(block + 8, y);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
          texels[i][0] = x[i];
          texels[i][1] = y[i];
          texels[i][2] = 0;
          texels[i][3] = 255;
        }
      } else {
        uint8_t alpha[16];
        DecodeBc4Alpha(block, alpha);
        DecodeBc1Colour(block + 8, true, texels);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) texels[i][3] = alpha[i];
      }
      for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        const uint32_t x = bx * 4 + (i & 3), y = by * 4 + (i >> 2);
        if (x >= l.width || y >= l.height) continue;
        std::memcpy(rgba + (size_t(y) * l.width + x) * 4, texels[i], 4);
      }
    }
  }
}

inline void EncodeMipLevel(const uint8_t* rgba, const LevelLayout& l, MipKind kind,
                           uint8_t* level) {
  if (kind == MipKind::kRgba8) {
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < l.height; ++y) {
      std::memcpy(level + size_t(y) * l.host_row_bytes, rgba + size_t(y) * l.width * 4,
                  size_t(l.width) * 4);
    }
    return;
  }
  const uint32_t block_bytes = kind == MipKind::kBc1 ? 8u : 16u;
  uint8_t texels[16][4];
  uint8_t alpha[16];
  for (uint32_t by = 0; by < l.blocks_y; ++by) {
    for (uint32_t bx = 0; bx < l.blocks_x; ++bx) {
      for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        const uint32_t x = std::min(bx * 4 + (i & 3), l.width - 1);
        const uint32_t y = std::min(by * 4 + (i >> 2), l.height - 1);
        std::memcpy(texels[i], rgba + (size_t(y) * l.width + x) * 4, 4);
      }
      uint8_t* block = level + (size_t(by) * l.blocks_x + bx) * block_bytes;
      if (kind == MipKind::kBc1) {
        EncodeBc1Colour(texels, block);
      } else if (kind == MipKind::kBc5) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) alpha[i] = texels[i][0];
        EncodeBc4Alpha(alpha, block);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) alpha[i] = texels[i][1];
        EncodeBc4Alpha(alpha, block + 8);
      } else {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) alpha[i] = texels[i][3];
        EncodeBc4Alpha(alpha, block);
        EncodeBc1Colour(texels, block + 8);
      }
    }
  }
}

// Rebuilds levels 1.. from level 0 in the staging buffer. False when the layout
// is not one this can handle, or the guest brought real mips.
bool RebuildMipChain(uint8_t* staging, const LevelLayout* levels, uint32_t level_count,
                     uint32_t layers, xenos::TextureFormat format, bool host_blocks,
                     uint32_t host_texel_bytes, Conversion conversion) {
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_generated_mips)) return false;
  if (conversion != Conversion::kCopy || layers != 1 || level_count < 2) return false;
  MipKind kind;
  if (!MipKindOf(format, host_blocks, host_texel_bytes, kind)) return false;
  const LevelLayout& first = levels[1];
  const size_t probe = std::min<size_t>(size_t(first.layer_bytes), 4096);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < probe; ++i) {
    if (staging[first.offset + i]) return false;
  }
  if (levels[0].width < 2 || levels[0].height < 2) return false;

  std::vector<uint8_t> current(size_t(levels[0].width) * levels[0].height * 4);
  DecodeMipLevel(staging + levels[0].offset, levels[0], kind, current.data());
  uint32_t src_w = levels[0].width, src_h = levels[0].height;
  for (uint32_t level = 1; level < level_count; ++level) {
    const LevelLayout& dst = levels[level];
    std::vector<uint8_t> next(size_t(dst.width) * dst.height * 4);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < dst.height; ++y) {
      const uint32_t y0 = std::min(y * 2, src_h - 1), y1 = std::min(y * 2 + 1, src_h - 1);
      for (uint32_t x = 0; x < dst.width; ++x) {
        const uint32_t x0 = std::min(x * 2, src_w - 1), x1 = std::min(x * 2 + 1, src_w - 1);
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
          const uint32_t sum = uint32_t(current[(size_t(y0) * src_w + x0) * 4 + c]) +
                               uint32_t(current[(size_t(y0) * src_w + x1) * 4 + c]) +
                               uint32_t(current[(size_t(y1) * src_w + x0) * 4 + c]) +
                               uint32_t(current[(size_t(y1) * src_w + x1) * 4 + c]);
          next[(size_t(y) * dst.width + x) * 4 + c] = uint8_t(sum / 4);
        }
      }
    }
    EncodeMipLevel(next.data(), dst, kind, staging + dst.offset);
    current.swap(next);
    src_w = dst.width;
    src_h = dst.height;
  }
  return true;
}

}  // namespace

/* COD6_STAGEDUMP
 *
 * Vuelca a disco el staging YA DESENTRELAZADO que se va a subir a la GPU. Es
 * memoria nuestra (el trabajo de untiling acaba de escribirla), asi que leerla
 * no puede salirse de ninguna pagina mapeada: el volcado anterior leia memoria
 * del invitado y provocaba 300 fallos por segundo.
 *
 * Con esto se puede decodificar el DXT en el PC y ver si lo que subimos es una
 * imagen o basura. Antes se estaba mirando si el contenido "cambiaba", que no es
 * lo mismo que si es correcto.
 */
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_stagedump_count, 0, "COD6",
    "Volcar el staging desentrelazado de esta many texturas (0 = apagado). "
    "Escribe <dir>/sNN.bin junto a la cabecera en el nombre.")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_stagedump_skip, 0, "COD6",
    "Texturas DXT a saltar antes de empezar a volcar (para pasar la carga)")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_STRING(cod6_stagedump_dir, "/switch/cod6-nx", "COD6",
    "Directorio donde dejar los volcados de staging")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

namespace {
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_stagedumps{0};

/* COD6_V309_EVICT_SAFE
 *
 * A cheap fingerprint of the bytes a texture is uploaded from: 8 samples of
 * 64 bytes, spread over base and mips. Cheap enough to take on every upload,
 * and only ever compared against itself, so it does not need to agree with the
 * full content hash. Used to answer one question before an eviction: does the
 * guest still hold these bytes, or has the streamer put another image here?
 */
inline uint64_t SourceFingerprint(const uint8_t* base, uint32_t base_bytes,
                                  const uint8_t* mips, uint32_t mip_bytes) {
  uint64_t hash = XXH3_64bits_withSeed(&base_bytes, sizeof(base_bytes), 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull);
  constexpr uint32_t kSamples = 8, kSampleBytes = 64;
  for (int part = 0; part < 2; ++part) {
    const uint8_t* data = part ? mips : base;
    const uint32_t size = part ? mip_bytes : base_bytes;
    if (!data || !size) continue;
    if (size <= kSamples * kSampleBytes * 2) {
      hash = XXH3_64bits_withSeed(data, size, hash);
      continue;
    }
    const uint32_t step = (size - kSampleBytes) / (kSamples - 1);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < kSamples; ++i) {
      hash = XXH3_64bits_withSeed(data + size_t(i) * step, kSampleBytes, hash);
    }
  }
  return hash;
}

std::atomic<uint64_t> g_evictions_refused{0};
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_stale_resolve_skips{0};
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_generated_mips{0};
}

void RunUntile(const UntileJob& j) {
    const auto* levels = j.levels;
    const uint32_t level_count = j.level_count, layers = j.layers, width = j.width,
                   height = j.height;
    const texture_util::TextureGuestLayout& layout = j.layout;
    const uint8_t* base_data = j.source.base();
    const uint8_t* mip_data = j.source.mips();
    uint8_t* staging = j.staging;
    const bool host_blocks = j.host_blocks;
    const xenos::TextureFormat format = j.format;
    const uint32_t block_width = j.block_width, block_height = j.block_height,
                   guest_bytes_per_block = j.guest_bytes_per_block, bpb_log2 = j.bpb_log2,
                   host_texel_bytes = j.host_texel_bytes;
    for (uint32_t level = 0; level < level_count; ++level) {
      const LevelLayout& l = levels[level];
      // Which storage holds this level, and where in it.
      const uint8_t* level_source;
      const texture_util::TextureGuestLayout::Level* guest_level;
      bool is_packed = layout.packed_level != UINT32_MAX && level >= layout.packed_level;
      if (level == 0) {
        level_source = base_data;
        guest_level = &layout.base;
      } else {
        uint32_t stored = is_packed ? layout.packed_level : level;
        level_source = mip_data ? mip_data + layout.mip_offsets_bytes[stored] : nullptr;
        guest_level = &layout.mips[stored];
      }
      uint32_t offset_x_blocks = 0, offset_y_blocks = 0, offset_z = 0;
      if (is_packed) {
        texture_util::GetPackedMipOffset(width, height, 1, format, level, offset_x_blocks,
                                         offset_y_blocks, offset_z);
      }
      uint32_t row_pitch_bytes = guest_level->row_pitch_bytes;
      uint32_t pitch_blocks = row_pitch_bytes >> bpb_log2;
      // Tiled memory keeps aligned runs of blocks contiguous: 16 bytes, or 8
      // blocks of one byte. A plain copy moves a whole run per tiled-offset
      // computation instead of one block, 4 times fewer for 32-bit texels,
      // which was most of the time untiling a texture that changes every
      // frame. A run is 8 or 16 bytes at an offset aligned to its size, so it
      // is made of whole swap units and swapping it is swapping the memory
      // it came from, whatever the size of a texel.
      const uint32_t run_blocks = bpb_log2 == 0 ? 8 : (16u >> std::min(bpb_log2, 4u));
      const bool run_copy =
          j.tiled && j.conversion == Conversion::kCopy && run_blocks > 1 &&
          guest_bytes_per_block == (1u << bpb_log2) &&
          (host_blocks || block_width * host_texel_bytes == guest_bytes_per_block);
      for (uint32_t layer = 0; layer < layers; ++layer) {
        uint8_t* out = staging + l.offset + l.layer_bytes * layer;
        if (!level_source) {
          std::memset(out, 0, size_t(l.layer_bytes));
          continue;
        }
        const uint8_t* src = level_source + size_t(guest_level->array_slice_stride_bytes) * layer;
        for (uint32_t by = 0; by < l.blocks_y; ++by) {
          uint32_t gy = by + offset_y_blocks;
          uint8_t* out_row = out + size_t(by) * (host_blocks ? l.host_row_bytes
                                                             : l.host_row_bytes * block_height);
          // Linear: the row is contiguous, one copy (and swap) does it. The
          // video planes of the cutscenes (1280x720 and two 640x360, 8-bit,
          // every frame) took 15 ms a frame one texel at a time.
          if (!j.tiled && j.conversion == Conversion::kCopy &&
              (host_blocks || block_width * host_texel_bytes == guest_bytes_per_block)) {
            const size_t row_bytes = size_t(l.blocks_x) * guest_bytes_per_block;
            const uint8_t* src_row = src + size_t(gy) * row_pitch_bytes +
                                     size_t(offset_x_blocks) * guest_bytes_per_block;
            const uintptr_t start = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(src_row);
            if (j.endianness == xenos::Endian::kNone ||
                (!(start & 3) && !(row_bytes & 3))) {
              texture_conversion::CopySwapBlock(j.endianness, out_row, src_row, row_bytes);
              continue;
            }
          }
          for (uint32_t bx = 0; bx < l.blocks_x; ++bx) {
            uint32_t gx = bx + offset_x_blocks;
            if (run_copy && !(gx & (run_blocks - 1)) && bx + run_blocks <= l.blocks_x) {
              size_t run_offset = size_t(texture_util::GetTiledOffset2D(
                  int32_t(gx), int32_t(gy), pitch_blocks, bpb_log2));
              texture_conversion::CopySwapBlock(j.endianness,
                                                out_row + size_t(bx) * guest_bytes_per_block,
                                                src + run_offset,
                                                run_blocks * guest_bytes_per_block);
              bx += run_blocks - 1;
              continue;
            }
            size_t src_offset;
            if (j.tiled) {
              src_offset = size_t(texture_util::GetTiledOffset2D(int32_t(gx), int32_t(gy),
                                                                 pitch_blocks, bpb_log2));
            } else {
              src_offset = size_t(gy) * row_pitch_bytes + size_t(gx) * guest_bytes_per_block;
            }
            uint8_t* out_block;
            if (host_blocks) {
              out_block = out_row + size_t(bx) * guest_bytes_per_block;
            } else {
              out_block = out_row + size_t(bx) * block_width * host_texel_bytes;
            }
            ConvertBlock(j.conversion, j.endianness, out_block, src + src_offset,
                         guest_bytes_per_block, l.host_row_bytes);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  if (RebuildMipChain(staging, levels, level_count, layers, format, host_blocks,
                      host_texel_bytes, j.conversion)) {
    const uint32_t seen = g_generated_mips.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
    if (seen <= 8 || seen % 64 == 0) {
      REXLOG_INFO("[mips] rebuilt the chain: {} levels from {}x{}, format {} ({})",
                  level_count, width, height, uint32_t(format), seen);
    }
  }

  /* COD6_STAGEDUMP: dejar el resultado en disco para inspeccionarlo fuera. */
  {
    /* COD6_STAGEDUMP_V2
     *
     * El primer volcado se lleno con las texturas de video del video de carga
     * (format 2, 1280x720 y 640x360, sin tiled) y no dejo ver ni una textura
     * DXT del mundo, que es lo que interesa. Ahora solo se vuelcan los formatos
     * DXT (18, 19, 20, 49) de 256 o mas de ancho, y se saltan las primeras
     * cod6_stagedump_skip para pasar de la pantalla de carga.
     */
    const uint32_t limite = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_stagedump_count);
    const uint32_t fmt = unsigned(j.format);
    const bool es_dxt = (fmt == 18 || fmt == 19 || fmt == 20 || fmt == 49);
    if (limite && es_dxt && j.staging && j.level_count && j.width >= 256 &&
        j.width <= 2048 && j.height >= 256 && j.height <= 2048) {
      const uint32_t visto = g_stagedumps.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
      const uint32_t saltar = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_stagedump_skip);
      if (visto >= saltar && visto < saltar + limite) {
      const uint32_t n = visto - saltar;
        VkDeviceSize total = 0;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < j.level_count; ++k) {
          const VkDeviceSize fin = j.levels[k].offset + j.levels[k].layer_bytes * j.layers;
          if (fin > total) total = fin;
        }
        char nombre[160];
        std::snprintf(nombre, sizeof(nombre), "%s/s%02u_f%u_%ux%u_t%u_p%u.bin",
                      REXCVAR_GET(cod6_stagedump_dir).c_str(), unsigned(n),
                      unsigned(j.format), unsigned(j.width), unsigned(j.height),
                      j.tiled ? 1u : 0u, unsigned(j.level_count));
        FILE* f = std::fopen(nombre, "wb");
        if (f) {
          std::fwrite(j.staging, 1, size_t(total), f);
          std::fclose(f);
          REXLOG_INFO("[stagedump] {} {} bytes levels={} host_blocks={}",
                      nombre, unsigned(total), unsigned(j.level_count),
                      j.host_blocks ? 1 : 0);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// A texture created off the renderer thread: the image, and staging memory of
// its own with the untiled data, which a later submission copies in.
struct StreamJob {
  UntileJob untile;
  VkImageCreateInfo info = {};
  VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkBuffer staging_buffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDeviceMemory staging_memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDeviceSize staging_size = 0;
  VkDeviceSize memory_size = 0;  // cod5-nx: for the texture memory budget
  std::atomic<bool> done{false};
  bool ok = false;
};

/* COD6_V232_1D: tratar las texturas 1D como 2D de una fila. */
/* COD6_V237_MIP0: muestrear siempre el nivel 0 del mapa de mip.
 * El suelo y los impactos se ven bien y los modelos enteros salen revueltos:
 * eso es lo que pasa cuando solo el nivel 0 es correcto y el muestreo baja de
 * nivel al alejarse. COD4 expone lo mismo como nfsmw_nativo_mipmaps.
 * Se deja a false por defecto: activarlo cuesta aliasing. */
/* COD6_WAITUPLOAD
 *
 * Cada fotograma, al final, se llamaba a textures.WaitForUploads(): drena los
 * trabajos de desentramado pendientes (haciendolos en el propio hilo del anillo
 * si hace falta) y espera a que no quede ninguno antes de grabar el setup y
 * enviar. Es una barrera dura por fotograma: mientras se espera, la GPU se queda
 * sin trabajo.
 *
 * El motivo de la espera es que el comando de copia staging->imagen se graba en
 * el setup DESPUES, y el hilo de subida esta escribiendo ese staging. Si la GPU
 * llega a la copia antes de que el desentramado acabe, lee basura.
 *
 * Ponerlo a false quita la barrera y deja que la copia y el desentramado se
 * solapen. RIESGO: si la GPU va por delante, las texturas recien transmitidas
 * pueden verse mal (parpadeo, basura) durante un fotograma. Por eso el valor por
 * defecto sigue siendo true; es un experimento.
 */
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_wait_uploads, true, "COD5",
                    "Wait for pending texture untiling before submitting the frame (false overlaps "
                    "upload with GPU but newly streamed textures may show garbage for a frame)");

/* COD6_EMPTYREASONS
 *
 * El resumen decia "64 lookups answered empty (streaming or not handled)" pero no
 * decia POR QUE. Sin eso no se puede saber si las texturas que faltan en el HUD
 * (municion, subtitulos) son culpa de un formato no soportado, de un fetch que no
 * es textura, o de que no hay paginas.
 *
 * Estos contadores separan los motivos. Se vuelcan en la misma linea del resumen.
 */
namespace {
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_vacio_no_textura{0};   // fetch.type != kTexture (normal)
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_vacio_sin_paginas{0};  // ni base_page ni mip_page
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_vacio_imagen{0};       // fallo creando imagen o view
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_vacio_streaming{0};    // en transmision, sin sustituto
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_vacio_formato{0};      // formato/tamano no soportado
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_vacio_otro{0};         // rango fuera de memoria, cubo, etc.
}  // namespace

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_force_mip0, false, "COD5",
                    "Native renderer: sample mip 0 only, for every texture (costs aliasing)");

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_1d_textures, true, "COD5",
                    "Native renderer: handle 1D fetch constants (256x1 lookup tables) "
                    "as one-row 2D textures instead of returning a null view")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_volume_copy_plan, true, "COD5",
                    "Convert CPU volumes using exact precomputed adjacent byte runs; "
                    "false keeps per-texel tiled addressing with the same owned snapshot")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_dynamic_texture_changes, 4, "COD5",
                      "Native renderer: textures whose data changed this many times are hashed in full every frame "
                      "(per-frame CPU data such as model lighting); 0 = sampled like the rest");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_full_texture_hash, false, "COD5",
                    "Native renderer diagnostics: hash all texture and vertex data in full every frame");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_scoped_resolve_answers, false, "COD5",
                    "Candidate: retain bindings across proven disjoint resolve changes; "
                    "all other answer invalidations keep the original full rebuild")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_texture_evict_frames, 600, "COD6",
    "Fotogramas sin usar una textura antes de expulsarla. Un valor enorme la "
    "mantiene siempre (con el presupuesto a 0 no se expulsa ninguna)")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_texture_budget_mb, 768, "COD5",
                      "Native renderer: GPU memory for textures before the least recently used are freed (0 = no "
                      "limit)");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_layout_extents, true, "COD5",
                    "Cache immutable texture layout extents; preserve guest content checks and build full layouts on upload")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_max_anisotropy, 4, "COD5",
                      "Most anisotropic filtering any texture gets (1 turns it off); the "
                      "game asks for it on floors, where it costs the GPU the most");

// New textures made on the spot each frame, up to this many: drawn the first
// time, not a frame or more later. Beyond it they stream in, so a new screen
// loading hundreds at once does not stall a frame on their allocations (each
// a kernel round trip). Streaming everything flickered: a texture missing for
// a frame shows as a flash of the empty texture on characters.
// Kept small: six of up to 512 KB each made a level load (a thousand new
// textures) cost 37 ms of renderer time per frame.
constexpr uint32_t kSyncCreatesPerFrame = 2;
constexpr VkDeviceSize kSyncCreateMaxBytes = 32 * 1024;
constexpr VkDeviceSize kSyncCreateLargeBytes = 256 * 1024;   // cod5-nx
constexpr VkDeviceSize kSyncCreateBudgetBytes = 1536 * 1024;  // cod5-nx, per frame
constexpr VkDeviceSize kSyncCreateBurstBytes = 6 * 1024 * 1024;  // cod5-nx, per frame with a backlog
constexpr size_t kSyncBacklogJobs = 24;                         // cod5-nx

// New textures with at least this much host data stream in asynchronously.
// Nearly all of them: the cost that hitched was not the data but creating the
// image (memory allocation and GPU mapping are each a kernel round trip), and
// that is the same for a small texture as for a big one.
// Every one beyond the per-frame budget, however small: under 1 KB they were
// all made on the spot, and a level load made 116 in one frame (180 ms).
/* COD6_STREAM_TUNE
 *
 * kStreamBytes era 0: total >= 0 siempre cierto, asi que TODO lo que no entraba
 * en el presupuesto sincrono se creaba en el hilo de streaming. Una textura
 * creada asi contesta "vacio" en los fotogramas siguientes y la superficie sale
 * sin textura.
 *
 * Medido: "[texture-empty] streaming" crecia sin parar durante la partida
 * (0 -> 19 -> 411 -> 483 -> 635 -> 732 -> 789) y las texturas subidas por
 * fotograma pasaban de 41 a 570, muy por encima del presupuesto sincrono
 * (2 texturas y 1.5 MB por fotograma). Eso es exactamente "la primera impresion
 * es buena y empeora cuanto mas rato se juega".
 *
 * Ahora los tres limites son cvars: subirlos hace que las texturas se creen
 * antes de dibujarlas (cuesta tirones) en vez de faltar durante fotogramas.
 */
constexpr VkDeviceSize kStreamBytes = 0;
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_stream_bytes, 0, "COD6",
    "Tamano a partir del cual una textura nueva se crea en el hilo de streaming. "
    "0 = como antes (casi todas asincronas). Un valor enorme las crea todas al momento.")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_sync_creates_per_frame, 2, "COD6",
    "Texturas pequenas creadas de forma sincrona por fotograma")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_sync_budget_kb, 1536, "COD6",
    "KB de texturas nuevas creadas de forma sincrona por fotograma")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod6_native_sync_max_kb, 32, "COD6",
    "Tamano maximo de una textura para contar en sync_creates_per_frame")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

struct TextureCache::Texture {
  VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkFormat format_unorm = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
  VkFormat format_snorm = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
  xenos::DataDimension dimension = xenos::DataDimension::k2DOrStacked;
  uint32_t host_format_swizzle = kSwizzleRGBA;
  // Views by (host swizzle << 1 | signed).
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, VkImageView> views;
  uint64_t last_used_frame = 0;
  // Submission that last sampled it: the image can be rewritten in place only
  // before the first use in a submission, since uploads run ahead of it.
  uint64_t last_used_submission = 0;
  uint64_t key_hash = 0;
  uint64_t content_hash = 0;
  // Still being created by the streaming worker.
  std::shared_ptr<StreamJob> stream;
  uint32_t level_count = 0;
  uint32_t layers = 0;
  VkDeviceSize memory_size = 0;  // cod5-nx: 0 when not known (not counted in the budget)
  // cod5-nx: its guest memory was written by a copy the renderer knows about (InvalidateRange): memoized lookups of
  // it go through the full path once, which checks the data and clears this.
  bool invalidated = false;
};

/* COD6_TEXMON
 *
 * Contadores para localizar por que se vuelven a subir texturas. NO leen memoria
 * del invitado (el volcado anterior se salio de las paginas mapeadas y provoco
 * 300 fallos por segundo): solo cuentan lo que ya pasa por el cache.
 *
 * Que responde cada uno:
 *   - stamp_hits / stamp_misses: si la marca de escritura esta sirviendo.
 *   - stamp_mismatch: la marca dijo "sin cambios" y el contenido si cambio
 *     (hay escritores sin marcar; con esto se sabe si la cobertura alcanza).
 *   - hash_changed / hash_unchanged: cuantos hash completos dicen que cambio.
 *   - uploads por direccion: si la MISMA direccion se sube una y otra vez, el
 *     detector la ve cambiar aunque no cambie.
 */
struct TexMon {
  static constexpr uint32_t kMax = 40;
  uint64_t addresses[kMax] = {};
  uint32_t uploads[kMax] = {};
  uint32_t count = 0;
  uint64_t stamp_hits = 0, stamp_misses = 0, stamp_mismatch = 0;
  uint64_t hash_changed = 0, hash_unchanged = 0;
  uint64_t uploaded_total = 0;

  void NoteUpload(uint64_t addr) {
    ++uploaded_total;
    uint32_t slot = count;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {
      if (addresses[k] == addr) { slot = k; break; }
    }
    if (slot == count) {
      if (count == kMax) return;
      addresses[count] = addr;
      uploads[count] = 0;
      ++count;
    }
    ++uploads[slot];
  }
  void Report() {
    REXLOG_INFO("[texmon] subidas={} marcas: aciertos {} fallos {} desacuerdos {}; "
                "hash: {} cambio, {} igual",
                uploaded_total, stamp_hits, stamp_misses, stamp_mismatch, hash_changed,
                hash_unchanged);
    // Top 12 direcciones por numero de subidas.
    uint32_t order[kMax];
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) order[k] = k;
    for (uint32_t a = 0; a < count; ++a) {
      for (uint32_t b = a + 1; b < count; ++b) {
        if (uploads[order[b]] > uploads[order[a]]) {
          const uint32_t t = order[a];
          order[a] = order[b];
          order[b] = t;
        }
      }
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < count && k < 12; ++k) {
      const uint32_t i = order[k];
      if (uploads[i] < 3) break;
      REXLOG_INFO("[texmon]   {:08X} subida {} veces", addresses[i], uploads[i]);
    }
    // Se reinicia cada informe para leer la tendencia por intervalos.
    count = 0;
    stamp_hits = stamp_misses = stamp_mismatch = 0;
    hash_changed = hash_unchanged = 0;
    uploaded_total = 0;
  }
};

struct TextureCache::Impl {
  const VulkanDevice* device = nullptr;
  rex::memory::Memory* memory = nullptr;

  // Layout key hash -> texture. When the content changes, the image is
  // uploaded again in place: allocating a new image each time was a kernel
  // round trip (memory map) per changed texture, about 50 a second in play.
  std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::unique_ptr<Texture>> textures;
  // Layout key hash -> content hash of the last check, per frame, so the data
  // of a texture used by many draws is hashed once per frame.
  struct Checked {
    uint64_t frame = UINT64_MAX;
    uint64_t texture_hash = 0;
    // COD6_V309_EVICT_SAFE: a fingerprint of the guest bytes this was uploaded
    // from, and whether they have since been overwritten by someone else.
    uint64_t source_fingerprint = 0;
    bool source_lost = false;
    ChangeDetector base;
    ChangeDetector mips;
    // COD6_TEX_STAMPS: serial de marcas de escritura del ultimo hash completo.
    uint64_t stamp_serial = 0;
    bool dynamic_logged = false;
  };
  uint32_t dynamic_logged = 0;
  FlatMap64<Checked> checked;
  TexMon texmon;
  using LayoutMemo = LayoutExtents<TextureLayoutKey>;
  static_assert(sizeof(LayoutMemo) <= 64 * 1024);
  std::unique_ptr<LayoutMemo> layout_extents;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  bool layout_diagnostics = false;
  uint64_t layout_queries = 0, layout_hits = 0, layout_builds = 0;
  ChangeDetectorStats change_stats;
  // checked layouts, memoized answers, view ids.
  FlatMapClearStats flat_clear_stats[3];
#endif
  // cod5-nx: the guest memory each texture layout reads (base and mips), so a CPU write the renderer knows about
  // (COD5's GPU memcpy, done on the CPU) can make the textures over it check their data on the next use.
  struct GuestRanges {
    uint32_t base = 0, base_bytes = 0, mips = 0, mip_bytes = 0;
  };
  std::unordered_map<uint64_t, GuestRanges> guest_ranges;
  // The same, indexed by 64 KB page: an invalidation looks only at the textures on its pages. Scanning every layout
  // ever seen (tens of thousands) for each of the streamer's ~40 copies a frame was millions of comparisons a frame,
  // the bulk of the ring thread on the console.
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<uint64_t>> guest_pages;
  // Once an index entry is dropped, cached answers may keep its texture from
  // registering again. Stay conservative for this cache's lifetime rather
  // than treating a partially repopulated index as complete.
  bool guest_ranges_complete = true;
  void AddGuestRanges(uint64_t key, const GuestRanges& r) {
    if (!guest_ranges_complete) return;
    auto [it, inserted] = guest_ranges.try_emplace(key, r);
    if (!inserted) {
      if (it->second.base == r.base && it->second.base_bytes == r.base_bytes && it->second.mips == r.mips &&
          it->second.mip_bytes == r.mip_bytes) {
        return;
      }
      it->second = r;
    }
    auto add = [&](uint32_t start, uint32_t bytes) {
      if (!bytes) return;
      for (uint32_t page = start >> 16; page <= (start + bytes - 1) >> 16; ++page) guest_pages[page].push_back(key);
    };
    add(r.base, r.base_bytes);
    add(r.mips, r.mip_bytes);
    if (guest_ranges.size() > 65536) {
      guest_ranges.clear();
      guest_pages.clear();
      guest_ranges_complete = false;
      REXLOG_WARN("[native] texture range index exceeded 65536 layouts; using conservative write invalidation for this cache lifetime");
    }
  }
  // cod5-nx: uncompressed 3D textures from guest memory (project8-sw's cache never needed them; COD5 samples a
  // 512x256x4 k_8_8_8_8 volume that read as zero, apparently its ambient lighting, so shadowed areas came out black).
  struct Volume3D {
    VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, VkImageView> views;
    VolumeUploadState sync;
    VolumeCopyPlan copy_plan;
    uint64_t last_used_frame = 0;
  };
  std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Volume3D> volumes3d;
  // cod5-nx: the last ready texture for each (mips address, format, size, dimension). COD5's streamer gives a texture a
  // new top level at a new address and keeps its mips: the renderer sees a new texture, which was drawn black for the
  // frame or two it took to build (a flicker at 10 FPS). Meanwhile its predecessor stands in.
  std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint64_t> placeholders;
  struct UploadStat {
    uint32_t address = 0, format = 0, width = 0, height = 0, count = 0;
    uint64_t bytes = 0, last_hash = 0;
  };
  std::unordered_map<uint64_t, UploadStat> upload_stats;
  void CountUpload(uint64_t key_hash, uint32_t address, uint32_t format, uint32_t width,
                   uint32_t height, uint64_t bytes, uint64_t content_hash) {
    if (upload_stats.size() > 4096) return;
    UploadStat& u = upload_stats[key_hash];
    u.address = address;
    u.format = format;
    u.width = width;
    u.height = height;
    ++u.count;
    u.bytes += bytes;
    u.last_hash = content_hash;
  }
  std::unordered_set<uint32_t> depth_words_wanted;

  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::unique_ptr<ResolveDestination>> resolve_destinations;
  // cod5-nx: an address can hold a depth resolve (R32_SFLOAT, keyed by the address) and a color one (keyed with
  // kColorTag) at once. COD5 resolves its shadow depth and then its color grading table to the same address every
  // frame; with one image per address both were destroyed and recreated twice a frame (8 MB each: what ran NVK out
  // of memory after a few minutes) and the table's volume never survived to be sampled. Lookups for sampling take
  // the kind written last.
  static constexpr uint32_t kColorTag = 2;
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, bool> last_resolve_color;
  uint32_t SampleKey(uint32_t address) const {
    if (address & 3) return address;
    auto it = last_resolve_color.find(address);
    return it != last_resolve_color.end() && it->second ? (address | kColorTag) : address;
  }
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::unique_ptr<ResolveDestination::Volume>> volumes;

  // This frame's answers by the raw fetch constant, so a texture bound by many
  // draws is looked up once: the layout computation and the hashing are then
  // skipped for the rest of the frame.
  struct Memo {
    uint64_t frame;
    VkImageView view;
    Texture* texture;
    // Reused through this frame: the content checks would not look at the
    // texture's data before then (see ChangeDetector::TrustedUntil).
    uint64_t valid_until;
  };
  // Set by GetViewUncached for the memo.
  uint64_t last_valid_until = 0;
  // What the last GetView answered from (last_texture(), last_valid_until()).
  Texture* out_texture = nullptr;
  uint64_t out_valid_until = 0;
  uint32_t sync_creates_left = 0;
  VkDeviceSize sync_create_bytes_left = 0;
  VkDeviceSize sync_create_large_limit = 0;
  FlatMap64<Memo> memo;
  uint64_t memo_frame = UINT64_MAX;
  // The texture GetViewUncached returned a view of (null for resolve
  // destinations and null views).
  Texture* last_texture = nullptr;

  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, VkSampler> samplers;

  VkImage null_images[3] = {};
  VkDeviceMemory null_memory[3] = {};
  VkImageView null_views[3] = {};  // 2D array, cube, 3D

  // Destroyed once the frame that last used them is complete.
  struct Retired {
    uint64_t frame;
    VkImage image;
    VkDeviceMemory memory;
    std::vector<VkImageView> views;
  };
  std::vector<Retired> retired;

  uint64_t frame = 0;
  uint64_t completed_frame = 0;
  float max_anisotropy = 1.0f;

  std::vector<uint8_t> scratch;

  // Upload worker: untiles into staging while the ring keeps recording.
  std::thread upload_thread;
  std::mutex upload_mutex;
  std::condition_variable upload_cv;
  std::condition_variable upload_done_cv;
  std::deque<std::function<void()>> upload_jobs;
  uint32_t upload_running = 0;
  bool upload_stop = false;

  void EnqueueUpload(std::function<void()> job) {
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(upload_mutex);
      upload_jobs.push_back(std::move(job));
    }
    upload_cv.notify_one();
  }

  void UploadThread() {
#if defined(__SWITCH__)
    /* COD6_COREMASK: el hilo de subida no tenia mascara de nucleo. Se le da el 3
     * (mascara 0x8) para que no compita con el juego (0/1) ni con la grabacion (2/3). */
    svcSetThreadPriority(CUR_THREAD_HANDLE, 0x3B);
    svcSetThreadCoreMask(CUR_THREAD_HANDLE, 3, 0x8);
#endif
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(upload_mutex);
    while (true) {
      upload_cv.wait(lock, [&] { return upload_stop || !upload_jobs.empty(); });
      if (upload_jobs.empty() && upload_stop) {
        return;
      }
      std::function<void()> job = std::move(upload_jobs.front());
      upload_jobs.pop_front();
      ++upload_running;
      lock.unlock();
      job();
      lock.lock();
      --upload_running;
      if (upload_jobs.empty() && !upload_running) {
        upload_done_cv.notify_all();
      }
    }
  }

  // Streaming worker: creates large new textures and fills their staging.
  // Two of them, just below the game's threads in priority. Above them, a
  // cutscene loading a thousand textures had both take cores from the game,
  // which stalled; one alone at the lowest priority could leave a new screen
  // drawn with the empty texture for seconds.
  std::thread stream_threads[2];
  std::mutex stream_mutex;
  std::condition_variable stream_cv;
  std::deque<std::shared_ptr<StreamJob>> stream_jobs;
  bool stream_stop = false;

  void StreamThread() {
#if defined(__SWITCH__)
    svcSetThreadPriority(CUR_THREAD_HANDLE, 0x3C);
#endif
    while (true) {
      std::shared_ptr<StreamJob> job;
      {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(stream_mutex);
        stream_cv.wait(lock, [&] { return stream_stop || !stream_jobs.empty(); });
        if (stream_stop) return;
        job = stream_jobs.front();
        stream_jobs.pop_front();
      }
      job->ok = CreateTextureImage(job->info, job->image, job->memory, &job->memory_size);
      if (job->ok) {
        job->ok = rex::ui::vulkan::util::CreateDedicatedAllocationBuffer(
            device, job->staging_size, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT,
            rex::ui::vulkan::util::MemoryPurpose::kUpload, job->staging_buffer,
            job->staging_memory);
      }
      void* mapping = nullptr;
      if (job->ok && device->functions().vkMapMemory(device->device(), job->staging_memory, 0,
                                                     VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &mapping) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        job->ok = false;
      }
      if (job->ok) {
        job->untile.staging = static_cast<uint8_t*>(mapping);
        RunUntile(job->untile);
      }
      job->untile.source.Release();
      job->done.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
  }

  void DestroyStreamJob(StreamJob& job) {
    const auto& dfn = device->functions();
    VkDevice d = device->device();
    if (job.staging_buffer) dfn.vkDestroyBuffer(d, job.staging_buffer, nullptr);
    if (job.staging_memory) dfn.vkFreeMemory(d, job.staging_memory, nullptr);
    job.staging_buffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    job.staging_memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  }

  struct RetiredStaging {
    uint64_t frame;
    std::shared_ptr<StreamJob> job;
  };
  std::vector<RetiredStaging> retired_staging;

  // The caller runs queued jobs itself rather than sleeping: it is waiting
  // for them anyway, and the worker shares its cores with the game's threads,
  // so it can sit preempted while the renderer waits on it.
  void WaitForUploads() {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(upload_mutex);
    while (!upload_jobs.empty()) {
      std::function<void()> job = std::move(upload_jobs.front());
      upload_jobs.pop_front();
      ++upload_running;
      lock.unlock();
      job();
      lock.lock();
      --upload_running;
    }
    upload_done_cv.wait(lock, [&] { return upload_jobs.empty() && !upload_running; });
  }

  void Retire(VkImage image, VkDeviceMemory memory, std::vector<VkImageView> views,
              uint64_t last_used) {
    retired.push_back({last_used, image, memory, std::move(views)});
  }

  uint64_t views_epoch = 0;

  // Destruction of what the GPU no longer uses, on a thread of its own: each
  // freed image is a kernel round trip (unmapping and freeing), and doing them
  // at the frame boundary on the ring thread showed as bursts of lost time.
  std::thread reap_thread;
  std::mutex reap_mutex;
  std::condition_variable reap_cv;
  std::deque<std::function<void()>> reap_jobs;
  bool reap_stop = false;

  void ReapThread() {
#if defined(__SWITCH__)
    svcSetThreadPriority(CUR_THREAD_HANDLE, 0x3D);
#endif
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(reap_mutex);
    while (true) {
      reap_cv.wait(lock, [&] { return reap_stop || !reap_jobs.empty(); });
      if (reap_jobs.empty() && reap_stop) return;
      auto job = std::move(reap_jobs.front());
      reap_jobs.pop_front();
      lock.unlock();
      job();
      lock.lock();
    }
  }

  void Reap(std::function<void()> job) {
    if (!reap_thread.joinable()) {
      job();
      return;
    }
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reap_mutex);
      reap_jobs.push_back(std::move(job));
    }
    reap_cv.notify_one();
  }

  // Open addressing (std::unordered_map lookups were 4% of the ring thread);
  // a destroyed view's id is zeroed rather than erased, and a reused handle
  // then gets a new one.
  FlatMap64<uint64_t> view_ids;
  TextureCache::ComputeCopy compute_copy;
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, bool> storage_capable;
  // Bumped whenever the memo is dropped: an answer for some fetch changed.
  uint64_t answers_epoch = 1;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  uint64_t resolve_fanout_generation = 1;
#endif
  bool scoped_resolve_answers = false;
  ResolveAnswerJournal resolve_answer_journal;
  uint64_t next_view_id = 1;
  void ForgetViews(const std::vector<VkImageView>& views) {
    for (VkImageView v : views) {
      if (uint64_t* id = view_ids.find(uint64_t(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(v)))) *id = 0;
    }
  }

  // cod5-nx: textures sub-allocated from large blocks (texture_pool.h): a dedicated allocation per texture cost
  // ~8 ms of the ring thread each on the console (COD5 made ~3 a frame in play: 20-30 ms per frame). The streaming
  // worker creates images too, hence the lock. A pooled image has no VkDeviceMemory of its own; its block goes back
  // to the pool when the image is destroyed, which happens only after the GPU finished the frames that used it.
  TexturePool pool;
  std::mutex pool_mutex;
  std::unordered_map<VkImage, uint32_t> pooled_images;
  bool CreateTextureImage(const VkImageCreateInfo& info, VkImage& image, VkDeviceMemory& memory,
                          VkDeviceSize* size_out) {
    image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    const auto& dfn = device->functions();
    VkDevice d = device->device();
    if (pool.Active() && dfn.vkCreateImage(d, &info, nullptr, &image) == VK_SUCCESS) {
      VkMemoryRequirements requirements = {};
      dfn.vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(d, image, &requirements);
      VkDeviceMemory block_memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      VkDeviceSize offset = 0;
      uint32_t block = kInvalidPoolBlock;
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(pool_mutex);
      if (pool.Reserve(requirements, block_memory, offset, block)) {
        if (dfn.vkBindImageMemory(d, image, block_memory, offset) == VK_SUCCESS) {
          pooled_images[image] = block;
          if (size_out) *size_out = requirements.size;
          return true;
        }
        pool.Release(block);
      }
      pool.NoteDedicated();
      dfn.vkDestroyImage(d, image, nullptr);
      image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    return rex::ui::vulkan::util::CreateDedicatedAllocationImage(
        device, info, rex::ui::vulkan::util::MemoryPurpose::kDeviceLocal, image, memory, nullptr, size_out);
  }
  void DestroyImage(VkImage image, VkDeviceMemory memory) {
    // Detach the old allocation before destroying the handle. A streaming
    // worker can immediately receive that same VkImage value from the driver;
    // looking it up after destruction could release the NEW image's block.
    uint32_t block = kInvalidPoolBlock;
    if (image && !memory) {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(pool_mutex);
      auto it = pooled_images.find(image);
      if (it != pooled_images.end()) {
        block = it->second;
        pooled_images.erase(it);
      }
    }
    const auto& dfn = device->functions();
    VkDevice d = device->device();
    if (image) dfn.vkDestroyImage(d, image, nullptr);
    if (memory) dfn.vkFreeMemory(d, memory, nullptr);
    if (block != kInvalidPoolBlock) {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(pool_mutex);
      pool.Release(block);
    }
  }

  void DestroyLater(VkImage image, VkDeviceMemory memory, std::vector<VkImageView> views) {
    if (!views.empty()) {
      // Now, not when the reaper gets to it: before a handle can be reused.
      ++views_epoch;
      ForgetViews(views);
    }
    Reap([this, image, memory, views = std::move(views)]() {
      const auto& dfn = device->functions();
      VkDevice d = device->device();
      for (VkImageView v : views) dfn.vkDestroyImageView(d, v, nullptr);
      DestroyImage(image, memory);
    });
  }

  void DestroyNow(VkImage image, VkDeviceMemory memory, const std::vector<VkImageView>& views) {
    if (!views.empty()) {
      ++views_epoch;
      ForgetViews(views);
    }
    const auto& dfn = device->functions();
    VkDevice d = device->device();
    for (VkImageView v : views) {
      dfn.vkDestroyImageView(d, v, nullptr);
    }
    DestroyImage(image, memory);
  }
};

TextureCache::TextureCache() : impl_(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
TextureCache::~TextureCache() { Shutdown(); }

void TextureCache::WaitForUploads() {
  /* COD6_WAITUPLOAD: la barrera por fotograma se puede quitar para que la subida
   * se solape con la GPU. Ver la nota del cvar. */
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_wait_uploads)) {
    return;
  }
  impl_->WaitForUploads();
}

bool TextureCache::Initialize(const VulkanDevice* device, rex::memory::Memory* memory) {
  Impl& im = *impl_;
  im.upload_thread = std::thread([&im]() { im.UploadThread(); });
  for (std::thread& thread : im.stream_threads) {
    thread = std::thread([&im]() { im.StreamThread(); });
  }
  im.reap_thread = std::thread([&im]() { im.ReapThread(); });
  im.device = device;
  im.memory = memory;
  if (REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_layout_extents)) im.layout_extents = std::make_unique<Impl::LayoutMemo>();
  else im.layout_extents.reset();
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  im.layout_diagnostics = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_diagnostics);
  im.layout_queries = im.layout_hits = im.layout_builds = 0;
  im.change_stats = {};
  for (auto& clear : im.flat_clear_stats) clear = {};
  if (im.layout_diagnostics)
    REXLOG_INFO("[texture-layout] schema=1 enabled={} capacity=1024 bytes={} point=GetViewUncached content_checks=unchanged",
                bool(im.layout_extents), im.layout_extents ? sizeof(Impl::LayoutMemo) : 0);
#endif
  im.scoped_resolve_answers = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_scoped_resolve_answers);
  if constexpr (cod6::diagnostics::kEnabled) {
    REXLOG_INFO("[native-diag] scoped resolve answers: enabled={} journal_capacity={}; "
                "CanReuseAnswers requires complete disjoint GetResolveDestination history",
                im.scoped_resolve_answers, ResolveAnswerJournal::kCapacity);
  }
  im.pool.Init(device, int32_t(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_texture_budget_mb)));
  ChangeDetector::dynamic_changes = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_dynamic_texture_changes);
  ChangeDetector::always_full = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_full_texture_hash);
  /* COD6_WRITES_LATE
   *
   * Configure() se llamaba solo desde SetupGuestGpu, que corre ANTES de que se
   * cargue el toml: leia el valor por defecto (false) y g_enabled se quedaba
   * apagado aunque cod6_native_vertex_by_writes fuera true en el archivo.
   * Sintoma en el registro: "[writes] vertex hashes false" con true en el toml,
   * y ni una linea de texmon contando marcas.
   *
   * La inicializacion del cache de texturas si ocurre despues de leer la
   * configuracion, asi que aqui el valor es el bueno.
   */
  cod6::writes::Configure();
  im.max_anisotropy =
      device->properties().samplerAnisotropy
          ? std::min({16.0f, device->properties().maxSamplerAnisotropy,
                      float(std::max(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_max_anisotropy), 1u))})
          : 1.0f;

  const auto& dfn = device->functions();
  VkDevice d = device->device();
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
    VkImageCreateInfo info = {};
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    info.imageType = i == 2 ? VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D : VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    info.flags = i == 1 ? VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT : 0;
    info.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    info.extent = {1, 1, 1};
    info.mipLevels = 1;
    info.arrayLayers = i == 1 ? 6 : 1;
    info.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    info.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    info.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    info.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    if (!rex::ui::vulkan::util::CreateDedicatedAllocationImage(
            device, info, rex::ui::vulkan::util::MemoryPurpose::kDeviceLocal, im.null_images[i],
            im.null_memory[i])) {
      REXLOG_ERROR("[native] Could not create the null textures");
      return false;
    }
    VkImageViewCreateInfo view = {};
    view.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
    view.image = im.null_images[i];
    view.viewType = i == 0 ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY
                           : (i == 1 ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D);
    view.format = info.format;
    view.subresourceRange = rex::ui::vulkan::util::InitializeSubresourceRange();
    if (dfn.vkCreateImageView(d, &view, nullptr, &im.null_views[i]) != VK_SUCCESS) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

void TextureCache::InitializeNullImages(VkCommandBuffer commands) {
  Impl& im = *impl_;
  const auto& dfn = im.device->functions();
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier barrier = {};
    barrier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
    barrier.srcAccessMask = 0;
    barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    barrier.image = im.null_images[i];
    barrier.subresourceRange = rex::ui::vulkan::util::InitializeSubresourceRange();
    dfn.vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT,
                             VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1,
                             &barrier);
    VkClearColorValue black = {};
    VkImageSubresourceRange range = rex::ui::vulkan::util::InitializeSubresourceRange();
    dfn.vkCmdClearColorImage(commands, im.null_images[i], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL,
                             &black, 1, &range);
    barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL;
    dfn.vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT |
                                 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT,
                             0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &barrier);
  }
}

void TextureCache::Shutdown() {
  if (!impl_ || !impl_->device) {
    return;
  }
  Impl& im = *impl_;
  if (im.upload_thread.joinable()) {
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(im.upload_mutex);
      im.upload_stop = true;
    }
    im.upload_cv.notify_all();
    im.upload_thread.join();
  }
  {
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(im.stream_mutex);
      im.stream_stop = true;
    }
    im.stream_cv.notify_all();
    for (std::thread& thread : im.stream_threads) {
      if (thread.joinable()) thread.join();
    }
  }
  if (im.reap_thread.joinable()) {
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(im.reap_mutex);
      im.reap_stop = true;
    }
    im.reap_cv.notify_all();
    im.reap_thread.join();  // runs what is still queued first
  }
  for (auto& retired : im.retired_staging) {
    im.DestroyStreamJob(*retired.job);
  }
  im.retired_staging.clear();
  const auto& dfn = im.device->functions();
  VkDevice d = im.device->device();
  for (auto& r : im.retired) {
    im.DestroyNow(r.image, r.memory, r.views);
  }
  im.retired.clear();
  for (auto& [hash, texture] : im.textures) {
    std::vector<VkImageView> views;
    for (auto& [k, v] : texture->views) views.push_back(v);
    if (texture->stream) {
      // Never finished: the job owns the image.
      im.DestroyStreamJob(*texture->stream);
      im.DestroyNow(texture->stream->image, texture->stream->memory, views);
      continue;
    }
    im.DestroyNow(texture->image, texture->memory, views);
  }
  im.textures.clear();
  for (auto& [address, dest] : im.resolve_destinations) {
    std::vector<VkImageView> views;
    if (dest->view) views.push_back(dest->view);
    for (auto& [k, v] : dest->texture_views) views.push_back(v);
    im.DestroyNow(dest->image, dest->memory, views);
    for (auto& sized : dest->sized) {
      std::vector<VkImageView> sized_views;
      for (auto& [k, v] : sized->views) sized_views.push_back(v);
      im.DestroyNow(sized->image, sized->memory, sized_views);
    }
  }
  im.resolve_destinations.clear();
  for (auto& [address, volume] : im.volumes) {
    std::vector<VkImageView> volume_views;
    for (auto& [k, v] : volume->views) volume_views.push_back(v);
    im.DestroyNow(volume->image, volume->memory, volume_views);
  }
  im.volumes.clear();
  for (auto& [k, volume] : im.volumes3d) {
    std::vector<VkImageView> views;
    for (auto& [s2, view] : volume.views) views.push_back(view);
    im.DestroyNow(volume.image, volume.memory, views);
  }
  im.volumes3d.clear();
  // Every pooled image is destroyed by now (textures, at shutdown, are destroyed right away).
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(im.pool_mutex);
    im.pooled_images.clear();
    im.pool.Shutdown();
  }
  for (auto& [k, s] : im.samplers) {
    dfn.vkDestroySampler(d, s, nullptr);
  }
  im.samplers.clear();
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
    im.DestroyNow(im.null_images[i], im.null_memory[i],
                  im.null_views[i] ? std::vector<VkImageView>{im.null_views[i]}
                                   : std::vector<VkImageView>{});
    im.null_images[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    im.null_memory[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    im.null_views[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  }
  im.device = nullptr;
}

void TextureCache::BeginFrame(uint64_t frame, uint64_t completed_frame) {
  Impl& im = *impl_;
  /* COD6_WRITES_AT_FRAME
   *
   * Las marcas de escritura por pagina de 4 KB no se usaban nunca. En cada
   * arranque el registro decia:
   *   [writes] vertex hashes false, verify-only true
   * con cod6_native_vertex_by_writes = true en el toml, y despues:
   *   [texmon] ... marcas: aciertos 0 fallos 0
   * o sea, ni una sola comprobacion por marcas.
   *
   * La causa: Configure() se llamaba desde SetupGuestGpu y desde el arranque de
   * esta cache, las dos veces antes de que se leyera el toml, asi que leia el
   * valor por defecto (false).
   *
   * Aqui es el primer fotograma de verdad: el toml ya esta aplicado, el registro
   * ya funciona y no estamos en la ruta caliente de ninguna consulta de textura
   * (en v299 se llamaba desde Enabled(), dentro de esa ruta, y el juego no
   * llegaba a cargar el nivel).
   */
  {
    static bool writes_configured = false;
    if (!writes_configured) {
      writes_configured = true;
      cod6::writes::Configure();
    }
  }
  im.frame = frame;
  im.completed_frame = completed_frame;
  if (frame % 300 == 0) im.texmon.Report();
  im.sync_creates_left = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_sync_creates_per_frame);
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(im.pool_mutex);
    im.pool.PerFrame(frame);
    if (frame % 600 == 0 && im.pool.Active()) REXLOG_INFO("[native] {}", im.pool.Summary());
  }
  // cod5-nx: with a backlog (a map just started: hundreds of new textures, drawn black until they arrive), a larger
  // budget: a few slower frames, but the textures appear in about a second instead of several at 10 FPS.
  size_t backlog = 0;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(im.stream_mutex);
    backlog = im.stream_jobs.size();
  }
  im.sync_create_bytes_left =
      VkDeviceSize(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_sync_budget_kb)) * 1024u *
      (backlog >= kSyncBacklogJobs ? 4u : 1u);
  im.sync_create_large_limit = backlog >= kSyncBacklogJobs ? (2u << 20) : kSyncCreateLargeBytes;
  // Destroy what the GPU no longer uses.
  auto it = std::remove_if(im.retired.begin(), im.retired.end(), [&](Impl::Retired& r) {
    if (r.frame > completed_frame) {
      return false;
    }
    im.DestroyLater(r.image, r.memory, std::move(r.views));
    return true;
  });
  im.retired.erase(it, im.retired.end());
  for (auto r = im.retired_staging.begin(); r != im.retired_staging.end();) {
    if (r->frame <= completed_frame) {
      std::shared_ptr<StreamJob> job = r->job;
      im.Reap([&im, job]() { im.DestroyStreamJob(*job); });
      r = im.retired_staging.erase(r);
    } else {
      ++r;
    }
  }
  /* COD6_EVICT_TUNE
   *
   * La expulsion por edad borraba texturas cada 600 fotogramas (~20 s a 30 fps).
   * Medido: el numero de texturas vivas oscilaba 519 -> 56 -> 436 -> 331 sin que
   * el presupuesto expulsara NADA ("0 freed by the budget"), o sea que todas esas
   * muertes venian de aqui.
   *
   * Cada expulsion hace im.memo.clear() y ++answers_epoch: si un buffer de
   * comandos ya grabado sigue apuntando al VkImageView de la textura retirada, la
   * GPU lee memoria liberada y la superficie sale con otra textura o con basura.
   * Eso encaja con "al principio bien, cuanto mas rato peor".
   *
   * Ahora el umbral es un cvar. Un valor enorme la desactiva (con el presupuesto a
   * 0 no se expulsa ninguna textura y se puede comprobar si el desgaste para).
   */
  /* COD6_V308_EVICT_FLOOR
   *
   * Measured on v307: the live texture count fell to zero and the whole
   * level's textures were rebuilt in one interval (9 8 15 8 19 320 329 0 19 42
   * 484 334 created per 10 s). Every rebuild re-reads guest memory that the
   * streamer has since reused, so surfaces come back with other textures' data -
   * "good at first, worse and worse" - and ~480 untilings and uploads in one
   * interval is the periodic freeze.
   *
   * The age pass below is what wipes it, and it is driven by a cvar that lives in
   * this module: the one the handover (chapter 7, item 7) records as reading its
   * toml values into the pending table and never applying them. A zero there
   * means "evict everything not used in this very frame".
   *
   * So the threshold cannot go below 600 frames any more, and whatever value is
   * in force is printed: if toml and runtime ever disagree again, the log says so.
   */
  /* COD6_V309_EVICT_SAFE: only evict what can be rebuilt correctly. */
  auto source_recoverable = [&im](uint64_t key) {
    Impl::Checked* c = im.checked.find(key);
    if (!c) return false;
    if (c->source_lost) return false;
    const auto r = im.guest_ranges.find(key);
    if (r == im.guest_ranges.end()) return false;
    const auto& ranges = r->second;
    const uint8_t* base = ranges.base_bytes
                             ? im.memory->TranslatePhysical<const uint8_t*>(ranges.base)
                             : nullptr;
    const uint8_t* mips = ranges.mip_bytes
                             ? im.memory->TranslatePhysical<const uint8_t*>(ranges.mips)
                             : nullptr;
    if ((ranges.base_bytes && !base) || (ranges.mip_bytes && !mips)) return false;
    const uint64_t now = SourceFingerprint(base, ranges.base_bytes, mips, ranges.mip_bytes);
    if (now == c->source_fingerprint) return true;
    // The bytes are someone else's now: destroying this texture would lose it
    // for good. Keep it, and do not look at it again.
    c->source_lost = true;
    g_evictions_refused.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return false;
  };
  const uint64_t evict_frames_cvar = REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_texture_evict_frames);
  const uint64_t kEvictFrames = std::max<uint64_t>(evict_frames_cvar, 600);
  if (frame % 60 == 0) {
    // cod5-nx: frames are not time at 5-10 fps (600 frames was two minutes in COD5's Kino der Toten), and a map
    // streams far more textures than that holds: GPU memory ran out after a few minutes (NVK "VA bind ... failed:
    // 0x235C", then no new images at all). Over the budget, the least recently used textures go first, never one
    // used in the last 4 frames.
    const uint64_t budget = uint64_t(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_texture_budget_mb)) << 20;
    bool texture_answers_changed = false;
    uint64_t total = 0;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
    const bool measure_eviction = im.layout_diagnostics;
    const uint64_t scan_start = measure_eviction ? NowNsTextures() : 0;
    if (measure_eviction) {
      ++stats_.eviction_checks;
      stats_.eviction_entries_scanned += im.textures.size();
    }
#endif
    for (const auto& [key, texture] : im.textures) total += texture->memory_size;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
    if (measure_eviction) stats_.eviction_scan_ns += NowNsTextures() - scan_start;
#endif
    stats_.texture_memory_bytes = total;
    if (budget && total > budget) {
      std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> by_age;  // (last used frame, key)
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
      const uint64_t candidate_start = measure_eviction ? NowNsTextures() : 0;
      if (measure_eviction) ++stats_.eviction_over_budget;
#endif
      for (const auto& [key, texture] : im.textures) {
        if (!texture->stream && texture->memory_size && texture->last_used_frame + 4 < frame) {
          by_age.emplace_back(texture->last_used_frame, key);
        }
      }
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
      if (measure_eviction) {
        stats_.eviction_eligible += by_age.size();
        stats_.eviction_candidate_ns += NowNsTextures() - candidate_start;
      }
      const uint64_t sort_start = measure_eviction ? NowNsTextures() : 0;
#endif
      std::sort(by_age.begin(), by_age.end());
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
      if (measure_eviction) {
        stats_.eviction_sorted += by_age.size();
        stats_.eviction_sort_ns += NowNsTextures() - sort_start;
      }
      const uint64_t release_start = measure_eviction ? NowNsTextures() : 0;
#endif
      bool evicted_any = false;
      for (const auto& [used, key] : by_age) {
        if (total <= budget * 7 / 8) break;
        auto t = im.textures.find(key);
        if (t == im.textures.end()) continue;
        if (!source_recoverable(key)) continue;
        Texture& texture = *t->second;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
        if (measure_eviction) stats_.budget_evicted_bytes += texture.memory_size;
#endif
        total -= texture.memory_size;
        std::vector<VkImageView> views;
        for (auto& [k, v] : texture.views) views.push_back(v);
        im.Retire(texture.image, texture.memory, std::move(views), texture.last_used_frame);
        im.textures.erase(t);
        texture_answers_changed = true;
        ++stats_.budget_evictions;
        evicted_any = true;
      }
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
      if (measure_eviction) stats_.eviction_release_ns += NowNsTextures() - release_start;
#endif
      /* COD6_V309_EVICT_SAFE fallback: every candidate was refused because its
       * guest bytes no longer hold it. Memory still has to come down, so what is
       * left is thrown away too - knowing it cannot be rebuilt - and said out
       * loud, because that is the corruption path coming back by necessity. */
      if (!evicted_any && total > budget + budget / 4) {
        uint32_t forced = 0;
        for (const auto& [used, key] : by_age) {
          if (total <= budget) break;
          auto t = im.textures.find(key);
          if (t == im.textures.end()) continue;
          Texture& texture = *t->second;
          total -= texture.memory_size;
          std::vector<VkImageView> views;
          for (auto& [k, v] : texture.views) views.push_back(v);
          im.Retire(texture.image, texture.memory, std::move(views), texture.last_used_frame);
          im.textures.erase(t);
          texture_answers_changed = true;
          ++stats_.budget_evictions;
          ++forced;
          if (forced >= 64) break;
        }
        REXLOG_ERROR("[evict] sin candidatos reconstruibles: se expulsaron {} texturas que NO se "
                     "pueden reconstruir (su memoria del invitado ya tiene otra imagen)",
                     forced);
      }
    }
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
    const uint64_t age_scan_start = measure_eviction ? NowNsTextures() : 0;
#endif
    for (auto t = im.textures.begin(); t != im.textures.end();) {
      Texture& texture = *t->second;
      if (texture.stream) {
        ++t;
        continue;
      }
      if (texture.last_used_frame + kEvictFrames < frame && source_recoverable(t->first)) {
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
        if (measure_eviction) {
          ++stats_.age_evictions;
          stats_.age_evicted_bytes += texture.memory_size;
        }
#endif
        std::vector<VkImageView> views;
        for (auto& [k, v] : texture.views) views.push_back(v);
        im.Retire(texture.image, texture.memory, std::move(views), texture.last_used_frame);
        t = im.textures.erase(t);
        texture_answers_changed = true;
      } else {
        ++t;
      }
    }
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
    if (measure_eviction) {
      stats_.eviction_age_scan_ns += NowNsTextures() - age_scan_start;
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(im.pool_mutex);
      const TexturePoolState pool = im.pool.State();
      stats_.pool_dedicated = pool.texturas_dedicadas;
      stats_.pool_no_fit = pool.huecos_fallados;
      stats_.pool_slabs_failed = pool.slabs_fallados;
    }
#endif
    if (frame % 600 == 0) {
      {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> pool_lock(im.pool_mutex);
        const TexturePoolIntegrity integrity = im.pool.VerifyIntegrity();
        if (integrity.checked && !integrity.ok) {
          REXLOG_ERROR("[pool] INCONSISTENTE: bloque {} unidad {}: el mapa dice {} y lo "
                       "registrado dice {} - dos imagenes pueden estar compartiendo "
                       "memoria",
                       integrity.slab, integrity.unit, integrity.marked, integrity.recorded);
        }
      }
      REXLOG_INFO("[evict] frame {}: {} texturas vivas; umbral {} fotogramas (cvar {}, "
                  "presupuesto {} MB, {} MB en uso, {} expulsadas, {} NO expulsadas: su "
                  "memoria del invitado ya tiene otra imagen)",
                  frame, im.textures.size(), kEvictFrames, evict_frames_cvar,
                  REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_texture_budget_mb), stats_.texture_memory_bytes >> 20,
                  stats_.budget_evictions,
                  g_evictions_refused.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));
    }
    if (texture_answers_changed) {
      // Retired Vulkan views may outlive the deleted Texture owner. Drop all
      // memo pointers and invalidate outer bindings before another lookup.
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
      ClearFlatMapMeasured(im.memo, im.layout_diagnostics, im.flat_clear_stats[1]);
#else
      im.memo.clear();
#endif
      ++im.answers_epoch;
    }
    if (im.checked.size() > 16384) {
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
      ClearFlatMapMeasured(im.checked, im.layout_diagnostics, im.flat_clear_stats[0]);
#else
      im.checked.clear();
#endif
    }
  }
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  const ChangeDetectorStats& change = im.change_stats;
  stats_.change_paths[0] = change.trusted_skips;
  stats_.change_paths[1] = change.sample_checks;
  stats_.change_paths[2] = change.sample_hits;
  stats_.change_paths[3] = change.full_checks;
  stats_.change_paths[4] = change.full_initial;
  stats_.change_paths[5] = change.full_unchanged;
  stats_.change_paths[6] = change.full_changed;
  stats_.change_paths[7] = change.sample_input_bytes;
  stats_.change_paths[8] = change.full_input_bytes;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
    stats_.flat_clear_count[i] = im.flat_clear_stats[i].clears;
    stats_.flat_clear_entries[i] = im.flat_clear_stats[i].entries;
    stats_.flat_clear_capacity[i] = im.flat_clear_stats[i].capacity;
    stats_.flat_clear_ns[i] = im.flat_clear_stats[i].ns;
  }
#endif
  stats_.live_textures = im.textures.size();
}

VkImageView TextureCache::GetResolveDestinationView2D(uint32_t address, uint32_t guest_swizzle,
                                                      uint32_t* width_out, uint32_t* height_out) {
  Impl& im = *impl_;
  auto it = im.resolve_destinations.find(im.SampleKey(address));
  if (it == im.resolve_destinations.end()) {
    return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  }
  ResolveDestination& dest = *it->second;
  *width_out = dest.width;
