```cpp
  bool mip_base_map = mip == xenos::TextureFilter::kBaseMap;
  xenos::BorderColor border = xenos::ClampModeUsesBorder(clamp_x) ||
                                      xenos::ClampModeUsesBorder(clamp_y) ||
                                      xenos::ClampModeUsesBorder(clamp_z)
                                  ? fetch.border_color
                                  : xenos::BorderColor::k_ABGR_Black;
  if (aniso != xenos::AnisoFilter::kDisabled) {
    mag_linear = min_linear = mip_linear = true;
  }
  uint32_t key = uint32_t(clamp_x) | (uint32_t(clamp_y) << 3) | (uint32_t(clamp_z) << 6) |
                 (uint32_t(border) << 9) | (uint32_t(mag_linear) << 11) |
                 (uint32_t(min_linear) << 12) | (uint32_t(mip_linear) << 13) |
                 (uint32_t(aniso) << 14) | (mip_min_level << 17) | (uint32_t(mip_base_map) << 21);
  auto it = im.samplers.find(key);
  if (it != im.samplers.end()) {
    return it->second;
  }
  static const VkSamplerAddressMode kAddressModes[] = {
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT,
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRRORED_REPEAT,
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRROR_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRROR_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_BORDER,
      VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRROR_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
  };
  VkSamplerCreateInfo info = {};
  info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO;
  info.magFilter = mag_linear ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
  info.minFilter = min_linear ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
  info.mipmapMode = mip_linear ? VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_LINEAR : VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
  info.addressModeU = kAddressModes[uint32_t(clamp_x) & 7];
  info.addressModeV = kAddressModes[uint32_t(clamp_y) & 7];
  info.addressModeW = kAddressModes[uint32_t(clamp_z) & 7];
  if (aniso != xenos::AnisoFilter::kDisabled && im.max_anisotropy > 1.0f) {
    info.anisotropyEnable = VK_TRUE;
    info.maxAnisotropy = std::min(
        im.max_anisotropy,
        float(1u << (uint32_t(aniso) - uint32_t(xenos::AnisoFilter::kMax_1_1))));
  }
  /* COD6_V310_MIP0_REAL
   *
   * This used to leave minLod at the guest's mip_min_level and set
   * maxLod = minLod + 0.25, so "force level 0" actually forced the level the
   * fetch constant asked for. With every level above 0 zero in this port (the
   * game fills them with a memexport copy the renderer skips), a decal, a
   * particle or any texture whose fetch sets a minimum level sampled zeros -
   * which is what a muzzle flash turning into a dark or garbage square looks
   * like. Forcing level 0 now really means the whole LOD range is level 0.
   */
  const bool v237_mip0 = mip_base_map || REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_force_mip0);
  if (v237_mip0) {
    info.minLod = 0.0f;
    info.maxLod = 0.25f;
    // Keep the guest's minimum level out of the cache key's meaning only when it
    // is used; when forcing, every texture shares the same range.
    info.minLod = 0.0f;
  } else {
    info.minLod = float(mip_min_level);
    info.maxLod = VK_LOD_CLAMP_NONE;
  }
  info.borderColor = border == xenos::BorderColor::k_ABGR_White
                         ? VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_OPAQUE_WHITE
                         : (border == xenos::BorderColor::k_ABGR_Black
                                ? VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_TRANSPARENT_BLACK
                                : VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_OPAQUE_BLACK);
  VkSampler sampler = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (im.device->functions().vkCreateSampler(im.device->device(), &info, nullptr, &sampler) !=
      VK_SUCCESS) {
    return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  }
  im.samplers.emplace(key, sampler);
  return sampler;
}

}  // namespace cod6::native


namespace cod6::native {
/* COD6_EMPTYREASONS_OUT: acceso a los contadores desde el resumen. */
uint64_t rex_vacio_no_textura() { return g_vacio_no_textura.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
uint64_t rex_vacio_sin_paginas() { return g_vacio_sin_paginas.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
uint64_t rex_vacio_imagen() { return g_vacio_imagen.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
uint64_t rex_vacio_streaming() { return g_vacio_streaming.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
uint64_t rex_vacio_otro() { return g_vacio_otro.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
}  // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_textures.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
//
// Textures for the native renderer (see native_renderer.h).
//
// Guest textures are untiled and converted on the CPU into a staging buffer and
// copied into an image by the setup command buffer, which runs before the draws
// of its submission. An image is identified by its fetch-constant layout and a
// hash of its guest data, so a texture whose memory changes becomes a different
// image, and an image never changes while a submission may be reading it: that
// is what lets every upload be hoisted out of the draw command buffer, which
// then never has to break a render pass to upload.
//
// Resolve destinations are images the renderer copies render targets into.
// They are registered by guest address, and a texture fetched from that address
// uses them instead of the guest memory, which the native renderer never writes.
//
// The formats, the view swizzles and the sampler parameters follow ReXGlue's
// VulkanTextureCache (itself from Xenia, BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSES/), which is
// what the translated shaders are written against.

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "cod6_diagnostics.h"

#include <rex/graphics/pipeline/shader/spirv.h>
#include <rex/graphics/xenos.h>
#include <rex/ui/vulkan/device.h>

namespace rex::memory {
class Memory;
}

namespace cod6::native {

#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
struct TextureUploadReportRecord {
  uint32_t address = 0, format = 0, width = 0, height = 0, count = 0;
  uint64_t bytes = 0, last_hash = 0;
};

struct TextureUploadReportSnapshot {
  static constexpr size_t kCapacity = 4097;
  TextureUploadReportRecord records[kCapacity] = {};
  size_t count = 0;
  bool layout_diagnostics = false;
  bool layout_extents = false;
  uint64_t layout_queries = 0, layout_hits = 0, layout_builds = 0;
};
#endif

// Where the texture cache puts upload data and records the copies.
struct UploadTarget {
  // Returns a CPU pointer for `size` bytes aligned to `alignment`, and their
  // offset in `buffer`. Null if the arena is exhausted.
  std::function<uint8_t*(size_t size, size_t alignment, VkDeviceSize& offset_out)> allocate;
  VkBuffer buffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  // Records into the command buffer that runs before the submission's draws.
  VkCommandBuffer setup_commands = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  // The submission being recorded (increasing).
  uint64_t submission = 0;
};

// An image a resolve writes into. Owned by the texture cache.
struct ResolveDestination {
  uint32_t address = 0;
  uint32_t width = 0;
  uint32_t height = 0;
  VkFormat format = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
  VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  // Plain 2D view, for presenting.
  VkImageView view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  // Guest components (XYZW, as a texture fetch sees the resolved memory) in
  // terms of the host components (xenos swizzle encoding, 3 bits each).
  uint32_t host_swizzle = 0;
  // Views as textures (2D arrays), by host swizzle; bit 31 set for plain 2D.
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, VkImageView> texture_views;
  uint64_t last_written_frame = 0;
  // Copies of the top-left corner at the sizes the game samples this address
  // as, where that differs from the image. Texture coordinates span the whole
  // image, so sampling the image itself scaled the content: the blur the game
  // makes from a 264x152 resolve into a 320-wide destination came back 1.2
  // times too small, a ghost of the skater up and to the left with a halo.
  // Refreshed by every resolve here (CopyToSized).
  struct Sized {
    uint32_t width = 0;
    uint32_t height = 0;
    VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, VkImageView> views;
    // Plain 2D view for the compute copy into it (null: copied by transfer).
    VkImageView storage_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    bool filled = false;
  };
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Sized>> sized;
  // cod5-nx: the image as a 3D texture, its slices stacked vertically in the resolved image (COD5 resolves its
  // 32x32x32 color grading table as a 32x1024 surface and samples it as a volume). Kept by address in the texture
  // cache (it outlives replaced destinations); refilled by every resolve of the same format there.
  struct Volume {
    uint32_t width = 0;
    uint32_t height = 0;
    uint32_t depth = 0;
    VkFormat format = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, VkImageView> views;
    bool filled = false;
    // Copy regions from the resolved image, from the guest tiling of both: on the console the 2D resolve and the
    // 3D fetch address the same bytes (COD5's table maps in 16x8 blocks, scrambled). Empty: slices stacked.
    std::vector<VkImageCopy> regions;
  };
};

struct TextureCacheStats {
  uint64_t uploads = 0;
  uint64_t created = 0;
  uint64_t streamed = 0;
  uint64_t upload_bytes = 0;
  uint64_t hash_bytes = 0;
  uint64_t unsupported = 0;
  uint64_t resolved_hits = 0;
  uint64_t resolve_swizzle_changes = 0; // test-only increments; existing images with changed channel mapping
  uint64_t resolve_answer_checks = 0, resolve_answer_reuses = 0, resolve_answer_fallbacks = 0;
  uint64_t live_textures = 0;
  uint64_t texture_memory_bytes = 0;  // cod5-nx: counted textures, refreshed every 60 frames
  uint64_t budget_evictions = 0;      // cod5-nx: textures freed by the memory budget
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  // Record-only evidence for the existing 60-frame budget/age eviction pass.
  // These counters never choose or suppress an eviction.
  uint64_t eviction_checks = 0, eviction_over_budget = 0;
  uint64_t eviction_entries_scanned = 0, eviction_eligible = 0, eviction_sorted = 0;
  uint64_t budget_evicted_bytes = 0, age_evictions = 0, age_evicted_bytes = 0;
  uint64_t eviction_scan_ns = 0, eviction_candidate_ns = 0, eviction_sort_ns = 0;
  uint64_t eviction_release_ns = 0, eviction_age_scan_ns = 0;
  uint64_t pool_dedicated = 0, pool_no_fit = 0, pool_slabs_failed = 0;
  // ChangeDetector path mix: trusted skip, sample check/hit, full check,
  // initial/unchanged/changed, sampled input bytes and full input bytes.
  uint64_t change_paths[9] = {};
  // FlatMap clear evidence for checked layouts, memoized answers and view ids.
  uint64_t flat_clear_count[3] = {};
  uint64_t flat_clear_entries[3] = {};
  uint64_t flat_clear_capacity[3] = {};
  uint64_t flat_clear_ns[3] = {};
#endif
  uint64_t placeholders = 0;          // cod5-nx: lookups answered with a predecessor while building
  uint64_t hash_ns = 0;               // cod5-nx: time hashing guest texture data
  uint64_t create_ns = 0;             // cod5-nx: time creating images on the ring thread
  uint64_t creates_on_ring = 0;       // cod5-nx
  uint64_t source_snapshot_ns = 0;
  uint64_t source_snapshot_bytes = 0;
  uint64_t source_snapshot_jobs = 0;
  uint64_t volume_uploads=0,volume_bytes=0,volume_conversion_ns=0,volume_plan_ns=0,volume_retries=0;
  // Lookups answered with the empty texture: still streaming in, or a format
  // or dimension not handled (logged once each).
  uint64_t pending = 0;
  // Textures whose content changed after a draw of this frame had used them.
  uint64_t replaced = 0;
};

class TextureCache {
 public:
  // Added to a depth resolve's address for the image holding what the resolve
  // leaves in guest memory, (depth24 << 8) | stencil per texel: fetches of
  // that address as anything but a depth format get it. Resolve addresses are
  // page aligned, so the tag never names a real one.
  static constexpr uint32_t kDepthWordsTag = 1;

  TextureCache();
  ~TextureCache();

  bool Initialize(const rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* device, rex::memory::Memory* memory);
  void Shutdown();

  // Frame boundary: textures not used for a while are destroyed once the GPU
  // is done with them. completed_frame is the last frame whose work finished.
  void BeginFrame(uint64_t frame, uint64_t completed_frame);

  // Records the null images' first transition. Called once, before any use.
  void InitializeNullImages(VkCommandBuffer commands);

  // The view for a translated shader's texture binding. Never null: a texture
  // that cannot be made gives a transparent black one.
  VkImageView GetView(const rex::graphics::xenos::xe_gpu_texture_fetch_t& fetch,
                      rex::graphics::xenos::FetchOpDimension dimension, bool is_signed,
                      UploadTarget& upload);

  // About the view the last GetView returned: the texture behind it (null for
  // a resolve or the empty texture), and the last frame through which that
  // answer stays the same while the fetch constant does.
  void* last_texture() const;
  // cod5-nx debug: the image and host format of a texture last_texture() returned.
  static VkImage DebugTextureImage(const void* texture, VkFormat* format);
  uint64_t last_valid_until() const;
  // Marks a texture as used by this submission and frame, as GetView does:
  // what frees textures and rewrites them in place goes by it.
  void Touch(void* texture, uint64_t submission);

  VkSampler GetSampler(const rex::graphics::xenos::xe_gpu_texture_fetch_t& fetch,
                       const rex::graphics::SpirvShader::SamplerBinding& binding);

  // Finds or makes the image a resolve at this address writes into; recreated
  // if the size or the format changes. commands receives the layout
  // transition of a new image.
  ResolveDestination* GetResolveDestination(uint32_t address, uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
                                            VkFormat format, uint32_t host_swizzle,
                                            VkCommandBuffer commands);
  const ResolveDestination* FindResolveDestination(uint32_t address) const;
  // After a resolve wrote dest (transfer writes recorded in commands): brings
  // its sized copies up to date.
  // cod5-nx: see ResolveDestination::Volume::regions.
  static std::vector<VkImageCopy> VolumeRegions(const ResolveDestination& dest, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t depth,
                                                bool tiled, uint32_t pitch);
  void CopyToSized(ResolveDestination& dest, VkCommandBuffer commands);
  // cod5-nx: a view of a texture (opaque Texture*) for a fetch.
  VkImageView ViewOf(void* texture, const rex::graphics::xenos::xe_gpu_texture_fetch_t& fetch, bool is_signed);
  // cod5-nx: the predecessor of a texture still being built (see Impl::placeholders), or null.
  VkImageView Placeholder(uint64_t signature, const rex::graphics::xenos::xe_gpu_texture_fetch_t& fetch,
                          bool is_signed, uint64_t except_key);
  // cod5-nx: an uncompressed 3D texture from guest memory (null if not handled).
  VkImageView GetVolumeView(const rex::graphics::xenos::xe_gpu_texture_fetch_t& fetch, VkFormat host_format,
                            uint32_t host_format_swizzle, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t depth,
                            uint32_t base_page, UploadTarget& upload, bool as_2d_array);
  // cod5-nx: textures reading [start, start + bytes) check their data in full on their next use.
  void InvalidateRange(uint32_t start, uint32_t bytes);
  // Copies a rectangle between two views on the GPU without vkCmdCopyImage,
  // barriers included (the renderer's compute copy); false if it cannot.
  using ComputeCopy = std::function<bool(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkImageView source,
                                         VkImageView dest, int32_t source_x, int32_t source_y,
                                         int32_t dest_x, int32_t dest_y, uint32_t width,
                                         uint32_t height)>;
  void SetComputeCopy(ComputeCopy copy);
  // Whether images of this format can be written by the compute copy.
  bool StorageCapable(VkFormat format);

  // Whether a depth resolve to this address has been sampled as anything but
  // a depth format, so it needs the guest memory words (kDepthWordsTag).
  bool WantsDepthWords(uint32_t address) const;
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
  // Ring producer: copies then clears the bounded interval records. Sorting,
  // formatting and logging are consumer work and never touch TextureCache.
  void TakeUploadReportSnapshot(TextureUploadReportSnapshot& snapshot);
  static std::string FormatUploadReport(const TextureUploadReportSnapshot& snapshot);
#endif
  // A plain 2D view of a resolve destination with a host swizzle, for the
  // swap (which samples a non-array image).
  VkImageView GetResolveDestinationView2D(uint32_t address, uint32_t guest_swizzle,
                                          uint32_t* width_out, uint32_t* height_out);

  // Untiling runs on a worker: call before submitting the command buffers
  // that copy from the staging data.
  void WaitForUploads();

  const TextureCacheStats& stats() const { return stats_; }
  // Changes whenever image views are destroyed, so descriptor sets cached by
  // view handle must be dropped (a new view may reuse a handle).
  uint64_t views_epoch() const;
  // An id for a view that is never given to another: a handle can be reused
  // once its view is destroyed, an id cannot, so descriptor sets cached by id
  // stay right without being dropped whenever any view is destroyed.
  uint64_t ViewId(VkImageView view);
  // Whether the view with this id still exists.
  bool ViewAlive(VkImageView view, uint64_t id
#if COD6_DIAGNOSTICS
                 , uint64_t* probes = nullptr
#endif
                 ) const;
  // Changes when what GetView answers for some fetch may have changed other
  // than by its own checks (a resolve destination made, a texture replaced).
  uint64_t answers_epoch() const;
  // Diagnostic dependency token for resolve fanout images (exact-size and
  // volume copies). Global by design: unrelated changes only lose candidates.
  uint64_t resolve_fanout_generation() const;
  // Only bypass a moved epoch when every intervening change is a recorded
  // resolve at an address not sampled by these fetch slots. Other lifetime,
  // frame, submission and content-deadline checks remain the caller's job.
  bool CanReuseAnswers(uint64_t previous, const uint32_t* fetch_words, uint32_t slot_mask);

 private:
  VkImageView GetViewUncached(const rex::graphics::xenos::xe_gpu_texture_fetch_t& fetch,
                              rex::graphics::xenos::FetchOpDimension dimension, bool is_signed,
                              UploadTarget& upload, VkImageView null_view);
  struct Texture;
  struct Impl;
  std::unique_ptr<Impl> impl_;
  TextureCacheStats stats_;
};

}  // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_upload_source.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace cod6::native {

// A queued conversion must not borrow guest memory. The ring can acknowledge
// consumption before the worker runs, allowing the game to recycle that memory.
// Capture on the recording thread and keep only owned bytes in the worker job.
class TextureUploadSource {
 public:
  void Capture(const uint8_t* base, size_t base_size,
               const uint8_t* mips, size_t mip_size) {
    if (base && base_size) base_.assign(base, base + base_size);
    else base_.clear();
    if (mips && mip_size) mips_.assign(mips, mips + mip_size);
    else mips_.clear();
  }

  const uint8_t* base() const { return base_.empty() ? nullptr : base_.data(); }
  const uint8_t* mips() const { return mips_.empty() ? nullptr : mips_.data(); }
  size_t size() const { return base_.size() + mips_.size(); }

  // Conversion is complete; GPU copies use staging, not these source bytes.
  void Release() {
    std::vector<uint8_t>().swap(base_);
    std::vector<uint8_t>().swap(mips_);
  }

 private:
  std::vector<uint8_t> base_, mips_;
};

}  // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_volume_copy.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

namespace cod6::native {
// Exact runs of adjacent source bytes in linear output order. Guest tiling is
// evaluated once for this immutable fetch layout, never approximated by a
// hardcoded assumption about Xenos microtiles.
class VolumeCopyPlan {
 public:
  struct Run {uint32_t source,bytes;};
  template<class Offset> bool Build(uint32_t width,uint32_t height,uint32_t depth,uint32_t bpb,
                                   uint64_t source_bytes,Offset offset) {
    runs_.clear();bpb_=0;bytes_=0;
    if(!width || !height || !depth || (bpb!=1 && bpb!=2 && bpb!=4 && bpb!=8))return false;
    const uint64_t pixels=uint64_t(width)*height;
    if(pixels>UINT32_MAX/uint64_t(depth)/bpb)return false;
    const uint64_t bytes=pixels*depth*bpb;
    if(bytes>source_bytes || source_bytes>UINT32_MAX)return false;
    for(uint32_t z=0;z<depth;++z)for(uint32_t y=0;y<height;++y)for(uint32_t x=0;x<width;++x) {
      const uint64_t source=uint64_t(offset(x,y,z));
      if(source>source_bytes || bpb>source_bytes-source) {runs_.clear();return false;}
      if(!runs_.empty() && uint64_t(runs_.back().source)+runs_.back().bytes==source) {
        runs_.back().bytes+=bpb;
      } else runs_.push_back({uint32_t(source),bpb});
    }
    bpb_=bpb;bytes_=uint32_t(bytes);return true;
  }
  template<class Swap16,class Swap32>
  void Copy(const uint8_t* source,uint8_t* destination,Swap16 swap16,Swap32 swap32)const {
    uint8_t* cursor=destination;
    for(const auto& run:runs_) {
      const uint8_t* in=source+run.source;uint8_t* out=cursor;cursor+=run.bytes;
      if(bpb_==1) {std::memcpy(out,in,run.bytes);continue;}
      if(bpb_==2) {
        for(uint32_t i=0;i<run.bytes;i+=2) {uint16_t v;std::memcpy(&v,in+i,2);v=swap16(v);std::memcpy(out+i,&v,2);}
      } else {
        for(uint32_t i=0;i<run.bytes;i+=4) {uint32_t v;std::memcpy(&v,in+i,4);v=swap32(v);std::memcpy(out+i,&v,4);}
      }
    }
  }
  uint32_t bytes()const{return bytes_;}
  std::size_t run_count()const{return runs_.size();}
  std::size_t metadata_bytes()const{return runs_.size()*sizeof(Run);}
 private:
  std::vector<Run> runs_;
  uint32_t bpb_=0,bytes_=0;
};
} // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/native_volume_sync.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace cod6::native {
struct VolumeUploadState {bool initialized=false;uint64_t content=0,checked_frame=0;};
enum class VolumeUpdate {kCurrent,kUpdated,kRetry};
// Capture owns the source before Prepare is allowed to submit/wait/recycle
// guest storage. Hash and Record must both use that same captured snapshot.
// Only successful recording commits the GPU image's content identity.
template<class Capture,class Hash,class Prepare,class Record>
VolumeUpdate UpdateVolumeSnapshot(VolumeUploadState& state,uint64_t frame,uint64_t interval,
                                  Capture capture,Hash hash,Prepare prepare,Record record) {
  if(state.initialized && frame>=state.checked_frame && frame-state.checked_frame<interval)
    return VolumeUpdate::kCurrent;
  if(!capture())return VolumeUpdate::kRetry;
  const uint64_t observed=hash();
  if(state.initialized && state.content==observed) {
    state.checked_frame=frame;return VolumeUpdate::kCurrent;
  }
  if(!prepare() || !record(state.initialized))return VolumeUpdate::kRetry;
  state={true,observed,frame};
  return VolumeUpdate::kUpdated;
}
} // namespace cod6::native
```

`src/native/nativo/shaders/copy_color.cs.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
//
// Copies a rectangle of a color image into another of the same format, for
// resolves. vkCmdCopyImage on NVK draws through its meta path, which creates
// image views and buffers for every copy and destroys them when the command
// buffer is reset: with about 30 resolves a frame that was 5% of the command
// ring thread. This needs no objects of its own (shaderStorageImageWrite-
// WithoutFormat covers every destination format with one pipeline).
//
// Rebuild copy_color_cs.h after editing:
//   glslangValidator -S comp -V --target-env vulkan1.1
//     --vn kCopyColorCs -o copy_color_cs.h copy_color.cs.glsl
#extension GL_EXT_samplerless_texture_functions : require
layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform texture2D source;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform writeonly image2D dest;
layout(push_constant) uniform Params {
  ivec2 source_origin;
  ivec2 dest_origin;
  uvec2 size;
};
void main() {
  uvec2 p = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
  if (p.x >= size.x || p.y >= size.y) {
    return;
  }
  imageStore(dest, dest_origin + ivec2(p), texelFetch(source, source_origin + ivec2(p), 0));
}
```

`src/native/nativo/shaders/depth_resolve.cs.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
//
// Turns a depth buffer copied into a buffer into the two forms a game can read
// a depth resolve back as, in place:
// - words[i]: depth as a 32-bit float in [0, 1], for k_24_8 fetches (the
//   translated shaders sample those as R32_SFLOAT);
// - words[packed_offset + i]: what the resolve leaves in Xbox 360 memory,
//   (depth24 << 8) | stencil, for fetches as any other 32-bit format.
// Depth comes either as a 24-bit unorm in the low bits of each word (from a
// D24_UNORM_S8_UINT image) or as a float; stencil, when present, is one byte
// per texel starting at word stencil_offset.
//
// Rebuild depth_resolve_cs.h after editing:
//   glslangValidator -S comp -V --target-env vulkan1.1
//     --vn kDepthResolveCs -o depth_resolve_cs.h depth_resolve.cs.glsl
layout(local_size_x = 64) in;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) buffer Data { uint words[]; };
layout(push_constant) uniform Params {
  uint count;
  // Texels per row of work groups: large copies need a second dimension.
  uint row_words;
  uint stencil_offset;
  uint packed_offset;
  // Bit 0: depth is 24-bit unorm (else float). Bit 1: stencil present.
  uint flags;
};
void main() {
  uint i = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x + gl_GlobalInvocationID.y * row_words;
  if (i >= count) {
    return;
  }
  uint raw = words[i];
  uint depth24;
  float depth;
  if ((flags & 1u) != 0u) {
    depth24 = raw & 0xFFFFFFu;
    depth = float(depth24) * (1.0 / 16777215.0);
  } else {
    depth = clamp(uintBitsToFloat(raw), 0.0, 1.0);
    depth24 = uint(depth * 16777215.0 + 0.5);
  }
  uint stencil = 0u;
  if ((flags & 2u) != 0u) {
    stencil = (words[stencil_offset + (i >> 2u)] >> ((i & 3u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
  }
  words[packed_offset + i] = (depth24 << 8u) | stencil;
  words[i] = floatBitsToUint(depth);
}

```

`src/native/nativo/shaders/depth_to_float.cs.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
//
// Copies a rectangle of a depth buffer into the R32_SFLOAT image the
// translated shaders sample a depth resolve (k_24_8, k_24_8_FLOAT) as, in one
// pass. Reading the depth through a buffer with two copies cost about 1 ms of
// GPU time per full-screen resolve on this GPU; this is a small fraction.
//
// Rebuild depth_to_float_cs.h after editing:
//   glslangValidator -S comp -V --target-env vulkan1.1
//     --vn kDepthToFloatCs -o depth_to_float_cs.h depth_to_float.cs.glsl
#extension GL_EXT_samplerless_texture_functions : require
layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform texture2D depth_buffer;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, r32f) uniform writeonly image2D dest;
layout(push_constant) uniform Params {
  ivec2 source_origin;
  ivec2 dest_origin;
  uvec2 source_size;
  uvec2 dest_size;
};
void main() {
  uvec2 p = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
  if (p.x >= dest_size.x || p.y >= dest_size.y) {
    return;
  }
  // Pixel-center nearest mapping for the only ratios accepted by the host
  // cvar. Do not use the generic source/destination integer division here:
  // cod5sp_008 measured it at roughly 8-13x the old depth-resolve cost on
  // Tegra X1 / NVK. The exact mappings are:
  //   75%: floor((p + 0.5) * 3 / 4) == (3*p + 1) >> 2
  //   50%: floor((p + 0.5) * 1 / 2) == p >> 1
  // Identity copies still map p to p exactly.
  uvec2 source_p = p;
  if (all(equal(source_size * 4u, dest_size * 3u))) {
    source_p = (p * 3u + 1u) >> 2u;
  } else if (all(equal(source_size * 2u, dest_size))) {
    source_p = p >> 1u;
  }
  source_p = min(source_p, source_size - uvec2(1u));
  ivec2 source_c = source_origin + ivec2(source_p);
  ivec2 dest_c = dest_origin + ivec2(p);
  imageStore(dest, dest_c, vec4(texelFetch(depth_buffer, source_c, 0).r));
}

```

`src/native/nativo/texture_pool.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// cod5-nx: sub-allocation pool for textures, adapted from nfsmw-nx (StevensND/nfsmw-nx,
// app/src/nfsmw_nativo_texturas_pool.*, GPL-3.0); names in English, settings cod6_native_texture_pool*.
// The references to nfsmw files below are kept from the original for the measurements behind it.
// The rationale, the measurements and the safety invariant are in texture_pool.h.

#include "texture_pool.h"

#include <rex/cvar.h>
#include <rex/logging.h>
#include <rex/ui/vulkan/util.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod6_native_texture_pool, true, "COD5",
                    "Renderizador nativo (22/09): las texturas toman trozos de bloques grandes de memoria "
                    "en vez de pedir una reserva dedicada cada una. En Horizon cada reserva dedicada cuesta "
                    "~1,9 ms de CPU (un nvMapCreate, DOS reservas de direccion y DOS mapeos), y la imagen no "
                    "cambia. Apagarlo vuelve a la reserva por textura")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

/* COD6_PREWARM_CFG
 *
 * El pool precalentaba la MITAD del presupuesto (con 768 MB salian 256 MB, 8 bloques
 * de 32). En cuanto el juego pasaba de ahi, cada bloque nuevo se reservaba EN CALIENTE,
 * en el hilo del anillo: vkAllocateMemory de 32 MB en mitad de una partida, y el
 * fotograma se queda esperando (en el registro se ve como "bloque N nuevo en caliente"
 * y como la GPU bajando a cero).
 *
 * COD4 lo resuelve con codmw_texturas_pool_crecer_en_hilo: el pool crece en un hilo
 * aparte. Hacer eso aqui requiere un mutex alrededor de slabs_ (Reserve lo recorre en
 * el camino caliente), que es un cambio mas invasivo. Este cvar es el paso previo y sin
 * riesgo: sube lo que se precalienta, de modo que las reservas ocurran al arrancar, que
 * es donde una pausa no molesta, en vez de durante la partida.
 *
 * Si el pool no consigue la memoria, CrearSlab devuelve false y se para: no rompe nada.
 */
REXCVAR_DEFINE_INT32(cod6_native_texture_pool_prewarm_mb, 256, "COD5",
                     "Native renderer: MB of texture pool allocated at startup instead of on demand "
                     "(more here = fewer 32 MB allocations during play)")
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

REXCVAR_DEFINE_INT32(cod6_native_texture_pool_slab_mb, 32, "COD5",
                     "Renderizador nativo: MB de cada bloque grande del pool de texturas. Mas grande = menos "
                     "reservas al sistema, pero cada bloque nuevo cuesta un memset de ese tamano")
    .range(4, 256)
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

namespace cod6::native {
namespace {

uint32_t AlinearArriba(uint32_t valor, uint32_t paso) {
  if (paso <= 1) {
    return valor;
  }
  return ((valor + paso - 1) / paso) * paso;
}

bool BitOcupado(const std::vector<uint64_t>& mapa, uint32_t i) {
  return ((mapa[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1ull) != 0ull;
}

// Returns true if [inicio, inicio+n) is entirely free. Otherwise it stores in `primera_ocupada`
// the first used unit it found, so the search can jump past it.
bool RangoLibre(const std::vector<uint64_t>& mapa, uint32_t inicio, uint32_t n,
                uint32_t& primera_ocupada) {
  for (uint32_t i = inicio; i < inicio + n; ++i) {
    if (BitOcupado(mapa, i)) {
      primera_ocupada = i;
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

void MarcarRango(std::vector<uint64_t>& mapa, uint32_t inicio, uint32_t n, bool ocupado) {
  for (uint32_t i = inicio; i < inicio + n; ++i) {
    if (ocupado) {
      mapa[i >> 6] |= 1ull << (i & 63);
    } else {
      mapa[i >> 6] &= ~(1ull << (i & 63));
    }
  }
}

/*
 * First fit, without a rover.
 *
 * With 32 MB blocks there are 512 units, so a full pass is at most a few hundred bit checks,
 * and jumping past the first used unit keeps it linear. At ten or twenty textures per second
 * this does not show up in measurements; a rover would only add a second pass and more places
 * to get it wrong.
 */
bool BuscarHueco(const std::vector<uint64_t>& mapa, uint32_t unidades_totales, uint32_t n,
                 uint32_t paso, uint32_t& inicio_out) {
  if (n == 0 || n > unidades_totales) {
    return false;
  }
  uint32_t inicio = 0;
  while (inicio + n <= unidades_totales) {
    uint32_t ocupada = 0;
    if (RangoLibre(mapa, inicio, n, ocupada)) {
      inicio_out = inicio;
      return true;
    }
    inicio = AlinearArriba(ocupada + 1, paso);
  }
  return false;
}

// The largest contiguous free range, in units. It is the fragmentation measure in the report.
uint32_t MayorHueco(const std::vector<uint64_t>& mapa, uint32_t unidades_totales) {
  uint32_t mejor = 0;
  uint32_t actual = 0;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < unidades_totales; ++i) {
    if (BitOcupado(mapa, i)) {
      actual = 0;
    } else {
      ++actual;
      mejor = std::max(mejor, actual);
    }
  }
  return mejor;
}

}  // namespace

TexturePool::~TexturePool() { Shutdown(); }

bool TexturePool::ElegirTipoDeMemoria(uint32_t& tipo_out, uint64_t& alineacion_vista_out) const {
  /*
   * A sample image with the same usage and tiling as the real textures, only to ask the
   * driver which memory types it accepts and with what alignment. It is destroyed right
   * away; it does not allocate memory.
   */
  const auto& dfn = dispositivo_->functions();
  VkImageCreateInfo info{};
  info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
  info.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
  info.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
  info.extent = {256, 256, 1};
  info.mipLevels = 1;
  info.arrayLayers = 1;
  info.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
  info.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
  info.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
  info.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
  info.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;

  VkImage muestra = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (dfn.vkCreateImage(device_, &info, nullptr, &muestra) != VK_SUCCESS) {
    return false;
  }
  VkMemoryRequirements requisitos{};
  dfn.vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(device_, muestra, &requisitos);
  dfn.vkDestroyImage(device_, muestra, nullptr);

  // The same criterion CreateDedicatedAllocationImage uses for textures, so the slab lands
  // in the same memory type the dedicated allocation would.
  const uint32_t tipo = rex::ui::vulkan::util::ChooseMemoryType(
      dispositivo_->memory_types(), requisitos.memoryTypeBits,
      rex::ui::vulkan::util::MemoryPurpose::kDeviceLocal);
  if (tipo == UINT32_MAX) {
    return false;
  }
  tipo_out = tipo;
  alineacion_vista_out = requisitos.alignment;
  return true;
}

bool TexturePool::Init(const rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* dispositivo, int32_t mb_cache_max) {
  if (!REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_texture_pool)) {
    REXLOG_INFO("[native] pool de texturas (cod6_native_texture_pool) = no; cada textura pedira su "
                "reserva dedicada, como antes del 22/09");
    return false;
  }
  if (dispositivo == nullptr) {
    return false;
  }
  dispositivo_ = dispositivo;
  device_ = dispositivo->device();

  uint64_t alineacion_vista = 0;
  if (!ElegirTipoDeMemoria(tipo_memoria_, alineacion_vista)) {
    REXLOG_WARN("[native] pool de texturas: no hay un tipo de memoria local valido; se sigue con la "
                "reserva dedicada por textura");
    dispositivo_ = nullptr;
    device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    return false;
  }

  const int32_t slab_mb = std::max<int32_t>(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_texture_pool_slab_mb), 4);
  slab_bytes_ = uint64_t(slab_mb) << 20;
  slab_unidades_ = uint32_t(slab_bytes_ / kUnidadPoolBytes);

  /*
   * How much to prewarm and how far to grow.
   *
   * At startup, half the cache limit (clamped between 64 and 256 MB): the cache currently
   * stays at about 159 MB of 384, so with that the pool almost never needs to grow during a
   * race. The cap is one slab above the cache limit to leave room for fragmentation.
   */
  const int32_t mb_max = mb_cache_max > 0 ? mb_cache_max : 384;
  /* COD6_PREWARM_CFG: cuanto se reserva de golpe al arrancar. Antes era la mitad del
   * presupuesto (con 768 MB salian 256 MB); cada bloque de mas se reservaba en caliente
   * durante la partida. Ahora se puede subir desde el toml. */
  const int32_t mb_inicial =
      std::clamp<int32_t>(REXCVAR_GET(cod6_native_texture_pool_prewarm_mb), 64, mb_max);
  const uint64_t bytes_tope = (uint64_t(mb_max) << 20) + slab_bytes_;
  slabs_tope_ = uint32_t(std::min<uint64_t>((bytes_tope + slab_bytes_ - 1) / slab_bytes_, kMaxSlabs));
  const uint32_t slabs_iniciales =
      uint32_t(std::min<uint64_t>(((uint64_t(mb_inicial) << 20) + slab_bytes_ - 1) / slab_bytes_, slabs_tope_));

  activo_ = true;  // CrearSlab lo necesita puesto
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < slabs_iniciales; ++i) {
    if (!CrearSlab(false)) {
      break;
    }
  }
  if (slabs_.empty()) {
    REXLOG_WARN("[native] pool de texturas: no se pudo crear ni un bloque de {} MB; se sigue con la "
                "reserva dedicada por textura",
                slab_mb);
    activo_ = false;
    dispositivo_ = nullptr;
    device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    return false;
  }

  REXLOG_INFO("[native] pool de texturas ENCENDIDO: {} bloques de {} MB precalentados ({} MB), tope {} "
              "bloques ({} MB); tipo de memoria {}, unidad {} KB, alineacion que pide el driver {} KB",
              slabs_.size(), slab_mb, (slabs_.size() * slab_bytes_) >> 20, slabs_tope_,
              (uint64_t(slabs_tope_) * slab_bytes_) >> 20, tipo_memoria_, kUnidadPoolBytes >> 10,
              alineacion_vista >> 10);
  return true;
}

bool TexturePool::CrearSlab(bool en_caliente) {
  if (!activo_ || slabs_.size() >= slabs_tope_ || slabs_.size() >= kMaxSlabs) {
    return false;
  }
  /*
   * Without VkMemoryDedicatedAllocateInfo on purpose: that way the nvkmd_mem is created with
   * pte_kind = 0 and tile_mode = 0, its layout.valid stays false
   * (nvkmd/switch/nvkmd_switch_dev.c:787-795) and the block accepts aliased images with any
   * pte_kind (horizon/nouveau_horizon_memory.c:1056-1073).
   */
  VkMemoryAllocateInfo reserva{};
  reserva.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
  reserva.allocationSize = slab_bytes_;
  reserva.memoryTypeIndex = tipo_memoria_;

  VkDeviceMemory memoria = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (dispositivo_->functions().vkAllocateMemory(device_, &reserva, nullptr, &memoria) != VK_SUCCESS) {
    ++slabs_fallados_;
    return false;
  }

  Slab slab;
  slab.memoria = memoria;
  slab.unidades = slab_unidades_;
  slab.ocupadas.assign((slab_unidades_ + 63) / 64, 0ull);
  slab.largo.assign(slab_unidades_, 0u);
  slabs_.push_back(std::move(slab));
  if (en_caliente) {
    ++slabs_en_caliente_;
    REXLOG_INFO("[native] pool de texturas: bloque {} nuevo en caliente; ya van {} MB reservados",
                slabs_.size() - 1, (slabs_.size() * slab_bytes_) >> 20);
  }
  return true;
}

void TexturePool::Shutdown() {
  if (device_ != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
    const auto& dfn = dispositivo_->functions();
    for (Slab& slab : slabs_) {
      if (slab.memoria != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
        dfn.vkFreeMemory(device_, slab.memoria, nullptr);
      }
    }
  }
  slabs_.clear();
  activo_ = false;
  dispositivo_ = nullptr;
  device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

bool TexturePool::Reserve(const VkMemoryRequirements& requisitos, VkDeviceMemory& memoria_out,
                            VkDeviceSize& offset_out, uint32_t& bloque_out) {
  if (!activo_) {
    return false;
  }
  // The slab's type must be among the ones this image accepts. On NVK for Tegra it always
  // is, but if some format said otherwise, falling back to the dedicated path is better than
  // binding something invalid.
  if (((requisitos.memoryTypeBits >> tipo_memoria_) & 1u) == 0u) {
    return false;
  }
  if (requisitos.size == 0) {
    return false;
  }

  const uint64_t unidades64 = (requisitos.size + kUnidadPoolBytes - 1) / kUnidadPoolBytes;
  if (unidades64 > slab_unidades_) {
    ++huecos_fallados_;
    return false;  // does not fit even in an empty block: use the dedicated path
  }
  const uint32_t unidades = uint32_t(unidades64);

  /*
   * The alignment is honored exactly; it is not assumed to be 64 KiB.
   *
   * For TILING_OPTIMAL on Switch the driver asks for at least 64 KiB
   * (nvk_image.c:1192-1197), but a 3D texture can ask for up to 512 KB because the level-0
   * tile size includes z_log2 (nouveau/nil/image.rs:430). Assuming 64 KiB would make the
   * bind fail on a driver assert (nvk_image.c:1692), a rare and late failure. Converted to
   * units, the alignment is the step used to search for candidate starts.
   */
  const uint64_t alineacion = std::max<uint64_t>(requisitos.alignment, kUnidadPoolBytes);
  const uint32_t paso = uint32_t(std::max<uint64_t>(1, alineacion / kUnidadPoolBytes));

  for (uint32_t s = 0; s < slabs_.size(); ++s) {
    Slab& slab = slabs_[s];
    uint32_t inicio = 0;
    if (!BuscarHueco(slab.ocupadas, slab.unidades, unidades, paso, inicio)) {
      continue;
    }
    MarcarRango(slab.ocupadas, inicio, unidades, true);
    slab.largo[inicio] = unidades;
    slab.unidades_en_uso += unidades;

    memoria_out = slab.memoria;
    offset_out = VkDeviceSize(inicio) * kUnidadPoolBytes;
    bloque_out = (s << 24) | inicio;
    ++texturas_vivas_;
    ++texturas_colocadas_;
    return true;
  }

  ++huecos_fallados_;
  return false;
}

void TexturePool::Release(uint32_t bloque) {
  if (bloque == kInvalidPoolBlock || !activo_) {
    return;
  }
  const uint32_t s = bloque >> 24;
  const uint32_t inicio = bloque & 0x00FFFFFFu;
  if (s >= slabs_.size()) {
    REXLOG_ERROR("[native] pool de texturas: bloque {:08X} con un bloque grande que no existe", bloque);
    return;
  }
  Slab& slab = slabs_[s];
  if (inicio >= slab.unidades || slab.largo[inicio] == 0u) {
    REXLOG_ERROR("[native] pool de texturas: bloque {:08X} que no era el inicio de nada (doble liberacion?)",
                 bloque);
    return;
  }
  const uint32_t unidades = slab.largo[inicio];
  MarcarRango(slab.ocupadas, inicio, unidades, false);
  slab.largo[inicio] = 0u;
  slab.unidades_en_uso -= std::min(slab.unidades_en_uso, unidades);
  if (texturas_vivas_ > 0) {
    --texturas_vivas_;
  }
}

void TexturePool::PerFrame(uint64_t fotograma) {
  if (!activo_ || slabs_.size() >= slabs_tope_) {
    return;
  }
  if (fotograma < ultimo_crecimiento_ + kFotogramasEntreSlabs) {
    return;
  }
  uint64_t libres = 0;
  for (const Slab& slab : slabs_) {
    libres += uint64_t(slab.unidades - slab.unidades_en_uso) * kUnidadPoolBytes;
  }
  if (libres >= kHolguraBytes) {
    return;
  }
  ultimo_crecimiento_ = fotograma;
  CrearSlab(true);
}

TexturePoolIntegrity TexturePool::VerifyIntegrity() const {
  TexturePoolIntegrity r;
  r.checked = true;
  for (uint32_t s = 0; s < slabs_.size(); ++s) {
    const Slab& slab = slabs_[s];
    uint32_t recorded_units = 0;
    std::vector<uint64_t> rebuilt((slab.unidades + 63) / 64, 0ull);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < slab.unidades; ++i) {
      const uint32_t largo = slab.largo[i];
      if (!largo) continue;
      if (i + largo > slab.unidades) {
        r.ok = false;
        r.slab = s;
        r.unit = i;
        return r;
      }
      for (uint32_t k = i; k < i + largo; ++k) rebuilt[k >> 6] |= 1ull << (k & 63);
      recorded_units += largo;
    }
    for (uint32_t w = 0; w < rebuilt.size(); ++w) {
      if (rebuilt[w] != slab.ocupadas[w]) {
        // Name the first unit that differs, so the log points at the allocation.
        for (uint32_t bit = 0; bit < 64; ++bit) {
          const uint64_t mask = 1ull << bit;
          if ((rebuilt[w] & mask) == (slab.ocupadas[w] & mask)) continue;
          r.ok = false;
          r.slab = s;
          r.unit = w * 64 + bit;
          r.marked = (slab.ocupadas[w] & mask) ? 1u : 0u;
          r.recorded = (rebuilt[w] & mask) ? 1u : 0u;
          return r;
        }
      }
    }
    if (recorded_units != slab.unidades_en_uso) {
      r.ok = false;
      r.slab = s;
      r.marked = slab.unidades_en_uso;
      r.recorded = recorded_units;
      return r;
    }
  }
  return r;
}

TexturePoolState TexturePool::State() const {
  TexturePoolState e;
  e.activo = activo_;
  e.tipo_memoria = tipo_memoria_;
  e.slabs = uint32_t(slabs_.size());
  e.bytes_reservados = uint64_t(slabs_.size()) * slab_bytes_;
  uint32_t mayor = 0;
  for (const Slab& slab : slabs_) {
    e.bytes_en_uso += uint64_t(slab.unidades_en_uso) * kUnidadPoolBytes;
    mayor = std::max(mayor, MayorHueco(slab.ocupadas, slab.unidades));
  }
  e.bytes_libres = e.bytes_reservados - e.bytes_en_uso;
  e.bytes_mayor_hueco = uint64_t(mayor) * kUnidadPoolBytes;
  e.texturas_vivas = texturas_vivas_;
  e.texturas_colocadas = texturas_colocadas_;
  e.texturas_dedicadas = texturas_dedicadas_;
  e.huecos_fallados = huecos_fallados_;
  e.slabs_en_caliente = slabs_en_caliente_;
  e.slabs_fallados = slabs_fallados_;
  return e;
}

std::string TexturePool::Summary() const {
  if (!activo_) {
    return std::string("pool de texturas apagado (") + std::to_string(texturas_dedicadas_) +
           " texturas con reserva dedicada)";
  }
  const TexturePoolState e = State();
  /*
   * Fragmentation is what needs watching: if plenty is free but the largest free range is
   * small, large textures start falling back to the dedicated path and the savings vanish
   * without anything failing. That is why both figures are printed together.
   */
  const uint64_t frag = e.bytes_libres > 0 ? 100u - (e.bytes_mayor_hueco * 100u / e.bytes_libres) : 0u;
  return std::string("pool de texturas: ") + std::to_string(e.slabs) + " bloques (" +
         std::to_string(e.bytes_reservados >> 20) + " MB), " + std::to_string(e.bytes_en_uso >> 20) +
         " MB en uso por " + std::to_string(e.texturas_vivas) + " texturas; libres " +
         std::to_string(e.bytes_libres >> 20) + " MB con el mayor hueco en " +
         std::to_string(e.bytes_mayor_hueco >> 20) + " MB (fragmentacion " + std::to_string(frag) +
         " %); " + std::to_string(e.texturas_colocadas) + " colocadas y " +
         std::to_string(e.texturas_dedicadas) + " a la ruta dedicada (" + std::to_string(e.huecos_fallados) +
         " sin hueco); bloques en caliente " + std::to_string(e.slabs_en_caliente) + ", negados " +
         std::to_string(e.slabs_fallados);
}

}  // namespace cod6::native

```

`src/native/nativo/texture_pool.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// cod5-nx: sub-allocation pool for textures, adapted from nfsmw-nx (StevensND/nfsmw-nx,
// app/src/nfsmw_nativo_texturas_pool.*, GPL-3.0); names in English, settings cod6_native_texture_pool*.
// The references to nfsmw files below are kept from the original for the measurements behind it.
//
// Why it exists (measured, not estimated)
//
//   Without the pool, every texture gets its own dedicated allocation: CrearTextura ->
//   rex::ui::vulkan::util::CreateDedicatedAllocationImage -> vkAllocateMemory with
//   VkMemoryDedicatedAllocateInfo. On Horizon that is not a cheap call.
//
//   What every texture pays, following the chain in the Mesa tree:
//     1. nvk_AllocateMemory (nvk_device_memory.c:133); in the __SWITCH__ branch
//        (:178-193) it sets alignment, tile_mode and pte_kind.
//     2. nvkmd_switch_dev_alloc_mem_impl (nvkmd/switch/nvkmd_switch_dev.c:750-838):
//        memory_create -> memory_map -> alloc_va (VA #1) -> va_bind_mem (mapping #1).
//     3. nouveau_horizon_memory_create (horizon/nouveau_horizon_memory.c:468-663):
//        memalign + nvMapCreate (:572) and, always, memset(size) + armDCacheClean(size)
//        (:612-620), even though Vulkan does not ask for ZERO_INITIALIZE.
//     4. nvk_image_plane_bind (nvk_image.c:1697-1707): since our textures are
//        SAMPLED|TRANSFER_DST, nvk_image_can_compress returns false (nvk_image.c:843-846),
//        so the dedicated shortcut is not taken: a VA #2 is reserved with the block-linear
//        pte_kind and a mapping #2 is made.
//
//   In short: the dedicated allocation costs twice the VAs and mappings and gives nothing back.
//   Its only benefit is compression, and our textures are never compressible.
//
// The measurement (console, entering a new zone)
//
//   From rex_perfil.log:
//     "NvMap nuevos 17.6 con cache (2.8 MB) y 0.3 sin cache (0.0 MB), 7.8 ms |
//      direcciones de GPU 35.4 (4.0 ms), mapeos 35.4 (0.0 MB, 19.2 ms)"
//   -> 31.0 ms/s of CPU just allocating and mapping. And 35.4/17.9 = 1.98: two VAs and two
//      mappings per NvMap, exactly what the code above predicts.
//
//   Medians per call, 80 intervals with >=5 allocations/s across several logs
//   (the counters come from the --wrap wrappers in tools/switch/sdk/switch_perf.cpp:789-810):
//     nvMapCreate                422 us
//     nvAddressSpaceAllocFixed   127 us
//     MapBufferEx                626 us
//     One texture (1 + 2 + 2)   ~1.9 ms
//
//   Real peaks: 159 ms/s (16 % of a core) and 298.7 ms/s (30 % of a core).
//
//   The driver's BO cache does not save this: in a long measurement it hits 88 % and
//   everything is still paid, because recycling saves the nvMapCreate but not the VA or the
//   mapping, which are the expensive two thirds.
//
// What this pool saves
//
//   Per texture only the plane's VA and its partial mapping remain: 1.9 ms -> ~0.75 ms (-60 %).
//     Bad stretch:                  31.0 ms/s -> 18.8 ms/s   (-12.2 ms/s)
//     Average frame (~27 FPS):       1.15 ms  ->  0.70 ms    (-0.45 ms)
//     Burst of 15 textures:         28.5 ms   -> 11.3 ms     (-17.2 ms)
//   It is a variance fix, not an average one: allocation explains 9 % of the average gap
//   but 17 of the 44 ms of the worst frame, which is what is noticeable when turning.
//
//   As a bonus: live NvMap handles drop from ~3,600 to ~12, and with them the ceiling of
//   the area shared with nvdrv goes away (error 0x235C, which showed up as a black screen;
//   see nfsmw_entorno_mesa.cpp:30-44).
//
// Why not a single pixel changes
//
//   Binding at offset != 0 into non-dedicated memory is supported and keeps the block-linear
//   layout: NVK reserves a VA of its own for the plane with the right pte_kind and maps the
//   sub-range (nvk_image.c:1700-1710 -> nouveau_horizon_vm.c:374-394).
//   The size vkGetImageMemoryRequirements returns is already rounded to 64 KiB precisely for
//   this (nvk_image.c:1422-1428), and requiresDedicatedAllocation is never true on Switch
//   (nvk_image.c:1444-1460). The slabs are allocated without VkMemoryDedicatedAllocateInfo,
//   so their layout.valid is false and they accept any pte_kind (nvkmd_switch_dev.c:787-795,
//   nouveau_horizon_memory.c:1056-1073).
//   No compression is lost because there was none (nvk_image.c:843-846).
//
// Safety invariant (mandatory, read before touching eviction)
//
//   Without the pool, if the GPU read a texture that was just destroyed it would read memory
//   that was freed but still mapped: harmless garbage. With the pool it would read the pixels
//   of another texture, because the physical block is reused immediately.
//
//   That is only safe while both of these conditions hold. The current code meets them, and
//   they are mandatory:
//     a) Normal eviction only releases textures unused for 120 frames
//        (kFotogramasSinUsoParaSoltar, nfsmw_nativo_dibujos.cpp:2695-2705). No pending work
//        can reference them.
//     b) Emergency eviction (SoltarTexturasPorFaltaDeMemoria, :2835-2850) calls
//        EsperarGpuDelTodo() first.
//   If that threshold of 120 is ever lowered or that wait removed, this pool is no longer
//   safe and releasing a block must be delayed by a few frames.
//
// Single thread
//
//   All of this lives on the ring thread (PrepararTextura in C3 and render targets in C2),
//   so there is no lock. If a texture is ever created from another thread, a lock must be
//   added here first.

#pragma once

#include <rex/ui/vulkan/device.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace cod6::native {

// Opaque identifier of a pool block. This value means "not from the pool" and is the
// default value ImagenNativa::pool_bloque must hold.
inline constexpr uint32_t kInvalidPoolBlock = UINT32_MAX;

// Pool granularity. Horizon binds with 64 KiB alignment
// (NOUVEAU_HORIZON_BIND_ALIGN_B, horizon/nouveau_horizon_private.h:21) and NVK already
// rounds image sizes to that value, so no memory is lost: it is the same rounding the
// dedicated allocation already pays.
// COD6_V311_POOLINVARIANT: set by VerifyIntegrity when the bookkeeping no
// longer describes the bitmap, empty when both agree.
struct TexturePoolIntegrity {
  bool checked = false;
  bool ok = true;
  uint32_t slab = 0, unit = 0;
  uint32_t marked = 0, recorded = 0;
};

inline constexpr uint64_t kUnidadPoolBytes = 64ull * 1024ull;

// For the AnotarMemoriaDeLaGpu report.
struct TexturePoolState {
  bool activo = false;
  uint32_t tipo_memoria = UINT32_MAX;
  uint32_t slabs = 0;
  uint64_t bytes_reservados = 0;  // sum of the slab sizes
  uint64_t bytes_en_uso = 0;      // space used by live textures
  uint64_t bytes_libres = 0;
  uint64_t bytes_mayor_hueco = 0;  // largest contiguous free range: measures fragmentation
  uint64_t texturas_vivas = 0;
  uint64_t texturas_colocadas = 0;   // running total that went into the pool
  uint64_t texturas_dedicadas = 0;   // running total that fell back to the dedicated path
  uint64_t huecos_fallados = 0;      // times it did not fit in any slab
  uint64_t slabs_en_caliente = 0;    // slabs created after prewarming
  uint64_t slabs_fallados = 0;       // times vkAllocateMemory refused a slab
};

/*
 * GPU memory sub-allocator for the native renderer's textures.
 *
 * Intended use, all from the ring thread:
 *   Init(dispositivo, mb_cache_max)      once, in Inicializar(), before drawing
 *   PerFrame(fotograma)                 once per frame, to grow with headroom
 *   Reserve(requisitos, mem, offset, blq)  in CrearTextura, before vkBindImageMemory
 *   NoteDedicated()                        when a texture falls back to the dedicated path
 *   Release(bloque)                         in DestruirImagen
 *   Shutdown()                              in the destructor, after the images are destroyed
 */
class TexturePool {
 public:
  TexturePool() = default;
  ~TexturePool();

  TexturePool(const TexturePool&) = delete;
  TexturePool& operator=(const TexturePool&) = delete;

  /*
   * Prepares the pool and prewarms the slabs for the steady state.
   *
   * `mb_cache_max` is nfsmw_nativo_texturas_mb_max: it gives the initial MB (half of it,
   * between 64 and 256) and the cap (the cache limit plus one slab of headroom).
   *
   * Returns false if the cvar is off, if there is no valid memory type or if not even one
   * slab could be created. In that case Reserve() always fails and everything keeps using
   * the usual dedicated path, exactly the behavior without the pool.
   */
  bool Init(const rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* dispositivo, int32_t mb_cache_max);

  // Frees every slab. The images must already be destroyed.
  void Shutdown();

  bool Active() const { return activo_; }

  /*
   * Finds room for an already created image.
   *
   * `requisitos` is what vkGetImageMemoryRequirements returns for that VkImage.
   * requisitos.alignment is honored exactly, it is not assumed to be 64 KiB: a 3D texture
   * can ask for up to 512 KB because of the tile mode's z_log2 (nil/image.rs:430).
   *
   * If it returns true, the caller must call vkBindImageMemory(imagen, memoria_out,
   * offset_out) and store bloque_out in ImagenNativa::pool_bloque.
   * If it returns false, nothing has been touched: the caller uses the dedicated path.
   */
  bool Reserve(const VkMemoryRequirements& requisitos, VkDeviceMemory& memoria_out,
                VkDeviceSize& offset_out, uint32_t& bloque_out);

  // Returns the block to the pool. Accepts kInvalidPoolBlock and does nothing with it.
  void Release(uint32_t bloque);

  /*
   * Growth with headroom. Called once per frame.
   *
   * Creates a new slab when less than kHolguraBytes is free, never at the moment it is
   * needed: nouveau_horizon_memory_create does a memset + dcache clean of the whole slab
   * (:612-620), and 32 MB of that in the middle of a race would be a 10-15 ms stutter, the
   * very problem this pool solves. It also creates at most one every kFotogramasEntreSlabs.
   */
  void PerFrame(uint64_t fotograma);

  // A texture did not fit (or the pool is off) and took the dedicated path.
  void NoteDedicated() { ++texturas_dedicadas_; }

  // COD6_V311_POOLINVARIANT: does the bitmap still agree with the ranges the
  // allocator recorded? A drift here means two images can share memory.
  TexturePoolIntegrity VerifyIntegrity() const;
  TexturePoolState State() const;

  // Line for the C3 report of AnotarMemoriaDeLaGpu. No trailing newline.
  std::string Summary() const;

 private:
  struct Slab {
    VkDeviceMemory memoria = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t unidades = 0;
    uint32_t unidades_en_uso = 0;
    std::vector<uint64_t> ocupadas;  // bitmap, one unit per bit
    std::vector<uint32_t> largo;     // units reserved from each start (0 = not a start)
  };

  // 8 MB of headroom: below that a new slab is requested.
  static constexpr uint64_t kHolguraBytes = 48ull << 20;  // cod5-nx: 8 in nfsmw; COD5 streams far more textures
  // Never two slabs in a row: gives eviction time to free memory before growing further.
  static constexpr uint64_t kFotogramasEntreSlabs = 20;  // cod5-nx: 120 in nfsmw (bursts fell back to dedicated)
  // The slab index goes in the top 8 bits of the block identifier.
  static constexpr uint32_t kMaxSlabs = 255;

  bool CrearSlab(bool en_caliente);
  bool ElegirTipoDeMemoria(uint32_t& tipo_out, uint64_t& alineacion_vista_out) const;

  const rex::ui::vulkan::VulkanDevice* dispositivo_ = nullptr;
  VkDevice device_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  bool activo_ = false;
  uint32_t tipo_memoria_ = UINT32_MAX;
  uint64_t slab_bytes_ = 0;
  uint32_t slab_unidades_ = 0;
  uint32_t slabs_tope_ = 0;
  uint64_t ultimo_crecimiento_ = 0;
  std::vector<Slab> slabs_;

  uint64_t texturas_vivas_ = 0;
  uint64_t texturas_colocadas_ = 0;
  uint64_t texturas_dedicadas_ = 0;
  uint64_t huecos_fallados_ = 0;
  uint64_t slabs_en_caliente_ = 0;
  uint64_t slabs_fallados_ = 0;
};

}  // namespace cod6::native

```

```cpp
// The game starts its next frame as soon as the swap-complete interrupt of the
// previous one arrives (its frame limiter waits for a counter that interrupt
// bumps). With the native renderer that interrupt came back immediately, so
// frames were paced only by how long they took: 16.7, 33 or 50 ms in turn,
// which feels choppy even at a good average. Holding the interrupt to vblank
// boundaries, at least this many vblanks after the previous one, gives the
// even cadence a console gets from vsync; 2 is a steady 30.
REXCVAR_DEFINE_BOOL(cod5_pace_before_present, false, "COD5",
                    "Hold a frame for the frame rate cap before presenting it rather than "
                    "after, so frames go on screen evenly spaced");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod5_min_frame_vblanks, 3, "COD5",
                      "Native renderer: minimum 60 Hz vblanks between frames (1 = the game's "
                      "own pacing, 2 = an even 30 fps)");

// cod5-nx debug: every N presented frames, the guest output as the presenter has it is written to
// <cod5_debug_capture_dir>/frame_<swap>.rgbx (8-byte header: width, height, little endian; then R8G8B8X8 rows).
// tools/rgbx_to_png.py converts them. Off (0) by default: each capture waits for the GPU.
REXCVAR_DEFINE_UINT32(cod5_debug_capture_every, 0, "COD5",
                      "Debug: save every Nth presented frame to cod5_debug_capture_dir (0 = off)");
REXCVAR_DEFINE_STRING(cod5_debug_capture_dir, "", "COD5", "Debug: folder for cod5_debug_capture_every");

REXCVAR_DEFINE_STRING(cod5_renderer, "xenos", "COD5",
                      "xenos = the SDK's emulated Xbox 360 GPU; native = the native renderer "
                      "(in development: COD5 rendering correctness is unverified)")
    .allowed({"xenos", "native"})
    .lifecycle(rex::cvar::Lifecycle::kInitOnly);

// Sleeps until at least the deadline (project8-sw added rex::thread::SleepUntil to its SDK for this; ours lacks it).
void SleepUntil(Clock::time_point deadline) {
  const auto now = Clock::now();
  if (deadline > now) {
    rex::thread::Sleep(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(deadline - now));
  }
}

constexpr uint32_t kMmioBase = 0x7FC80000;
constexpr uint32_t kMmioMask = 0xFFFF0000;
constexpr uint32_t kMmioSize = 0x0000FFFF;

// Big-endian words of a command buffer. In the ring the position wraps around
// (its size is a power of two); in an indirect buffer it does not.
struct Reader {
  const uint8_t* base = nullptr;
  uint32_t mask = 0;  // words - 1 in the ring; 0 in a linear buffer
  uint32_t pos = 0;
  uint32_t end = 0;

  uint32_t Pending() const { return mask ? ((end - pos) & mask) : (end - pos); }
  uint32_t Peek() const { return rex::memory::load_and_swap<uint32_t>(base + size_t(pos) * 4); }
  uint32_t Read() {
    const uint32_t value = Peek();
    Advance(1);
    return value;
  }
  void Advance(uint32_t words) { pos = mask ? ((pos + words) & mask) : (pos + words); }
};
```
